units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|This planet is populated by an alien species that resemble giant, intelligent squirrels. However, the most surprising aspect of the spaceport is not the aliens, but the fact that human merchants and other civilians are walking among them and are clearly at home here. Would you like to find someone who can tell you what is going on here?|23|0
units.english: This planet is populated by an alien species that resemble giant, intelligent squirrels. However, the most surprising aspect of the spaceport is not the aliens, but the fact that human merchants and other civilians are walking among them and are clearly at home here. Would you like to find someone who can tell you what is going on here?
units.italian: Questo pianeta è popolato da una specie aliena che assomiglia a giganteschi scoiattoli intelligenti. Tuttavia l'aspetto più sorprendente dello spazioporto non sono gli alieni, ma il fatto che mercanti umani e altri civili camminino tra loro e si sentano chiaramente a casa. Vuoi cercare qualcuno che ti spieghi cosa succede qui?

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	(Sure.)|25|0
units.english: (Sure.)
units.italian: (Certo.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	(Not right now.)|27|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	You walk up to a human merchant who is busy haggling with one of the aliens. They interrupt their conversation when they see you approaching, and the human gestures for you to join them. "You look totally lost," he says. "First time down the rabbit hole?"|31|0
units.english: You walk up to a human merchant who is busy haggling with one of the aliens. They interrupt their conversation when they see you approaching, and the human gestures for you to join them. "You look totally lost," he says. "First time down the rabbit hole?"
units.italian: Ti avvicini a un mercante umano impegnato a contrattare con uno degli alieni. Interrompono la conversazione quando ti vedono arrivare, e l'umano ti fa cenno di unirti a loro. "Sembri completamente perso," dice. "Prima volta giù nella tana del coniglio?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	You nod. The alien reaches out a paw to shake hands with you. "Welcome to Hai space," they say. "We are people of peace, and you are free to visit us or even live among us. Our worlds provide enough bounty for all."|32|0
units.english: You nod. The alien reaches out a paw to shake hands with you. "Welcome to Hai space," they say. "We are people of peace, and you are free to visit us or even live among us. Our worlds provide enough bounty for all."
units.italian: Annuisci. L'alieno allunga una zampa per stringerti la mano. "Benvenuto nello spazio degli Hai," dice. "Siamo un popolo di pace, e sei libero di visitarci o persino di vivere tra noi. I nostri mondi producono abbondanza per tutti."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|The Hai here seem more friendly and approachable than those you met earlier. Even more surprising though is the fact that human merchants and other civilians are walking among them and are clearly at home here. Would you like to find someone who can tell you what is going on here?|36|0
units.english: The Hai here seem more friendly and approachable than those you met earlier. Even more surprising though is the fact that human merchants and other civilians are walking among them and are clearly at home here. Would you like to find someone who can tell you what is going on here?
units.italian: Gli Hai qui sembrano più amichevoli e accessibili di quelli che hai incontrato prima. Ancora più sorprendente, però, è il fatto che mercanti umani e altri civili camminino tra loro e si sentano chiaramente a casa. Vuoi cercare qualcuno che ti spieghi cosa succede qui?

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	(Sure.)|38|0
units.english: (Sure.)
units.italian: (Certo.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	(Not right now.)|40|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	You walk up to a human merchant who is busy haggling with one of the Hai. They interrupt their conversation when they see you approaching, and the human gestures for you to join them. "You look lost," he says. "First time down the rabbit hole?"|44|0
units.english: You walk up to a human merchant who is busy haggling with one of the Hai. They interrupt their conversation when they see you approaching, and the human gestures for you to join them. "You look lost," he says. "First time down the rabbit hole?"
units.italian: Ti avvicini a un mercante umano impegnato a contrattare con uno degli Hai. Interrompono la conversazione quando ti vedono arrivare, e l'umano ti fa cenno di unirti a loro. "Sembri perso," dice. "Prima volta giù nella tana del coniglio?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"No, I've actually met with the Hai up north," you respond. The merchant looks slightly concerned with this, but the Hai only seems to sigh.|45|0
units.english: "No, I've actually met with the Hai up north," you respond. The merchant looks slightly concerned with this, but the Hai only seems to sigh.
units.italian: "No, in realtà ho incontrato gli Hai a nord," rispondi. Il mercante sembra leggermente preoccupato, ma l'Hai si limita a sospirare.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"Ah, you have met our wayward sisters and brothers. I hope that they did not cause you too much trouble, for they are misled in their ways," they say. "Welcome to Hai space. Unlike those that you met before, the rest of us are a people of peace, and you are free to visit us or even live among us. Our worlds provide enough bounty for all."|46|0
units.english: "Ah, you have met our wayward sisters and brothers. I hope that they did not cause you too much trouble, for they are misled in their ways," they say. "Welcome to Hai space. Unlike those that you met before, the rest of us are a people of peace, and you are free to visit us or even live among us. Our worlds provide enough bounty for all."
units.italian: "Ah, hai incontrato le nostre sorelle e i nostri fratelli traviati. Spero che non ti abbiano causato troppi problemi, perché sono fuorviati nelle loro vie," dice. "Benvenuto nello spazio degli Hai. A differenza di quelli che hai incontrato prima, noi altri siamo un popolo di pace, e sei libero di visitarci o persino di vivere tra noi. I nostri mondi producono abbondanza per tutti."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	You glance quickly at the human merchant to see his expression, wondering if these aliens can indeed be so benign, but his expression is calm and untroubled. "It's true," he says, "look around you. These buildings have stood for thousands of years. Hai society is so advanced, they need almost no resources to maintain it."|49|0
units.english: You glance quickly at the human merchant to see his expression, wondering if these aliens can indeed be so benign, but his expression is calm and untroubled. "It's true," he says, "look around you. These buildings have stood for thousands of years. Hai society is so advanced, they need almost no resources to maintain it."
units.italian: Dai una rapida occhiata al mercante umano per vedere la sua espressione, chiedendoti se questi alieni possano davvero essere così benigni, ma la sua espressione è calma e serena. "È vero," dice, "guardati intorno. Questi edifici sono in piedi da migliaia di anni. La società degli Hai è così avanzata che non ha quasi bisogno di risorse per mantenersi."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"How did humanity reach this place? Did they use jump drives?"|53|0
units.english: "How did humanity reach this place? Did they use jump drives?"
units.italian: "Come ha fatto l'umanità a raggiungere questo posto? Ha usato motori di salto?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	The human merchant raises an eyebrow. "Can't say I'm familiar with what a jump drive is. In case you aren't in the know, though, there's a wormhole in Hai space that connects back to a secluded part of human space. Don't bother trying to figure out why and how it's there, because not even the Hai know."|54|0
units.english: The human merchant raises an eyebrow. "Can't say I'm familiar with what a jump drive is. In case you aren't in the know, though, there's a wormhole in Hai space that connects back to a secluded part of human space. Don't bother trying to figure out why and how it's there, because not even the Hai know."
units.italian: Il mercante umano alza un sopracciglio. "Non posso dire di sapere cosa sia un motore di salto. Nel caso tu non lo sappia, però, nello spazio degli Hai c'è un cunicolo che riporta a una parte isolata dello spazio umano. Non perdere tempo a capire perché e come sia lì, perché non lo sanno nemmeno gli Hai."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"Why do you allow humans to settle here?"|57|0
units.english: "Why do you allow humans to settle here?"
units.italian: "Perché permettete agli umani di stabilirsi qui?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"What do you ask for in return for letting humans settle here?"|58|0
units.english: "What do you ask for in return for letting humans settle here?"
units.italian: "Cosa chiedete in cambio per lasciare che gli umani si stabiliscano qui?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"Humans are a young species," the Hai says, "full of energy, full of new ideas. And the Hai are old, and everything we do is what we have done before. When humans go on vacation, they travel to a world with perfect weather, sunny every day. When Hai go on vacation, we visit the stormiest world, to find unpredictability and change. Humans are so strange, that to speak with a human is like a small vacation." They smile, and you catch a glimpse of its massive incisors. Based on your knowledge of xenobiology you would guess that the Hai are herbivores, but you can't be certain.|60|0
units.english: "Humans are a young species," the Hai says, "full of energy, full of new ideas. And the Hai are old, and everything we do is what we have done before. When humans go on vacation, they travel to a world with perfect weather, sunny every day. When Hai go on vacation, we visit the stormiest world, to find unpredictability and change. Humans are so strange, that to speak with a human is like a small vacation." They smile, and you catch a glimpse of its massive incisors. Based on your knowledge of xenobiology you would guess that the Hai are herbivores, but you can't be certain.
units.italian: "Gli umani sono una specie giovane," dice l'Hai, "piena di energia, piena di idee nuove. E gli Hai sono vecchi, e tutto ciò che facciamo è ciò che abbiamo già fatto. Quando gli umani vanno in vacanza, viaggiano verso un mondo con il clima perfetto, soleggiato ogni giorno. Quando gli Hai vanno in vacanza, visitiamo il mondo più tempestoso, per trovare imprevedibilità e cambiamento. Gli umani sono così strani che parlare con un umano è come una piccola vacanza." Sorride, e intravedi i suoi enormi incisivi. In base alle tue conoscenze di xenobiologia diresti che gli Hai sono erbivori, ma non puoi esserne certo.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"So I'm allowed to travel throughout your territory if I want?"|64|0
units.english: "So I'm allowed to travel throughout your territory if I want?"
units.italian: "Quindi posso viaggiare in tutto il vostro territorio se voglio?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"How come people back in human space don't know that you are here?"|66|0
units.english: "How come people back in human space don't know that you are here?"
units.italian: "Come mai la gente nello spazio umano non sa che siete qui?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"If your people are peaceful then why are the Hai from the north so hostile?"|71|0
units.english: "If your people are peaceful then why are the Hai from the north so hostile?"
units.italian: "Se il vostro popolo è pacifico, perché gli Hai del nord sono così ostili?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"How come people back in human space don't know that you are here?"|73|0
units.english: "How come people back in human space don't know that you are here?"
units.italian: "Come mai la gente nello spazio umano non sa che siete qui?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	The human merchant laughs. "Probably because most of us came here to escape from the chaos and fighting in human space. The last thing we want is for it to follow us here. Not that I'm saying you can't tell anyone about the wormhole, but if I were you I wouldn't go spreading the news too widely either. And take a look around Hai space before you leave; you'll find that we could learn a lot from them."|76|0
units.english: The human merchant laughs. "Probably because most of us came here to escape from the chaos and fighting in human space. The last thing we want is for it to follow us here. Not that I'm saying you can't tell anyone about the wormhole, but if I were you I wouldn't go spreading the news too widely either. And take a look around Hai space before you leave; you'll find that we could learn a lot from them."
units.italian: Il mercante umano ride. "Probabilmente perché la maggior parte di noi è venuta qui per sfuggire al caos e ai combattimenti dello spazio umano. L'ultima cosa che vogliamo è che ci segua fin qui. Non sto dicendo che non puoi parlarne con nessuno, ma se fossi in te non andrei a spargere troppo la notizia. E dai un'occhiata allo spazio degli Hai prima di andartene; scoprirai che potremmo imparare molto da loro."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"So I can travel anywhere I want in your territory?" you ask the Hai.|79|0
units.english: "So I can travel anywhere I want in your territory?" you ask the Hai.
units.italian: "Quindi posso viaggiare ovunque voglio nel vostro territorio?" chiedi all'Hai.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"Yes," they say, "but be careful. The north is the territory of some renegade Hai who are misled in their ways: bandits and pirates, living off what they steal from the rest of us. If you travel among them, you will not be safe."|82|0
units.english: "Yes," they say, "but be careful. The north is the territory of some renegade Hai who are misled in their ways: bandits and pirates, living off what they steal from the rest of us. If you travel among them, you will not be safe."
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "ma stai attento. Il nord è il territorio di alcuni Hai rinnegati, fuorviati nelle loro vie: banditi e pirati, che vivono di ciò che ci rubano. Se viaggi tra loro, non sarai al sicuro."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"Also," the human adds, "I've heard rumors that the 'Unfettered' Hai are trying to get human captains who land on their worlds to do some tasks for them. I'm not particularly interested in finding out what those tasks are, but if you see something suspicious happening, that might be it."|83|0
units.english: "Also," the human adds, "I've heard rumors that the 'Unfettered' Hai are trying to get human captains who land on their worlds to do some tasks for them. I'm not particularly interested in finding out what those tasks are, but if you see something suspicious happening, that might be it."
units.italian: "Inoltre," aggiunge l'umano, "ho sentito voci che gli Hai 'Slegati' stanno cercando di far svolgere qualche compito ai capitani umani che atterrano sui loro mondi. Non sono particolarmente interessato a scoprire quali siano questi compiti, ma se vedi qualcosa di sospetto, potrebbe essere quello."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"If your people are peaceful then why are the Hai from the north so hostile?" you ask the Hai.|87|0
units.english: "If your people are peaceful then why are the Hai from the north so hostile?" you ask the Hai.
units.italian: "Se il vostro popolo è pacifico, perché gli Hai del nord sono così ostili?" chiedi all'Hai.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	"I am young, and the origins of our 'Unfettered' brethren are before my time," they respond. "If you want to know more, it might be wise to find someone much older than myself to ask."|90|0
units.english: "I am young, and the origins of our 'Unfettered' brethren are before my time," they respond. "If you want to know more, it might be wise to find someone much older than myself to ask."
units.italian: "Sono giovane, e le origini dei nostri fratelli 'Slegati' precedono il mio tempo," risponde. "Se vuoi saperne di più, forse dovresti trovare qualcuno molto più vecchio di me."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|	You talk for a while longer, but do not gain much additional information except that several of their worlds are willing to sell Hai technology even to human beings. You thank them both for stopping to talk with you, and the Hai responds, "We are always glad to welcome new friends. May peace dwell in your heart until we meet again."|93|0
units.english: You talk for a while longer, but do not gain much additional information except that several of their worlds are willing to sell Hai technology even to human beings. You thank them both for stopping to talk with you, and the Hai responds, "We are always glad to welcome new friends. May peace dwell in your heart until we meet again."
units.italian: Parlate ancora per un po', ma non ottieni molte altre informazioni, se non che diversi dei loro mondi sono disposti a vendere tecnologia Hai persino agli esseri umani. Ringrazi entrambi per essersi fermati a parlare, e l'Hai risponde: "Siamo sempre lieti di accogliere nuovi amici. Che la pace dimori nel tuo cuore finché non ci rivedremo."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Hai|log|96|0
units.english: The Hai are a species of giant, intelligent rodents, who live to the north of human space. They allow any humans who discover their territory to live alongside them, and to trade with them and purchase their technology.
units.italian: Gli Hai sono una specie di giganteschi roditori intelligenti, che vivono a nord dello spazio umano. Permettono a qualsiasi umano che scopra il loro territorio di vivere al loro fianco, commerciare con loro e acquistare la loro tecnologia.

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|The Unfettered Hai say that they are the "true Hai," and seem to think that the other Hai are oppressing them, but another Hai that you spoke to said that the Unfettered Hai are simply misled. Would you like to look for someone here who can tell you more of the story?|150|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: The Unfettered Hai say that they are the "true Hai," and seem to think that the other Hai are oppressing them, but another Hai that you spoke to said that the Unfettered Hai are simply misled. Would you like to look for someone here who can tell you more of the story?
units.italian: Gli Hai Slegati dicono di essere i "veri Hai", e sembrano pensare che gli altri Hai li opprimano, ma un altro Hai con cui hai parlato ha detto che gli Slegati sono semplicemente fuorviati. Vuoi cercare qualcuno qui che ti racconti meglio la storia?

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	(Yes.)|152|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	(No.)|153|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	You find an elderly-looking Hai who is sitting on a bench watching the starships land and take off. As you approach, he says, "Hello human."|155|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: You find an elderly-looking Hai who is sitting on a bench watching the starships land and take off. As you approach, he says, "Hello human."
units.italian: Trovi un Hai dall'aria anziana seduto su una panchina, che guarda le navi spaziali atterrare e decollare. Avvicinandoti, dice: "Salve, umano."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"Hello. I've met some of the Unfettered Hai. What can you tell me about them?"|157|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "Hello. I've met some of the Unfettered Hai. What can you tell me about them?"
units.italian: "Salve. Ho incontrato alcuni Hai Slegati. Cosa può raccontarmi di loro?"

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"Hello. Can you tell me why you are at war with the other Hai who live to the north?"|158|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "Hello. Can you tell me why you are at war with the other Hai who live to the north?"
units.italian: "Salve. Può dirmi perché siete in guerra con gli altri Hai che vivono a nord?"

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	He says, "Ah, our wayward sisters and brothers to the north. You have surely seen what our society is like: safe, stable, predictable, deliberate. It suits most of us well. But there are those..."|160|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: He says, "Ah, our wayward sisters and brothers to the north. You have surely seen what our society is like: safe, stable, predictable, deliberate. It suits most of us well. But there are those..."
units.italian: Dice: "Ah, le nostre sorelle e fratelli traviati a nord. Avrai certo visto com'è la nostra società: sicura, stabile, prevedibile, ponderata. Si adatta bene alla maggior parte di noi. Ma ci sono quelli..."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	He says, "I would not call it war. We launch no raids on them. We only defend when they attack. And, we supply them with food and other things needful for life. They are not our enemies, they are just those who do not fit in. You have surely seen what our society is like: safe, stable, predictable, deliberate. It suits most of us well. But there are those..."|163|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: He says, "I would not call it war. We launch no raids on them. We only defend when they attack. And, we supply them with food and other things needful for life. They are not our enemies, they are just those who do not fit in. You have surely seen what our society is like: safe, stable, predictable, deliberate. It suits most of us well. But there are those..."
units.italian: Dice: "Non la chiamerei guerra. Non lanciamo incursioni contro di loro. Ci difendiamo solo quando attaccano. E forniamo loro cibo e altre cose necessarie alla vita. Non sono nostri nemici, sono solo quelli che non si adattano. Avrai certo visto com'è la nostra società: sicura, stabile, prevedibile, ponderata. Si adatta bene alla maggior parte di noi. Ma ci sono quelli..."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	He pauses. "No, I am telling this unfairly. I will start again. Hundreds of years ago, when I was young, our territory was raided by aliens from the east, who came in massive warships and plundered our worlds. In those days there were some Hai who were brave enough to risk their lives to defend us. The raids lasted for decades, then abruptly stopped.|165|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: He pauses. "No, I am telling this unfairly. I will start again. Hundreds of years ago, when I was young, our territory was raided by aliens from the east, who came in massive warships and plundered our worlds. In those days there were some Hai who were brave enough to risk their lives to defend us. The raids lasted for decades, then abruptly stopped.
units.italian: Si ferma. "No, la sto raccontando in modo ingiusto. Ricomincio. Centinaia di anni fa, quando ero giovane, il nostro territorio fu saccheggiato da alieni provenienti da est, che arrivarono su enormi navi da guerra e depredarono i nostri mondi. In quei giorni c'erano alcuni Hai abbastanza coraggiosi da rischiare la vita per difenderci. Le incursioni durarono decenni, poi cessarono bruscamente.

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"Most of those who had fought the invaders were glad to return to ordinary life, but there were some for whom life now seemed bland and meaningless without the excitement and chaos of war. They started colonies in the systems to the north, and fought amongst themselves, and mismanaged the land, and grew in numbers. And now their worlds cannot feed them all, and they invade us and tell stories to put blame on us for their failures."|166|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "Most of those who had fought the invaders were glad to return to ordinary life, but there were some for whom life now seemed bland and meaningless without the excitement and chaos of war. They started colonies in the systems to the north, and fought amongst themselves, and mismanaged the land, and grew in numbers. And now their worlds cannot feed them all, and they invade us and tell stories to put blame on us for their failures."
units.italian: "La maggior parte di quelli che avevano combattuto gli invasori fu felice di tornare alla vita normale, ma alcuni trovarono che la vita ora sembrasse insipida e senza senso senza l'eccitazione e il caos della guerra. Fecero colonie nei sistemi a nord, combatterono tra loro, gestirono male la terra e crebbero di numero. E ora i loro mondi non riescono a sfamarli tutti, e ci invadono raccontando storie per attribuire a noi la colpa dei loro fallimenti."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"Shouldn't they be treated with gratitude for defending you against the raiders?"|168|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "Shouldn't they be treated with gratitude for defending you against the raiders?"
units.italian: "Non dovrebbero essere trattati con gratitudine per avervi difeso dagli incursori?"

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"They said the Drak altered the Hai to make them less aggressive. Is that true?"|169|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "They said the Drak altered the Hai to make them less aggressive. Is that true?"
units.italian: "Hanno detto che i Drak hanno modificato gli Hai per renderli meno aggressivi. È vero?"

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"That's all I wanted to know. Thanks."|171|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "That's all I wanted to know. Thanks."
units.italian: "Era tutto quello che volevo sapere. Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"They were, and still should be. There will always be times when our society needs them. Only at this time, the need is not so great. There is no new frontier for them to explore, no worthy challenges for them to face. And we fear what would happen if they ventured south and gained access to the wormhole, so we must force them to stay where they are."|173|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "They were, and still should be. There will always be times when our society needs them. Only at this time, the need is not so great. There is no new frontier for them to explore, no worthy challenges for them to face. And we fear what would happen if they ventured south and gained access to the wormhole, so we must force them to stay where they are."
units.italian: "Lo erano, e dovrebbero ancora esserlo. Ci saranno sempre momenti in cui la nostra società ha bisogno di loro. Solo che in questo momento il bisogno non è così grande. Non c'è una nuova frontiera da esplorare, nessuna sfida degna da affrontare. E temiamo cosa succederebbe se si spingessero a sud e ottenessero accesso al cunicolo, quindi dobbiamo costringerli a restare dove sono."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"They said the Drak altered the Hai to make them less aggressive. Is that true?"|175|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "They said the Drak altered the Hai to make them less aggressive. Is that true?"
units.italian: "Hanno detto che i Drak hanno modificato gli Hai per renderli meno aggressivi. È vero?"

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"That's all I wanted to know. Thanks."|176|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "That's all I wanted to know. Thanks."
units.italian: "Era tutto quello che volevo sapere. Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"No," he says, "it is a story they invented, that the Hai were destined to be masters of the galaxy but the Drak and the Quarg prevented us. The story is not true. Our civilization beyond the wormhole was brought down by infighting and unwise governance. Amid the wreckage we studied and thought and argued and came to believe that we could rule a small territory with stability and peace, or hold more worlds but with constant turmoil. We chose stability, and relinquished those worlds."|179|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "No," he says, "it is a story they invented, that the Hai were destined to be masters of the galaxy but the Drak and the Quarg prevented us. The story is not true. Our civilization beyond the wormhole was brought down by infighting and unwise governance. Amid the wreckage we studied and thought and argued and came to believe that we could rule a small territory with stability and peace, or hold more worlds but with constant turmoil. We chose stability, and relinquished those worlds."
units.italian: "No," dice, "è una storia che hanno inventato, che gli Hai erano destinati a essere padroni della galassia ma i Drak e i Quarg ce lo hanno impedito. La storia non è vera. La nostra civiltà oltre il cunicolo è stata abbattuta da lotte intestine e da un governo dissennato. Tra le rovine abbiamo studiato, pensato e discusso, e siamo giunti a credere che potessimo governare un piccolo territorio con stabilità e pace, o tenere più mondi ma con continue turbolenze. Abbiamo scelto la stabilità, e rinunciato a quei mondi."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"So you don't think the Drak are keeping us all in cages?"|181|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "So you don't think the Drak are keeping us all in cages?"
units.italian: "Quindi non pensa che i Drak ci stiano tenendo tutti in gabbia?"

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	"That's all I wanted to know. Thanks."|182|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: "That's all I wanted to know. Thanks."
units.italian: "Era tutto quello che volevo sapere. Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	He thinks about the question for a while, then says, "Sometimes we make a fire for cooking food. The fire consumes much wood, and the flames are tall, too wild and hot to cook food well. Then the wood becomes coals that burn slowly with no flames or smoke, and when you gather them they are good for roasting meat or even baking bread. Perhaps each species must consume many worlds and many resources before learning to burn slowly, and the wisdom of the Drak is to allow them to do so. But when they find balance, as we did, they no longer need so much space."|184|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: He thinks about the question for a while, then says, "Sometimes we make a fire for cooking food. The fire consumes much wood, and the flames are tall, too wild and hot to cook food well. Then the wood becomes coals that burn slowly with no flames or smoke, and when you gather them they are good for roasting meat or even baking bread. Perhaps each species must consume many worlds and many resources before learning to burn slowly, and the wisdom of the Drak is to allow them to do so. But when they find balance, as we did, they no longer need so much space."
units.italian: Riflette sulla domanda per un po', poi dice: "A volte accendiamo un fuoco per cuocere il cibo. Il fuoco consuma molta legna, e le fiamme sono alte, troppo selvatiche e calde per cuocere bene il cibo. Poi la legna diventa braci che bruciano lentamente senza fiamme né fumo, e quando le raccogli sono buone per arrostire la carne o persino per cuocere il pane. Forse ogni specie deve consumare molti mondi e molte risorse prima di imparare a bruciare lentamente, e la saggezza dei Drak è permetterglielo. Ma quando trovano l'equilibrio, come abbiamo fatto noi, non hanno più bisogno di tanto spazio."

units.id: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered|	You thank him for taking time to speak with you, and say goodbye.|185|0
units.context: mission:Ask the Hai about the Unfettered
units.english: You thank him for taking time to speak with you, and say goodbye.
units.italian: Lo ringrazi per il tempo che ti ha dedicato, e ti congedi.

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|As the <ship> drops out of hyperspace, your dashboard is filled with an array of warning lights. It isn't hard to find the cause; even from this distance, the light of the wormhole is as clear as crystal, tinting everything around it a pale purple. The arms of the vortex rotate seemingly lethargically, but you know that, close up, the bands of energy that make it up must be moving several orders of magnitude faster than the top speed of your ship.|201|0
units.english: As the <ship> drops out of hyperspace, your dashboard is filled with an array of warning lights. It isn't hard to find the cause; even from this distance, the light of the wormhole is as clear as crystal, tinting everything around it a pale purple. The arms of the vortex rotate seemingly lethargically, but you know that, close up, the bands of energy that make it up must be moving several orders of magnitude faster than the top speed of your ship.
units.italian: Mentre la <ship> esce dall'iperspazio, la tua plancia si riempie di una serie di spie di avvertimento. Non è difficile trovarne la causa: anche da questa distanza, la luce del cunicolo è limpida come un cristallo, e tinge di viola pallido tutto ciò che la circonda. I bracci del vortice ruotano apparentemente con lentezza, ma sai che, da vicino, le bande di energia che lo compongono devono muoversi a velocità superiori di diversi ordini di grandezza rispetto alla velocità massima della tua nave.

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	Your sightseeing is interrupted by a hail on an encrypted frequency. You open it and are met with what you vaguely recognize as a short greeting in the Hai language.|202|0
units.english: Your sightseeing is interrupted by a hail on an encrypted frequency. You open it and are met with what you vaguely recognize as a short greeting in the Hai language.
units.italian: La tua osservazione viene interrotta da una chiamata su una frequenza criptata. La apri e ti trovi davanti quello che riconosci vagamente come un breve saluto in lingua Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"Could you repeat that?"|204|0
units.english: "Could you repeat that?"
units.italian: "Può ripetere?"

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"Sorry, I don't speak Hai."|205|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't speak Hai."
units.italian: "Mi scusi, non parlo l'Hai."

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	You receive a reply in the form of a hearty chuckle. "My bad, friend," the Hai hailing you says. "Used to be that anyone who grew up in Hai space knew Hai, but I guess that isn't really true anymore, what with Greenwater and such.|206|0
units.english: You receive a reply in the form of a hearty chuckle. "My bad, friend," the Hai hailing you says. "Used to be that anyone who grew up in Hai space knew Hai, but I guess that isn't really true anymore, what with Greenwater and such.
units.italian: Ricevi una risposta sotto forma di una risata di cuore. "Colpa mia, amico," dice l'Hai che ti chiama. "Un tempo chiunque fosse cresciuto nello spazio degli Hai conosceva l'Hai, ma immagino che ormai non sia più così, con Greenwater e tutto il resto.

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"Anyway, back on topic. You've probably heard this a hundred times, but it bears repeating: Unless you're certain that the other person already knows, don't talk about the Hai, Hai space, or any Hai technology. Got it?"|207|0
units.english: "Anyway, back on topic. You've probably heard this a hundred times, but it bears repeating: Unless you're certain that the other person already knows, don't talk about the Hai, Hai space, or any Hai technology. Got it?"
units.italian: "Comunque, torniamo al punto. Probabilmente l'avrai sentito cento volte, ma vale la pena ripeterlo: a meno che tu non sia certo che l'altra persona lo sappia già, non parlare degli Hai, dello spazio degli Hai o di qualsiasi tecnologia Hai. Chiaro?"

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"Got it."|209|0
units.english: "Got it."
units.italian: "Chiaro."

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"Why do I have to lie?"|211|0
units.english: "Why do I have to lie?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrei mentire?"

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	The Hai lets out another laugh, this time more nervous. "You know, there's some people out there who'd be able to say what you just did with a straight face."|212|0
units.english: The Hai lets out another laugh, this time more nervous. "You know, there's some people out there who'd be able to say what you just did with a straight face."
units.italian: L'Hai ride di nuovo, questa volta più nervosamente. "Sa, là fuori c'è gente capace di dire quello che hai appena detto con un'espressione impassibile."

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"Alright, I'll be on my way."|214|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll be on my way."
units.italian: "Va bene, me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"I'm serious."|216|0
units.english: "I'm serious."
units.italian: "Faccio sul serio."

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	While you can't see your conversation partner over the commlink, you get the feeling that they'd be pinching the bridge of their nose right now. "A few decades ago, you'd be hard-pressed to find a captain who'd even consider revealing the existence of the Hai. Nowadays, it feels like even Hai are clamoring to go public, regardless of the turmoil it would bring.|217|0
units.english: While you can't see your conversation partner over the commlink, you get the feeling that they'd be pinching the bridge of their nose right now. "A few decades ago, you'd be hard-pressed to find a captain who'd even consider revealing the existence of the Hai. Nowadays, it feels like even Hai are clamoring to go public, regardless of the turmoil it would bring.
units.italian: Anche se non vedi il tuo interlocutore attraverso il communicatore, hai la sensazione che in questo momento si stia pizzicando il naso. "Qualche decennio fa, era difficile trovare un capitano che solo considerasse di rivelare l'esistenza degli Hai. Oggi sembra che persino gli Hai stiano facendo pressioni per uscire allo scoperto, senza badare al caos che porterebbe.

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"But this isn't just about protecting Hai space. There are groups who have more than enough motive and ability to cover up any attempts of stirring chaos in human space, including anybody looking to expose the existence of a yet-unknown sapient species.|218|0
units.english: "But this isn't just about protecting Hai space. There are groups who have more than enough motive and ability to cover up any attempts of stirring chaos in human space, including anybody looking to expose the existence of a yet-unknown sapient species.
units.italian: "Ma non si tratta solo di proteggere lo spazio degli Hai. Ci sono gruppi con più che sufficienti motivi e capacità per insabbiare qualsiasi tentativo di seminare il caos nello spazio umano, compreso chiunque voglia rivelare l'esistenza di una specie senziente ancora sconosciuta.

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"Anyway, stay safe out there." The hail cuts off.|219|0
units.english: "Anyway, stay safe out there." The hail cuts off.
units.italian: "Comunque, stai al sicuro là fuori." La chiamata si interrompe.

units.id: mission:Hai Waypoint Warning|	"Glad to hear it. See you around, Captain." The hail cuts off.|222|0
units.english: "Glad to hear it. See you around, Captain." The hail cuts off.
units.italian: "Sono contento di sentirlo. Ci vediamo in giro, capitano." La chiamata si interrompe.

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|log|244|0
units.english: Got spoken to by a Hai merchant at a spaceport bar after a firefight. Was warned about the factions among Hai merchants and the danger of getting in trouble if sympathizers to the Unfettered get caught in the cross-fire when fighting the Unfettered themselves. Learned that, as an outsider, "self-defense" is not an adequate argument where the deaths of Hai citizens are involved.
units.italian: Sono stato avvicinato da un mercante Hai in un bar dello spazioporto dopo uno scontro a fuoco. Mi ha avvertito delle fazioni tra i mercanti Hai e del pericolo di finire nei guai se i simpatizzanti degli Slegati restano coinvolti nel fuoco incrociato quando si combattono gli Slegati stessi. Ho imparato che, da straniero, la "legittima difesa" non è un argomento adeguato quando sono coinvolte morti di cittadini Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|As you sit in a spaceport bar waiting for the food that you've ordered, a Hai unceremoniously pulls up a chair opposite you and takes a seat. He looks to be a merchant, and one who has seen more than a few things besides. He squints at you before speaking, "You are Captain <last>, are you not?"|247|0
units.english: As you sit in a spaceport bar waiting for the food that you've ordered, a Hai unceremoniously pulls up a chair opposite you and takes a seat. He looks to be a merchant, and one who has seen more than a few things besides. He squints at you before speaking, "You are Captain <last>, are you not?"
units.italian: Mentre sei seduto in un bar dello spazioporto in attesa del cibo che hai ordinato, un Hai avvicina una sedia senza tanti complimenti e si siede di fronte a te. Sembra un mercante, e uno che ha visto più di qualche cosa. Ti squadra prima di parlare: "Lei è il capitano <last>, giusto?"

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"That would be me."|249|0
units.english: "That would be me."
units.italian: "Sì, sono io."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"I think you have the wrong captain."|251|0
units.english: "I think you have the wrong captain."
units.italian: "Credo che abbiate sbagliato capitano."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	He slaps a device on the table, and a small holographic projection of your face springs up and begins rotating around. "No, I think not."|252|0
units.english: He slaps a device on the table, and a small holographic projection of your face springs up and begins rotating around. "No, I think not."
units.italian: Sbatte un dispositivo sul tavolo, e una piccola proiezione olografica del tuo volto scatta su e comincia a ruotare. "No, non credo proprio."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	He heaves a sigh. "You've been fighting the Unfettered, you see, and there are some Hai that don't take too kindly to that. They view you as an outsider sticking your nose into Hai internal politics. Some of those are what we merchants like to call Sympathizers, and they can get a little carried away with themselves and fire off a few shots if they see someone like yourself getting a little too gun-happy where the Unfettered are concerned."|254|0
units.english: He heaves a sigh. "You've been fighting the Unfettered, you see, and there are some Hai that don't take too kindly to that. They view you as an outsider sticking your nose into Hai internal politics. Some of those are what we merchants like to call Sympathizers, and they can get a little carried away with themselves and fire off a few shots if they see someone like yourself getting a little too gun-happy where the Unfettered are concerned."
units.italian: Emette un sospiro. "Vede, lei ha combattuto gli Slegati, e ci sono alcuni Hai a cui questo non va giù. La vedono come un estraneo che ficca il naso nella politica interna degli Hai. Alcuni di loro sono quelli che noi mercanti chiamiamo Simpatizzanti, e possono lasciarsi prendere un po' la mano e sparare qualche colpo se vedono uno come lei diventare un po' troppo generoso con il grilletto quando si tratta degli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	With a wave of his hand he indicates the spaceport around you. "You might have potentially noticed some difficulty landing. You see, because there are lots of people who don't like outsiders putting their noses in where they're not wanted, if you happen to shoot back and accidentally destroy a Sympathizer's ship, the authorities don't much care who shot first. There are enough of those opinions to ensure that if you shoot down a Sympathizer, it is treated no differently than if you shot down any other Hai merchant. The security forces will treat it the same.|255|0
units.english: With a wave of his hand he indicates the spaceport around you. "You might have potentially noticed some difficulty landing. You see, because there are lots of people who don't like outsiders putting their noses in where they're not wanted, if you happen to shoot back and accidentally destroy a Sympathizer's ship, the authorities don't much care who shot first. There are enough of those opinions to ensure that if you shoot down a Sympathizer, it is treated no differently than if you shot down any other Hai merchant. The security forces will treat it the same.
units.italian: Con un gesto della mano indica lo spazioporto intorno a voi. "Forse avrà notato qualche difficoltà ad atterrare. Vede, siccome ci sono molte persone a cui non piace che gli estranei ficchino il naso dove non sono voluti, se le capita di rispondere al fuoco e distruggere per sbaglio la nave di un Simpatizzante, le autorità non si preoccupano molto di chi ha sparato per primo. Ci sono abbastanza opinioni del genere da garantire che, se abbatte un Simpatizzante, venga trattato non diversamente da come se avesse abbattuto qualsiasi altro mercante Hai. Le forze di sicurezza lo tratteranno allo stesso modo.

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"Now the merchants, we're a different matter. It is a topic of great and ongoing debate among us, and some people are less offended when you shoot down someone they've been arguing with. Everyone has friends on all sides though, so you should watch yourself nonetheless. Sympathizers may become upset enough to shoot at you anywhere they see you, but the simple fact of the matter is that, if you retaliate against a Hai, any Hai, it'll upset someone and count against you. Even if that Hai was a Sympathizer, and even if they shot first."|256|0
units.english: "Now the merchants, we're a different matter. It is a topic of great and ongoing debate among us, and some people are less offended when you shoot down someone they've been arguing with. Everyone has friends on all sides though, so you should watch yourself nonetheless. Sympathizers may become upset enough to shoot at you anywhere they see you, but the simple fact of the matter is that, if you retaliate against a Hai, any Hai, it'll upset someone and count against you. Even if that Hai was a Sympathizer, and even if they shot first."
units.italian: "Quanto ai mercanti, è un'altra questione. È un tema di grande e continuo dibattito tra noi, e alcuni si offendono meno quando abbatte qualcuno con cui stavano discutendo. Però tutti hanno amici da tutte le parti, quindi dovrebbe comunque stare attento. I Simpatizzanti possono arrabbiarsi abbastanza da spararle ovunque la vedano, ma il fatto semplice è che, se reagisce contro un Hai, qualsiasi Hai, questo farà arrabbiare qualcuno e le sarà messo sul conto. Anche se quell'Hai era un Simpatizzante, e anche se ha sparato per primo."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	He looks at you very seriously to make sure what he's said has sunk in.|257|0
units.english: He looks at you very seriously to make sure what he's said has sunk in.
units.italian: Ti guarda molto seriamente per assicurarsi che quello che ha detto sia stato assimilato.

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"I understand, thank you for warning me."|261|0
units.english: "I understand, thank you for warning me."
units.italian: "Ho capito, la ringrazio per l'avvertimento."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"Why should I get in trouble for defending myself against Sympathizers?"|263|0
units.english: "Why should I get in trouble for defending myself against Sympathizers?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrei finire nei guai per essermi difeso dai Simpatizzanti?"

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|label|265|0
units.english: low reputation
units.italian: low reputation

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"I understand that I've stepped on some toes."|267|0
units.english: "I understand that I've stepped on some toes."
units.italian: "Capisco di aver pestato qualche piede."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"How could I be in trouble for defending myself against Sympathizers?"|269|0
units.english: "How could I be in trouble for defending myself against Sympathizers?"
units.italian: "Come potrei finire nei guai per essermi difeso dai Simpatizzanti?"

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	He shrugs. "You should try not to impart human ethical standards onto Hai. The simple fact of the matter is that they are citizens, and you are not.|273|0
units.english: He shrugs. "You should try not to impart human ethical standards onto Hai. The simple fact of the matter is that they are citizens, and you are not.
units.italian: Scrolla le spalle. "Dovrebbe cercare di non applicare gli standard etici umani agli Hai. Il fatto semplice è che loro sono cittadini, e lei no.

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"When a report is made that you have destroyed the vessel of a Hai citizen, it is up to the local security staff to verify the chain of events. If they report it was your fault, then it was your fault, unless you can challenge that in a court. However, you are not a citizen, so the security apparatus can simply brand you as a pirate and prevent you from ever gaining access to a court to challenge it in the first place. Even if you managed to do so, you're a captain; your business is in space. You would be grounded for months to work through the court proceedings to challenge it.|274|0
units.english: "When a report is made that you have destroyed the vessel of a Hai citizen, it is up to the local security staff to verify the chain of events. If they report it was your fault, then it was your fault, unless you can challenge that in a court. However, you are not a citizen, so the security apparatus can simply brand you as a pirate and prevent you from ever gaining access to a court to challenge it in the first place. Even if you managed to do so, you're a captain; your business is in space. You would be grounded for months to work through the court proceedings to challenge it.
units.italian: "Quando viene presentato un rapporto secondo cui hai distrutto la nave di un cittadino Hai, spetta al personale di sicurezza locale verificare la catena degli eventi. Se riferiscono che è stata colpa tua, allora è stata colpa tua, a meno che tu non riesca a contestarlo in tribunale. Tuttavia non sei un cittadino, quindi l'apparato di sicurezza può semplicemente bollarti come pirata e impedirti del tutto di accedere a un tribunale per contestarlo. E anche se ci riuscissi, sei un capitano; i tuoi affari sono nello spazio. Resti a terra per mesi per portare avanti il procedimento giudiziario.

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"Whether you believe it is right or not, it is simply the reality of the situation. You must manage your guns and your reputation carefully where interactions with the Unfettered are concerned."|275|0
units.english: "Whether you believe it is right or not, it is simply the reality of the situation. You must manage your guns and your reputation carefully where interactions with the Unfettered are concerned."
units.italian: "Che tu lo ritenga giusto o no, è semplicemente la realtà della situazione. Devi gestire con cura le tue armi e la tua reputazione quando si tratta di interazioni con gli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"You have gotten yourself in trouble, Captain."|286|0
units.english: "You have gotten yourself in trouble, Captain."
units.italian: "Ti sei messo nei guai, capitano."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|label|287|0
units.english: explained trouble
units.italian: explained trouble

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	He slides a data stick across to you. "Fortunately for you, in this case, I happened to see the event, and have argued that you did not know what you were getting into. This stick contains the security report file which indicates that you have been given a warning... keep this for your records; Hai Security certainly will. There will not be future warnings."|293|0
units.english: He slides a data stick across to you. "Fortunately for you, in this case, I happened to see the event, and have argued that you did not know what you were getting into. This stick contains the security report file which indicates that you have been given a warning... keep this for your records; Hai Security certainly will. There will not be future warnings."
units.italian: Ti fa scivolare sul tavolo una chiavetta dati. "Per tua fortuna, in questo caso ho assistito all'evento, e ho sostenuto che non sapevi in cosa ti stavi cacciando. Questa chiavetta contiene il file del rapporto di sicurezza che indica che ti è stato dato un avvertimento... conservalo per i tuoi archivi; la Sicurezza Hai lo farà di certo. Non ci saranno avvertimenti futuri."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|label|295|0
units.english: less trouble
units.italian: less trouble

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	"So far, you have been lucky. Hai Security has taken your history into account, and decided your recent activities are within the tolerable range of responses to the hostile situations you have got yourself into..." He slides a data stick across to you. "Nevertheless, this is a copy of the file on you that states you have now been advised of the situation. If you now proceed to upset Hai Security, they will not provide you with a warning."|297|0
units.english: "So far, you have been lucky. Hai Security has taken your history into account, and decided your recent activities are within the tolerable range of responses to the hostile situations you have got yourself into..." He slides a data stick across to you. "Nevertheless, this is a copy of the file on you that states you have now been advised of the situation. If you now proceed to upset Hai Security, they will not provide you with a warning."
units.italian: "Finora sei stato fortunato. La Sicurezza Hai ha tenuto conto della tua storia e ha deciso che le tue attività recenti rientrano nella gamma tollerabile di risposte alle situazioni ostili in cui ti sei cacciato..." Ti fa scivolare sul tavolo una chiavetta dati. "Tuttavia questa è una copia del fascicolo che ti riguarda, in cui si afferma che ora ti è stata illustrata la situazione. Se adesso contrarierai la Sicurezza Hai, non ti daranno un avvertimento."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	The waitress arrives with your food, and the merchant stands up. "Good luck, Captain. If you get into trouble, I recommend picking up some jobs to take aid supplies to the Unfettered, if you can manage that without shooting anyone..."|300|0
units.english: The waitress arrives with your food, and the merchant stands up. "Good luck, Captain. If you get into trouble, I recommend picking up some jobs to take aid supplies to the Unfettered, if you can manage that without shooting anyone..."
units.italian: La cameriera arriva con il tuo cibo, e il mercante si alza. "Buona fortuna, capitano. Se finisci nei guai, ti consiglio di prendere qualche incarico per portare rifornimenti di aiuto agli Slegati, se riesci a farlo senza sparare a nessuno..."

units.id: mission:Hai Sympathizer Warning|	With a nod, he leaves you to your meal.|301|0
units.english: With a nod, he leaves you to your meal.
units.italian: Con un cenno del capo, ti lascia al tuo pasto.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|description|309|0
units.english: Bring Elliot home to his family on <destination>. Elliot ran away from his family as a teenager and hasn't seen them in almost six years.
units.italian: Riporta Elliot a casa dalla sua famiglia su <destination>. Elliot è scappato dalla famiglia da adolescente e non li vede da quasi sei anni.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|You are stopped by a human in the <origin> marketplace. He takes off his hat and asks, "You're from the outside, aren't you?"|325|0
units.english: You are stopped by a human in the <origin> marketplace. He takes off his hat and asks, "You're from the outside, aren't you?"
units.italian: Vieni fermato da un umano nel mercato di <origin>. Si toglie il cappello e chiede: "Lei viene da fuori, vero?"

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Yes, I am."|327|0
units.english: "Yes, I am."
units.italian: "Sì, è così."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"What do you mean 'the outside?'"|329|0
units.english: "What do you mean 'the outside?'"
units.italian: "Che cosa intende con 'fuori'?"

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Outside of Hai space. You don't look quite like most humans who live here, unless there's some new fashion trend going on that I don't know about."|331|0
units.english: "Outside of Hai space. You don't look quite like most humans who live here, unless there's some new fashion trend going on that I don't know about."
units.italian: "Fuori dallo spazio degli Hai. Non sembra proprio come la maggior parte degli umani che vivono qui, a meno che non ci sia qualche nuova moda che io non conosco."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Oh, yes. I do come from outside."|333|0
units.english: "Oh, yes. I do come from outside."
units.italian: "Oh, sì. Vengo da fuori."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|You are stopped by a human in the marketplace of <origin>. He takes off his hat and asks, "You wouldn't happen to be a captain from the outside, would you?"|337|0
units.english: You are stopped by a human in the marketplace of <origin>. He takes off his hat and asks, "You wouldn't happen to be a captain from the outside, would you?"
units.italian: Vieni fermato da un umano nel mercato di <origin>. Si toglie il cappello e chiede: "Non è per caso un capitano che viene da fuori?"

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"No, I grew up here."|339|0
units.english: "No, I grew up here."
units.italian: "No, sono cresciuto qui."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Why? Do you need to go somewhere?"|340|0
units.english: "Why? Do you need to go somewhere?"
units.italian: "Perché? Deve andare da qualche parte?"

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	He sighs. "I figured as such. You can usually tell when people aren't from here by their clothing."|343|0
units.english: He sighs. "I figured as such. You can usually tell when people aren't from here by their clothing."
units.italian: Sospira. "Immaginavo. Di solito si capisce che le persone non sono di qui dai vestiti."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	The man thinks for a moment. "Would it be too much of a hassle for you to take a trip to human space?"|344|0
units.english: The man thinks for a moment. "Would it be too much of a hassle for you to take a trip to human space?"
units.italian: L'uomo riflette un momento. "Sarebbe un problema per lei fare un viaggio nello spazio umano?"

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"I'd be happy to take you there."|346|0
units.english: "I'd be happy to take you there."
units.italian: "Ti ci porterei volentieri."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Sorry, but no. You'll have to find another captain."|347|0
units.english: "Sorry, but no. You'll have to find another captain."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma no. Dovrai trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Good. My name is Elliot." You introduce yourself to Elliot and shake hands.|351|0
units.english: "Good. My name is Elliot." You introduce yourself to Elliot and shake hands.
units.italian: "Bene. Mi chiamo Elliot." Ti presenti a Elliot e vi stringete la mano.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"I do. My name is Elliot." You introduce yourself to Elliot and shake hands.|355|0
units.english: "I do. My name is Elliot." You introduce yourself to Elliot and shake hands.
units.italian: "Sì. Mi chiamo Elliot." Ti presenti a Elliot e vi stringete la mano.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Can you take me to <destination>?" Elliot asks.|358|0
units.english: "Can you take me to <destination>?" Elliot asks.
units.italian: "Puoi portarmi su <destination>?" chiede Elliot.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"That's all the way in the Dirt Belt," you say. "Why do you want to go that far?"|359|0
units.english: "That's all the way in the Dirt Belt," you say. "Why do you want to go that far?"
units.italian: "È dall'altra parte, nella Fascia Polverosa," dici. "Perché vuoi andare così lontano?"

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	Elliot looks down at the ground for a second and takes a deep breath while gripping his hat in his hands. "You see, I haven't lived here all my life. I was born on <planet> to a poor farming family. Most of my days were spent working on the farm, which I hated with a passion. One day I just got fed up with things and I ran away.|360|0
units.english: Elliot looks down at the ground for a second and takes a deep breath while gripping his hat in his hands. "You see, I haven't lived here all my life. I was born on <planet> to a poor farming family. Most of my days were spent working on the farm, which I hated with a passion. One day I just got fed up with things and I ran away.
units.italian: Elliot guarda a terra per un secondo e fa un respiro profondo stringendo il cappello tra le mani. "Vede, non ho vissuto qui tutta la vita. Sono nato su <planet>, in una famiglia di poveri agricoltori. Passavo la maggior parte delle giornate a lavorare nella fattoria, cosa che odiavo con tutto me stesso. Un giorno mi sono stufato e sono scappato.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"I ran away from home to the spaceport city and snuck my way into the cargo hold of a freighter. The captain didn't open the cargo hold for three weeks while I stayed in it. Lucky for me the freighter was transporting food, so I had plenty to eat.|361|0
units.english: "I ran away from home to the spaceport city and snuck my way into the cargo hold of a freighter. The captain didn't open the cargo hold for three weeks while I stayed in it. Lucky for me the freighter was transporting food, so I had plenty to eat.
units.italian: "Sono scappato da casa verso la città dello spazioporto e mi sono intrufolato nella stiva di un mercantile. Il capitano non ha aperto la stiva per tre settimane, mentre io restavo dentro. Per fortuna il mercantile trasportava cibo, quindi avevo da mangiare in abbondanza.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"When the cargo hold doors finally opened, I ran out as fast as I could, only to run back in at the sight of a group of Hai. I had no idea where I was at the time, but I've been living here ever since. That was when I was thirteen, nearly five years ago now."|362|0
units.english: "When the cargo hold doors finally opened, I ran out as fast as I could, only to run back in at the sight of a group of Hai. I had no idea where I was at the time, but I've been living here ever since. That was when I was thirteen, nearly five years ago now."
units.italian: "Quando le porte della stiva si sono finalmente aperte, sono corso fuori il più in fretta possibile, per poi rientrare di corsa alla vista di un gruppo di Hai. Non avevo idea di dove fossi, ma da allora vivo qui. Avevo tredici anni, quasi cinque anni fa ormai."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	Elliot looks down at the ground again and wipes a tear from the corner of his eye.|363|0
units.english: Elliot looks down at the ground again and wipes a tear from the corner of his eye.
units.italian: Elliot guarda di nuovo a terra e si asciuga una lacrima dall'angolo dell'occhio.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Alright, I'll take you to <planet>."|365|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll take you to <planet>."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti porto su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"And you finally want to go back home?"|367|0
units.english: "And you finally want to go back home?"
units.italian: "E finalmente vuoi tornare a casa?"

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Sorry, but I'm not able to take you that far."|368|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not able to take you that far."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non posso portarti così lontano."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Yes. I've thought a lot about it lately. I want to see my family again."|371|0
units.english: "Yes. I've thought a lot about it lately. I want to see my family again."
units.italian: "Sì. Ci ho pensato molto, ultimamente. Voglio rivedere la mia famiglia."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Alright, I'll take you to <planet>."|373|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll take you to <planet>."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti porto su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Sorry, but I'm not able to take you that far."|375|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not able to take you that far."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non posso portarti così lontano."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"I understand," Elliot says. "I'll just try and find someone else to help me. Goodbye, <first>."|378|0
units.english: "I understand," Elliot says. "I'll just try and find someone else to help me. Goodbye, <first>."
units.italian: "Capisco," dice Elliot. "Cercherò qualcun altro che mi aiuti. Addio, <first>."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	You lead Elliot to your ship and show him to a bunk room. After leaving Elliot there, you wonder if his family is still even on <planet> anymore.|382|0
units.english: You lead Elliot to your ship and show him to a bunk room. After leaving Elliot there, you wonder if his family is still even on <planet> anymore.
units.italian: Porti Elliot alla tua nave e gli mostri una cabina con le cuccette. Dopo averlo lasciato lì, ti chiedi se la sua famiglia sia ancora su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|dialog|386|0
units.english: You look for Elliot, but realize that he took a ride on one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Cerchi Elliot, ma ti rendi conto che è salito su una delle tue scorte! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|Elliot thanks you for bringing him to <planet> and hands you <payment>. He flags down a taxi just outside the spaceport, but before entering the taxi he turns back to you.|390|0
units.english: Elliot thanks you for bringing him to <planet> and hands you <payment>. He flags down a taxi just outside the spaceport, but before entering the taxi he turns back to you.
units.italian: Elliot ti ringrazia per averlo portato su <planet> e ti consegna <payment>. Ferma un taxi appena fuori dallo spazioporto, ma prima di entrare si volta verso di te.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Do you want to come with me? I'd love for you to meet my family. They'll want to meet you when I tell them how I got back."|391|0
units.english: "Do you want to come with me? I'd love for you to meet my family. They'll want to meet you when I tell them how I got back."
units.italian: "Vuoi venire con me? Mi piacerebbe che conoscessi la mia famiglia. Vorranno conoscerti quando racconterò come sono tornato."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Sorry, I have other places to be. Good luck."|393|0
units.english: "Sorry, I have other places to be. Good luck."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ho altri posti dove devo andare. Buona fortuna."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Sure. I've come with you this far."|394|0
units.english: "Sure. I've come with you this far."
units.italian: "Certo. Sono venuto fin qui con te."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"I understand. Thanks again, <first>. I'll always owe you."|397|0
units.english: "I understand. Thanks again, <first>. I'll always owe you."
units.italian: "Capisco. Grazie ancora, <first>. Ti dovrò sempre qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	Elliot gets into the taxi, which drives off toward the seemingly endless farmlands outside of the spaceport city.|398|0
units.english: Elliot gets into the taxi, which drives off toward the seemingly endless farmlands outside of the spaceport city.
units.italian: Elliot sale sul taxi, che parte verso le campagne apparentemente sconfinate fuori dalla città dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	The view for nearly the entire three hour drive is of hills and farmland with the occasional building or wild animal. Elliot shakes as the taxi approaches the house from the driveway. "I'm wondering if they still even live here," he says nervously.|402|0
units.english: The view for nearly the entire three hour drive is of hills and farmland with the occasional building or wild animal. Elliot shakes as the taxi approaches the house from the driveway. "I'm wondering if they still even live here," he says nervously.
units.italian: Per quasi tutto il viaggio di tre ore la vista è di colline e terre coltivate, con qualche edificio o animale selvatico ogni tanto. Elliot trema quando il taxi si avvicina alla casa dal vialetto. "Mi chiedo se vivano ancora qui," dice nervoso.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	No one comes out of the house when the taxi stops. You walk up to the front door with Elliot and a middle-aged woman answers the door with a mug of coffee and a bewildered look on her face.|403|0
units.english: No one comes out of the house when the taxi stops. You walk up to the front door with Elliot and a middle-aged woman answers the door with a mug of coffee and a bewildered look on her face.
units.italian: Nessuno esce dalla casa quando il taxi si ferma. Cammini fino alla porta d'ingresso con Elliot e una donna di mezza età apre con una tazza di caffè e un'espressione smarrita.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Can I help you?" the woman asks.|404|0
units.english: "Can I help you?" the woman asks.
units.italian: "Posso aiutarvi?" chiede la donna.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	Elliot looks over at you with a big smile on his face. "Yes you can, mom," he says to her. The woman's face lights up with joy and she begins jumping up and down, spilling coffee from her mug.|405|0
units.english: Elliot looks over at you with a big smile on his face. "Yes you can, mom," he says to her. The woman's face lights up with joy and she begins jumping up and down, spilling coffee from her mug.
units.italian: Elliot ti guarda con un gran sorriso. "Sì che puoi, mamma," le dice. Il volto della donna si illumina di gioia e comincia a saltellare, rovesciando caffè dalla tazza.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Oh Elliot, I can't believe it!" Elliot's mom puts down her mug and leaps out the door to hug him. "Jackson! Sarah! Abby! Sean! Victor! Elliot is here!" Elliot's entire family comes out from the house and greets him, asking dozens of questions about where and how he's been and why he left.|406|0
units.english: "Oh Elliot, I can't believe it!" Elliot's mom puts down her mug and leaps out the door to hug him. "Jackson! Sarah! Abby! Sean! Victor! Elliot is here!" Elliot's entire family comes out from the house and greets him, asking dozens of questions about where and how he's been and why he left.
units.italian: "Oh Elliot, non ci credo!" La madre di Elliot posa la tazza e salta fuori dalla porta per abbracciarlo. "Jackson! Sarah! Abby! Sean! Victor! Elliot è qui!" Tutta la famiglia di Elliot esce di casa e lo saluta, facendogli dozzine di domande su dove sia stato, come e perché se ne sia andato.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	Elliot introduces you to his family, who thank you for bringing Elliot home. Victor, who was only seven years old when Elliot left and is now twelve, asks you question after question about being a pilot, sometimes asking new questions before you can even answer the old one.|407|0
units.english: Elliot introduces you to his family, who thank you for bringing Elliot home. Victor, who was only seven years old when Elliot left and is now twelve, asks you question after question about being a pilot, sometimes asking new questions before you can even answer the old one.
units.italian: Elliot ti presenta alla sua famiglia, che ti ringrazia per averlo riportato a casa. Victor, che aveva solo sette anni quando Elliot se n'è andato e ora ne ha dodici, ti fa domanda dopo domanda sul mestiere del pilota, a volte ponendone una nuova prima che tu possa rispondere alla precedente.

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	"Are you going back to the spaceport, <first>?" the taxi driver yells from the driveway. "I need to get back to the city as soon as I can."|408|0
units.english: "Are you going back to the spaceport, <first>?" the taxi driver yells from the driveway. "I need to get back to the city as soon as I can."
units.italian: "Torna allo spazioporto, <first>?" grida il tassista dal vialetto. "Devo tornare in città il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:Returning Home|	You say goodbye to Elliot and to his family. "Thanks again, <first>," Elliot says. "I'll always owe you."|409|0
units.english: You say goodbye to Elliot and to his family. "Thanks again, <first>," Elliot says. "I'll always owe you."
units.italian: Saluti Elliot e la sua famiglia. "Grazie ancora, <first>," dice Elliot. "Ti dovrò sempre qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|description|432|0
units.english: Bring a Hai child who hid in your cargo hold back to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta su <destination> un bambino Hai che si è nascosto nella tua stiva.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|The "Check Cargo" light for your ship begins blinking when you land, meaning that a cargo crate may have come loose in flight. You shut off the ship's engines and walk to the cargo hold.|441|0
units.english: The "Check Cargo" light for your ship begins blinking when you land, meaning that a cargo crate may have come loose in flight. You shut off the ship's engines and walk to the cargo hold.
units.italian: La spia "Controlla carico" della nave comincia a lampeggiare quando atterri, il che significa che una cassa di carico potrebbe essersi staccata in volo. Spegni i motori e vai alla stiva.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	You check every cargo crate in the hold, but can't find anything wrong. Right as you decide to leave, one of the smaller crates begins rocking back and forth.|442|0
units.english: You check every cargo crate in the hold, but can't find anything wrong. Right as you decide to leave, one of the smaller crates begins rocking back and forth.
units.italian: Controlli ogni cassa nella stiva, ma non trovi nulla di strano. Proprio quando decidi di andartene, una delle casse più piccole comincia a dondolare avanti e indietro.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	You hear a voice come from the crate, but it is not a language you understand. The voice continues to speak, and you recognize it as the Hai language.|446|0
units.english: You hear a voice come from the crate, but it is not a language you understand. The voice continues to speak, and you recognize it as the Hai language.
units.italian: Senti una voce provenire dalla cassa, ma non è una lingua che capisci. La voce continua a parlare, e riconosci che è la lingua Hai.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	(Open the crate.)|448|0
units.english: (Open the crate.)
units.italian: (Apri la cassa.)

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	You open the crate and are met face to face with a Hai child. You aren't sure how old they are, but they look to be about the size of a one-year-old human child. They try to communicate with you, but begins to cry when they see the confused look on your face.|449|0
units.english: You open the crate and are met face to face with a Hai child. You aren't sure how old they are, but they look to be about the size of a one-year-old human child. They try to communicate with you, but begins to cry when they see the confused look on your face.
units.italian: Apri la cassa e ti trovi faccia a faccia con un bambino Hai. Non sei sicuro di quanti anni abbia, ma sembra grande più o meno come un bambino umano di un anno. Cerca di comunicare con te, ma comincia a piangere quando vede la tua espressione confusa.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	"Don't cry, little guy."|451|0
units.english: "Don't cry, little guy."
units.italian: "Non piangere, piccolo."

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	(Pick up the Hai.)|453|0
units.english: (Pick up the Hai.)
units.italian: (Prendi in braccio l'Hai.)

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	The child waves its hands around when you try to pick them up, making it impossible to grab on to. After waiting for a few minutes, the child finally calms down, eventually going to sleep in the crate.|455|0
units.english: The child waves its hands around when you try to pick them up, making it impossible to grab on to. After waiting for a few minutes, the child finally calms down, eventually going to sleep in the crate.
units.italian: Il bambino agita le mani quando cerchi di prenderlo, rendendo impossibile afferrarlo. Dopo qualche minuto di attesa, il bambino si calma, e alla fine si addormenta nella cassa.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	The child begins to cry even louder than before. After waiting for a few minutes, the child finally calms down, eventually going to sleep in the crate.|459|0
units.english: The child begins to cry even louder than before. After waiting for a few minutes, the child finally calms down, eventually going to sleep in the crate.
units.italian: Il bambino comincia a piangere ancora più forte di prima. Dopo qualche minuto di attesa, si calma, e alla fine si addormenta nella cassa.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	You hear a voice come from the crate, and surprisingly your Hai translator begins speaking. "Let me out! I want to go home!"|463|0
units.english: You hear a voice come from the crate, and surprisingly your Hai translator begins speaking. "Let me out! I want to go home!"
units.italian: Senti una voce provenire dalla cassa, e con tua sorpresa il tuo traduttore Hai comincia a parlare. "Fammi uscire! Voglio andare a casa!"

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	(Open the crate.)|465|0
units.english: (Open the crate.)
units.italian: (Apri la cassa.)

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	You open the crate and are met eye to eye with a Hai child. You aren't sure how old they are, but it looks to be about the size of a one-year-old human child. "I want my mommy!" they say as its eyes begin to tear up.|466|0
units.english: You open the crate and are met eye to eye with a Hai child. You aren't sure how old they are, but it looks to be about the size of a one-year-old human child. "I want my mommy!" they say as its eyes begin to tear up.
units.italian: Apri la cassa e ti trovi occhio a occhio con un bambino Hai. Non sei sicuro di quanti anni abbia, ma sembra grande più o meno come un bambino umano di un anno. "Voglio la mia mamma!" dice, mentre i suoi occhi cominciano a riempirsi di lacrime.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	"Where's your mommy?"|468|0
units.english: "Where's your mommy?"
units.italian: "Dov'è la tua mamma?"

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	"Don't cry, little guy."|469|0
units.english: "Don't cry, little guy."
units.italian: "Non piangere, piccolo."
