units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	The child looks surprised when your translation device speaks to them in Hai. "Take me home!" they yell back at you. You attempt to find out where the child's home is, but they continue to cry for its mother without giving any important information.|470|0
units.english: The child looks surprised when your translation device speaks to them in Hai. "Take me home!" they yell back at you. You attempt to find out where the child's home is, but they continue to cry for its mother without giving any important information.
units.italian: Il bambino sembra sorpreso quando il tuo dispositivo di traduzione gli parla in Hai. "Portami a casa!" ti grida. Cerchi di scoprire dove sia la casa del bambino, ma lui continua a piangere per la madre senza dare informazioni utili.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|	This child must have somehow gotten into your cargo hold while you were in Hai space. Leaving a Hai child on this world would be an extremely bad idea. Perhaps someone on <destination> will be able to bring the child back to its family.|473|0
units.english: This child must have somehow gotten into your cargo hold while you were in Hai space. Leaving a Hai child on this world would be an extremely bad idea. Perhaps someone on <destination> will be able to bring the child back to its family.
units.italian: Questo bambino deve essersi infilato in qualche modo nella tua stiva mentre eri nello spazio degli Hai. Lasciare un bambino Hai su questo mondo sarebbe un'idea estremamente cattiva. Forse qualcuno su <destination> riuscirà a riportarlo alla sua famiglia.

units.id: mission:Unwanted Cargo|dialog|478|0
units.english: You contact the spaceport authorities of <planet> and ask them if they are looking for a lost Hai child. It turns out that the family was so worried that they put up a <payment> reward for finding their son. A Hai spaceport worker takes the child from your ship and thanks you for finding him for the family.
units.italian: Contatti le autorità dello spazioporto di <planet> e chiedi se stanno cercando un bambino Hai smarrito. Scopri che la famiglia era così preoccupata da offrire una ricompensa di <payment> per chi lo avesse trovato. Un operaio dello spazioporto Hai prende il bambino dalla tua nave e ti ringrazia per averlo trovato per la famiglia.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|name|483|0
units.english: An Interesting Proposition
units.italian: Una proposta interessante

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|description|484|0
units.english: Travel with businessman David Turner to <destination> where a convoy of freighters are awaiting escort.
units.italian: Viaggia con l'uomo d'affari David Turner fino a <destination>, dove un convoglio di mercantili attende di essere scortato.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|Walking through the <origin> spaceport, you notice that almost half of the people you see are humans, unlike other Hai worlds where the Hai outnumber humans by a sizable degree. A human dressed in a business suit shouts your name from across the street and approaches you.|493|0
units.english: Walking through the <origin> spaceport, you notice that almost half of the people you see are humans, unlike other Hai worlds where the Hai outnumber humans by a sizable degree. A human dressed in a business suit shouts your name from across the street and approaches you.
units.italian: Camminando per lo spazioporto di <origin>, noti che quasi metà delle persone che vedi sono umane, a differenza degli altri mondi Hai dove gli Hai superano gli umani di parecchio. Un umano in abito da affari grida il tuo nome dall'altra parte della strada e ti si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Captain <last>, one of the many heroes of humanity! I noticed you right away when I laid my eyes upon you. I'd like to personally thank you for what you've done."|495|0
units.english: "Captain <last>, one of the many heroes of humanity! I noticed you right away when I laid my eyes upon you. I'd like to personally thank you for what you've done."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>, uno dei tanti eroi dell'umanità! L'ho notato subito quando l'ho visto. Vorrei ringraziarla personalmente per quello che ha fatto."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Glad to get some recognition for all the hard work I've done."|497|0
units.english: "Glad to get some recognition for all the hard work I've done."
units.italian: "Sono contento di ricevere un po' di riconoscimento per tutto il duro lavoro che ho fatto."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Don't mention it. I just did what I could to help."|499|0
units.english: "Don't mention it. I just did what I could to help."
units.italian: "Non c'è di che. Ho solo fatto quello che potevo per aiutare."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Can I help you, sir?"|501|0
units.english: "Can I help you, sir?"
units.italian: "Posso aiutarla, signore?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"I'm the one who should be using formal titles to address you, so please, Captain, don't call me sir.|503|0
units.english: "I'm the one who should be using formal titles to address you, so please, Captain, don't call me sir.
units.italian: "Sono io quello che dovrebbe usare i titoli formali con lei, quindi per favore, capitano, non mi chiami signore.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"A personality as big as yourself should be receiving praise and recognition wherever you go! People must really have no respect these days.|507|0
units.english: "A personality as big as yourself should be receiving praise and recognition wherever you go! People must really have no respect these days.
units.italian: "Una personalità grande come la sua dovrebbe ricevere lodi e riconoscimenti ovunque vada! Oggi la gente non ha davvero più rispetto.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"No need to downplay yourself, Captain! You've done God's work in saving humanity from that alien scourge.|511|0
units.english: "No need to downplay yourself, Captain! You've done God's work in saving humanity from that alien scourge.
units.italian: "Non c'è bisogno di sminuirsi, capitano! Ha fatto un lavoro da Dio salvando l'umanità da quel flagello alieno.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"The name's David Joseph Turner, venture capitalist, entrepreneur, and famous Paradise Worlds businessman." Turner grabs a business card from his pocket and hands it to you. The card contains his contact information, an address on Martini, and makes sure to boast in golden letters his net worth of more than three billion credits.|514|0
units.english: "The name's David Joseph Turner, venture capitalist, entrepreneur, and famous Paradise Worlds businessman." Turner grabs a business card from his pocket and hands it to you. The card contains his contact information, an address on Martini, and makes sure to boast in golden letters his net worth of more than three billion credits.
units.italian: "Mi chiamo David Joseph Turner, capitalista di ventura, imprenditore e famoso uomo d'affari dei Paradise Worlds." Turner prende un biglietto da visita dalla tasca e te lo porge. Il biglietto contiene i suoi recapiti, un indirizzo su Martini, e si assicura di vantare in lettere dorate un patrimonio netto di oltre tre miliardi di crediti.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"You may not have heard of me, but I've definitely heard of you, and I'd like to make a proposition to you." Turner turns around and waves his arm across the crowd of people in the spaceport. "You see all the humans here? About one out of every four of these people only arrived here after war broke out through the wormhole. Captains who knew of the Hai came flocking here in droves after the Navy entered Kornephoros, hoping to avoid any troubles that the war would bring. Some captains returned after the war ended, but most stayed, and I see a massive market opportunity in that."|515|0
units.english: "You may not have heard of me, but I've definitely heard of you, and I'd like to make a proposition to you." Turner turns around and waves his arm across the crowd of people in the spaceport. "You see all the humans here? About one out of every four of these people only arrived here after war broke out through the wormhole. Captains who knew of the Hai came flocking here in droves after the Navy entered Kornephoros, hoping to avoid any troubles that the war would bring. Some captains returned after the war ended, but most stayed, and I see a massive market opportunity in that."
units.italian: "Forse non avrà sentito parlare di me, ma io ho di certo sentito parlare di lei, e vorrei farle una proposta." Turner si volta e agita il braccio verso la folla di persone nello spazioporto. "Vede tutti questi umani? Circa uno su quattro di queste persone è arrivato qui solo dopo lo scoppio della guerra attraverso il cunicolo. I capitani che conoscevano gli Hai sono accorsi qui in massa dopo che la Marina è entrata a Kornephoros, sperando di evitare i problemi che la guerra avrebbe portato. Alcuni capitani sono tornati dopo la fine della guerra, ma la maggior parte è rimasta, e io ci vedo un'opportunità di mercato enorme."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"What kind of market opportunity?"|520|0
units.english: "What kind of market opportunity?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di opportunità di mercato?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Sorry, but I don't have the time to talk about this."|522|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't have the time to talk about this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non ho tempo di parlarne."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"What kind of market opportunity?"|527|0
units.english: "What kind of market opportunity?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di opportunità di mercato?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"You're only worth three billion credits? Why shouldn't I pursue your opportunity on my own?"|529|0
units.english: "You're only worth three billion credits? Why shouldn't I pursue your opportunity on my own?"
units.italian: "Vali solo tre miliardi di crediti? Perché non dovrei perseguire la tua opportunità da solo?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Sorry, but I don't have the time to talk about this."|530|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't have the time to talk about this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non ho tempo di parlarne."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Of course you're worth more than me, Captain <last>, but you are no business owner. I have the connections and skills, but a name like yours will always help.|533|0
units.english: "Of course you're worth more than me, Captain <last>, but you are no business owner. I have the connections and skills, but a name like yours will always help.
units.italian: "Certo che vale più di me, capitano <last>, ma lei non è un imprenditore. Io ho le conoscenze e le competenze, ma un nome come il suo aiuterà sempre.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	You try to walk away, but Turner stops you by grabbing your arm and continues to talk.|537|0
units.english: You try to walk away, but Turner stops you by grabbing your arm and continues to talk.
units.italian: Cerchi di andartene, ma Turner ti ferma afferrandoti il braccio e continua a parlare.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Allow me to explain. The journey to the Hai can be a dangerous one, and you know that. I heard many stories during the war of merchants trying to reach the Hai, but thanks to the Navy being distracted, those merchants fell victim to pirates patrolling the systems of the Far North. Now that many merchants are here, they're trapped. They expended most of if not all of their ammunition trying to get here, and now they have none to defend them on their way back. Human ammunition has become a scarce commodity among human captains in this region of space, leaving open a market that's just waiting to be cornered.|540|0
units.english: "Allow me to explain. The journey to the Hai can be a dangerous one, and you know that. I heard many stories during the war of merchants trying to reach the Hai, but thanks to the Navy being distracted, those merchants fell victim to pirates patrolling the systems of the Far North. Now that many merchants are here, they're trapped. They expended most of if not all of their ammunition trying to get here, and now they have none to defend them on their way back. Human ammunition has become a scarce commodity among human captains in this region of space, leaving open a market that's just waiting to be cornered.
units.italian: "Mi permetta di spiegare. Il viaggio verso gli Hai può essere pericoloso, e lei lo sa. Durante la guerra ho sentito molte storie di mercanti che cercavano di raggiungere gli Hai, ma grazie alla Marina distratta quei mercanti sono caduti vittima dei pirati che pattugliano i sistemi del Nord Lontano. Ora che molti mercanti sono qui, sono intrappolati. Hanno speso la maggior parte, se non tutte, le loro munizioni per arrivare, e ora non ne hanno per difendersi sulla via del ritorno. Le munizioni umane sono diventate una merce scarsa tra i capitani umani in questa regione di spazio, lasciando aperto un mercato che aspetta solo di essere accaparrato.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"I'd like you, Captain <last>, hero of humanity, to help me set up an outfitter here on <origin>, an outfitter that would supply these desperate merchants with relief by supplying them with the ammunition they need, along with outfits they might want to buy for their old ships. I've already received approval from the Hai government for the construction of an outfitter, and with a name like yours backing up this business, the profits are sure to be phenomenal, profits that you would be sharing in by being a founding member of this outfitter."|541|0
units.english: "I'd like you, Captain <last>, hero of humanity, to help me set up an outfitter here on <origin>, an outfitter that would supply these desperate merchants with relief by supplying them with the ammunition they need, along with outfits they might want to buy for their old ships. I've already received approval from the Hai government for the construction of an outfitter, and with a name like yours backing up this business, the profits are sure to be phenomenal, profits that you would be sharing in by being a founding member of this outfitter."
units.italian: "Vorrei che lei, capitano <last>, eroe dell'umanità, mi aiutasse ad aprire un fornitore di equipaggiamento qui su <origin>, un fornitore che darebbe sollievo a questi mercanti disperati fornendo loro le munizioni di cui hanno bisogno, insieme agli equipaggiamenti che potrebbero voler comprare per le loro vecchie navi. Ho già ricevuto l'approvazione del governo Hai per la costruzione di un fornitore, e con un nome come il suo a sostenere l'attività i profitti saranno di sicuro fenomenali, profitti a cui lei parteciperebbe come socio fondatore di questo fornitore."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"This sounds like a good idea to me. What do you need me to do?"|543|0
units.english: "This sounds like a good idea to me. What do you need me to do?"
units.italian: "Mi sembra una buona idea. Di cosa hai bisogno che faccia?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Sorry, but I'm not interested in your proposition."|545|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not interested in your proposition."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma la tua proposta non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Nonsense, Captain! All you'd need to do is help escort a few freighters from <planet> to Follower and back to here, and for so simple a job you could be receiving enough money to not work another day in your life, or perhaps even support a massive fleet."|547|0
units.english: "Nonsense, Captain! All you'd need to do is help escort a few freighters from <planet> to Follower and back to here, and for so simple a job you could be receiving enough money to not work another day in your life, or perhaps even support a massive fleet."
units.italian: "Sciocchezze, capitano! Tutto quello che dovrebbe fare è aiutare a scortare qualche mercantile da <planet> a Follower e ritorno qui, e per un lavoro così semplice potrebbe ricevere abbastanza denaro da non lavorare mai più, o persino da mantenere una flotta enorme."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Again, I'm not interested. Goodbye."|549|0
units.english: "Again, I'm not interested. Goodbye."
units.italian: "Ripeto, non mi interessa. Addio."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Alright, you have my attention."|550|0
units.english: "Alright, you have my attention."
units.italian: "Va bene, hai la mia attenzione."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Well, I tried, Captain," Turner says with a smirk. "I'll just have to travel back to the Paradise Worlds and make my money in other areas of business, then." He hands you another business card and winks. "Goodbye, Captain <last>. You should know where to find me if you need me. Perhaps we can pursue this venture together in the future."|553|0
units.english: "Well, I tried, Captain," Turner says with a smirk. "I'll just have to travel back to the Paradise Worlds and make my money in other areas of business, then." He hands you another business card and winks. "Goodbye, Captain <last>. You should know where to find me if you need me. Perhaps we can pursue this venture together in the future."
units.italian: "Beh, ci ho provato, capitano," dice Turner con un sorrisetto. "Allora dovrò solo tornare ai Paradise Worlds e fare soldi in altri settori di attività." Ti porge un altro biglietto da visita e fa l'occhiolino. "Addio, capitano <last>. Dovrebbe sapere dove trovarmi se ha bisogno di me. Forse potremo portare avanti questa impresa insieme in futuro."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|	"Excellent, Captain! I'll be making myself comfy on my own ship. A convoy of freighters is waiting for us on <destination>. From there, we're off to Follower to pick up supplies."|557|0
units.english: "Excellent, Captain! I'll be making myself comfy on my own ship. A convoy of freighters is waiting for us on <destination>. From there, we're off to Follower to pick up supplies."
units.italian: "Eccellente, capitano! Mi metterò comodo sulla mia nave. Un convoglio di mercantili ci aspetta su <destination>. Da lì partiamo per Follower a prendere i rifornimenti."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|dialog|566|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but you've left Turner behind. Wait for Turner's ship to arrive before landing.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro Turner. Aspetta che arrivi la sua nave prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [1]|dialog|569|0
units.english: The freighters are ready to launch by the time you get to <planet>. "Now we just need to escort these freighters to Follower in the Alphard system and back in one piece," Turner exclaims, hopping back on to his Star Queen.
units.italian: I mercantili sono pronti a partire quando arrivi su <planet>. "Ora dobbiamo solo scortare questi mercantili fino a Follower, nel sistema Alphard, e ritorno tutti interi," esclama Turner, saltando di nuovo sulla sua Star Queen.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [2]|name|575|0
units.english: An Interesting Proposition
units.italian: Una proposta interessante

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [2]|description|576|0
units.english: Escort the freighters to <destination> where they will pick up supplies for the Greenwater outfitter.
units.italian: Scorta i mercantili fino a <destination>, dove prenderanno i rifornimenti per il fornitore di Greenwater.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [2]|dialog|610|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but you've left one of the ships you're supposed to be escorting behind. Wait for Turner's ship and all the Bulk Freighters to arrive before landing.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una delle navi che devi scortare. Aspetta che arrivino la nave di Turner e tutti i Bulk Freighter prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [3]|name|616|0
units.english: An Interesting Proposition
units.italian: Una proposta interessante

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [3]|description|617|0
units.english: Escort Turner's ship to <destination> so that he can speak with an old friend.
units.italian: Scorta la nave di Turner fino a <destination> così che possa parlare con un vecchio amico.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [3]|Turner jumps off of his Star Queen before the boarding ramp fully reaches the ground, clearly eager to get moving with this project.|623|0
units.english: Turner jumps off of his Star Queen before the boarding ramp fully reaches the ground, clearly eager to get moving with this project.
units.italian: Turner salta giù dalla sua Star Queen prima che la rampa di imbarco raggiunga del tutto il suolo, chiaramente impaziente di andare avanti con questo progetto.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [3]|	Turner swears under his breath when he walks up to you. "Low life pirates giving us trouble on the way here. That's the kind of trouble I'm talking about that an outfitter in Hai space would help with. There's no telling what would have happened had my Bulk Freighters not had their missiles. Or if you were not there to protect them, of course."|624|0
units.english: Turner swears under his breath when he walks up to you. "Low life pirates giving us trouble on the way here. That's the kind of trouble I'm talking about that an outfitter in Hai space would help with. There's no telling what would have happened had my Bulk Freighters not had their missiles. Or if you were not there to protect them, of course."
units.italian: Turner impreca sottovoce quando ti si avvicina. "Pirati da quattro soldi che ci danno fastidio sulla via di qui. È proprio il tipo di problema per cui un fornitore di equipaggiamento nello spazio degli Hai sarebbe utile. Chissà cosa sarebbe successo se i miei Bulk Freighter non avessero avuto i loro missili. O se lei non fosse stato lì a proteggerli, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [3]|	Turner has a talk with the spaceport authorities, and within a short amount of time the necessary cargo is loaded on to the freighters. When the freighters are fully loaded, they take off without even giving you time to get to your ship.|625|0
units.english: Turner has a talk with the spaceport authorities, and within a short amount of time the necessary cargo is loaded on to the freighters. When the freighters are fully loaded, they take off without even giving you time to get to your ship.
units.italian: Turner parla con le autorità dello spazioporto, e in breve tempo il carico necessario viene caricato sui mercantili. Quando i mercantili sono carichi, decollano senza nemmeno darti il tempo di raggiungere la nave.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [3]|	"With their ammunition restocked they can get back to Greenwater on their own," Turner says from behind you as you watch the freighters fly off. "I told them to leave as soon as they could. As for you and me, I need an escort to <destination>. I received a message from an old friend there who would like to have a chat with me."|626|0
units.english: "With their ammunition restocked they can get back to Greenwater on their own," Turner says from behind you as you watch the freighters fly off. "I told them to leave as soon as they could. As for you and me, I need an escort to <destination>. I received a message from an old friend there who would like to have a chat with me."
units.italian: "Con le munizioni rifornite possono tornare a Greenwater da soli," dice Turner alle tue spalle mentre guardi i mercantili volare via. "Ho detto loro di partire il prima possibile. Quanto a te e me, mi serve una scorta fino a <destination>. Ho ricevuto un messaggio da un vecchio amico laggiù che vorrebbe scambiare due parole con me."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [3]|dialog|635|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but you've left Turner behind. Wait for Turner's ship to arrive before landing.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro Turner. Aspetta che arrivi la sua nave prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [4]|name|641|0
units.english: An Interesting Proposition
units.italian: Una proposta interessante

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [4]|description|642|0
units.english: Escort Turner back to <destination> to oversee the construction of the outfitter.
units.italian: Scorta Turner fino a <destination> per sovrintendere alla costruzione del fornitore di equipaggiamento.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [4]|Turner lands his ship outside of the Kraz Cybernetics building. "Wait here while I have a talk with my friend, Edward. This should only take a few minutes."|648|0
units.english: Turner lands his ship outside of the Kraz Cybernetics building. "Wait here while I have a talk with my friend, Edward. This should only take a few minutes."
units.italian: Turner atterra con la sua nave fuori dall'edificio della Kraz Cybernetics. "Aspetta qui mentre parlo con il mio amico Edward. Dovrebbero volerci solo pochi minuti."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [4]|	A few hours later, Turner returns carrying a black suitcase. "Sorry, that took longer than I expected. Now, let's get back to <destination>."|649|0
units.english: A few hours later, Turner returns carrying a black suitcase. "Sorry, that took longer than I expected. Now, let's get back to <destination>."
units.italian: Qualche ora dopo, Turner torna portando una valigetta nera. "Scusa, ci è voluto più del previsto. Ora torniamo su <destination>."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [4]|dialog|658|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but you've left Turner behind. Wait for Turner's ship to arrive before landing.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro Turner. Aspetta che arrivi la sua nave prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [4]|log|662|0
units.english: An entrepreneur with a sharp mind, he was instrumental in the creation of a human outfitter in Hai space, allowing merchants to arm themselves for the dangerous trip back to human space.
units.italian: Imprenditore dalla mente acuta, è stato determinante nella creazione di un fornitore di equipaggiamento umano nello spazio degli Hai, permettendo ai mercanti di armarsi per il pericoloso viaggio di ritorno nello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [4]|By the time you finally reach <planet>, construction on the outfitter is already underway. The construction workers have laid the foundation of the outfitter close to the spaceport, taking up a good portion of a park.|664|0
units.english: By the time you finally reach <planet>, construction on the outfitter is already underway. The construction workers have laid the foundation of the outfitter close to the spaceport, taking up a good portion of a park.
units.italian: Quando finalmente raggiungi <planet>, la costruzione del fornitore è già in corso. Gli operai hanno gettato le fondamenta del negozio vicino allo spazioporto, occupando buona parte di un parco.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [4]|	"I had to pay a pretty penny to get the outfitter this close to the spaceport," Turner says to you, "but it'll all be worth it in the end. The outfitter should be done in three months or so. You'll know it's done once you find an extra two thousand credits in your pocket every day."|665|0
units.english: "I had to pay a pretty penny to get the outfitter this close to the spaceport," Turner says to you, "but it'll all be worth it in the end. The outfitter should be done in three months or so. You'll know it's done once you find an extra two thousand credits in your pocket every day."
units.italian: "Ho dovuto pagare un occhio della testa per avere il fornitore così vicino allo spazioporto," ti dice Turner, "ma alla fine ne varrà la pena. Il fornitore dovrebbe essere pronto in circa tre mesi. Saprai che è finito quando troverai duemila crediti in più in tasca ogni giorno."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [4]|	Turner pats you on the back. "Have fun until then, Captain <last>. Keep yourself busy saving the galaxy."|666|0
units.english: Turner pats you on the back. "Have fun until then, Captain <last>. Keep yourself busy saving the galaxy."
units.italian: Turner ti dà una pacca sulla spalla. "Divertiti fino ad allora, capitano <last>. Tieniti occupato a salvare la galassia."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [5]|name|691|0
units.english: A New Proposition
units.italian: Una nuova proposta

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [5]|description|692|0
units.english: Meet with David Turner on <destination> to talk about a new proposition.
units.italian: Incontra David Turner su <destination> per parlare di una nuova proposta.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [5]|dialog|699|0
units.english: You receive a message from David Turner when you land. "Hello, Captain. I hope you've been enjoying your share in the outfitter. I have a new proposition for you, as I've bought out the rest of the park around the outfitter. Meet me on <destination> if you'd like to hear about it."
units.italian: Quando atterri ricevi un messaggio da David Turner. "Salve, capitano. Spero che stia apprezzando la sua quota nel fornitore. Ho una nuova proposta per lei, dato che ho rilevato il resto del parco attorno al negozio. Mi incontri su <destination> se vuole saperne di più."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|name|705|0
units.english: A New Proposition
units.italian: Una nuova proposta

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|description|706|0
units.english: Escort the freighters to <destination> in order to pick up the supplies for the shipyard.
units.italian: Scorta i mercantili fino a <destination> per prendere i rifornimenti per il cantiere navale.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|Turner meets you in a high-end human-owned restaurant in the richer part of the city, very much reminiscent of something you would find on a Paradise Planet. "It's been quite some time since we last spoke, Captain <last>. Over a year now," he says. "Have you been enjoying the extra cash in your pocket every day, Captain <last>?"|712|0
units.english: Turner meets you in a high-end human-owned restaurant in the richer part of the city, very much reminiscent of something you would find on a Paradise Planet. "It's been quite some time since we last spoke, Captain <last>. Over a year now," he says. "Have you been enjoying the extra cash in your pocket every day, Captain <last>?"
units.italian: Turner ti incontra in un ristorante di lusso di proprietà umana nella parte più ricca della città, molto simile a qualcosa che troveresti su un Pianeta Paradisiaco. "È passato parecchio tempo dall'ultima volta che ci siamo parlati, capitano <last>. Più di un anno ormai," dice. "Ha apprezzato il denaro extra in tasca ogni giorno, capitano <last>?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Yes. It's been a huge help paying crew salaries."|714|0
units.english: "Yes. It's been a huge help paying crew salaries."
units.italian: "Sì. È stato di grande aiuto per pagare gli stipendi dell'equipaggio."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Two thousand credits each day isn't much for me."|716|0
units.english: "Two thousand credits each day isn't much for me."
units.italian: "Duemila crediti al giorno non sono molti per me."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"I suppose two thousand credits every day wouldn't be much to a hero such as yourself. Spaceships are expensive, after all. How does four thousand credits every day sound to you?"|718|0
units.english: "I suppose two thousand credits every day wouldn't be much to a hero such as yourself. Spaceships are expensive, after all. How does four thousand credits every day sound to you?"
units.italian: "Immagino che duemila crediti al giorno non siano molti per un eroe come lei. Le navi spaziali costano, dopotutto. Che ne dice di quattromila crediti al giorno?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"I'm glad to hear that, Captain <last>. I spent my early years as a captain myself, and I didn't much enjoy having to worry about crew salaries every day. Perhaps doubling that amount will help even more."|722|0
units.english: "I'm glad to hear that, Captain <last>. I spent my early years as a captain myself, and I didn't much enjoy having to worry about crew salaries every day. Perhaps doubling that amount will help even more."
units.italian: "Sono contento di sentirlo, capitano <last>. Anch'io ho passato i primi anni come capitano, e non apprezzavo molto dovermi preoccupare ogni giorno degli stipendi dell'equipaggio. Forse raddoppiare quella cifra aiuterà ancora di più."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Am I getting a raise?"|726|0
units.english: "Am I getting a raise?"
units.italian: "Mi sta dando un aumento?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Is this part of your new proposition?"|727|0
units.english: "Is this part of your new proposition?"
units.italian: "Fa parte della tua nuova proposta?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"You could call it that," Turner says after sipping from his glass of wine.|730|0
units.english: "You could call it that," Turner says after sipping from his glass of wine.
units.italian: "Si potrebbe dire così," risponde Turner dopo aver sorseggiato il vino.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Building an outfitter selling human goods here on <origin> has had to be the best idea I've ever had, Captain <last>, but recently I thought of an even better idea. You see, most of the humans you see flying around in Hai space are flying decades-old ships. Hai ships are prohibitively expensive for humans. The Hai sell the Aphid for nearly one and a half million credits! This means that demand for ships is extremely high among humans, Captain <last>. Do you see where I'm going with this? You look at something we humans sell like a Star Barge, which is hardly worse than an Aphid for only a quarter of the price, and you start to see the problem."|733|0
units.english: "Building an outfitter selling human goods here on <origin> has had to be the best idea I've ever had, Captain <last>, but recently I thought of an even better idea. You see, most of the humans you see flying around in Hai space are flying decades-old ships. Hai ships are prohibitively expensive for humans. The Hai sell the Aphid for nearly one and a half million credits! This means that demand for ships is extremely high among humans, Captain <last>. Do you see where I'm going with this? You look at something we humans sell like a Star Barge, which is hardly worse than an Aphid for only a quarter of the price, and you start to see the problem."
units.italian: "Costruire un fornitore che vende merci umane qui su <origin> è stata la migliore idea che abbia mai avuto, capitano <last>, ma di recente ne ho pensata una ancora migliore. Vede, la maggior parte degli umani che volano nello spazio degli Hai usa navi vecchie di decenni. Le navi Hai sono proibitivamente costose per gli umani. Gli Hai vendono l'Aphid per quasi un milione e mezzo di crediti! Questo significa che la domanda di navi è estremamente alta tra gli umani, capitano <last>. Vede dove voglio arrivare? Guarda qualcosa che vendiamo noi umani come uno Star Barge, che non è molto peggio di un Aphid e costa un quarto, e si comincia a vedere il problema."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"You need me to help you escort freighters again?"|735|0
units.english: "You need me to help you escort freighters again?"
units.italian: "Hai di nuovo bisogno che ti aiuti a scortare mercantili?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Do you want to build a shipyard selling human ships?"|736|0
units.english: "Do you want to build a shipyard selling human ships?"
units.italian: "Vuoi costruire un cantiere navale che venda navi umane?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Yes, Captain. Right now, the only realistic way that a human born here can get a ship is if they know a captain willing to retire. Even then, prices for a human ship can be more than twice what they are across the wormhole. You'd think they could just get passage and buy a human ship over there, but those banks just don't recognize credit histories from this side. It's preposterous, Captain <last>!|738|0
units.english: "Yes, Captain. Right now, the only realistic way that a human born here can get a ship is if they know a captain willing to retire. Even then, prices for a human ship can be more than twice what they are across the wormhole. You'd think they could just get passage and buy a human ship over there, but those banks just don't recognize credit histories from this side. It's preposterous, Captain <last>!
units.italian: "Sì, capitano. Al momento l'unico modo realistico perché un umano nato qui possa avere una nave è conoscere un capitano disposto a ritirarsi. E anche così, i prezzi di una nave umana possono essere più del doppio di quelli dall'altra parte del cunicolo. Verrebbe da pensare che possano semplicemente prendere un passaggio e comprare una nave umana laggiù, ma quelle banche non riconoscono le storie creditizie da questo lato. È assurdo, capitano <last>!

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"I've already made arrangements with the local Hai government. The rest of the park next to the outfitter is now my property, and I intend to use it to build the shipyard. I've also contacted Megaparsec and bought a license to build their ships and some of the outfits they sell on <planet>. My freighters are at the ready in the spaceport right now. All I need you to do is escort them to <destination> and back, and in six to seven months' time when the shipyard is done, you'll reap the rewards. What do you say, Captain <last>? Do you want to be a hero to millions once again?"|739|0
units.english: "I've already made arrangements with the local Hai government. The rest of the park next to the outfitter is now my property, and I intend to use it to build the shipyard. I've also contacted Megaparsec and bought a license to build their ships and some of the outfits they sell on <planet>. My freighters are at the ready in the spaceport right now. All I need you to do is escort them to <destination> and back, and in six to seven months' time when the shipyard is done, you'll reap the rewards. What do you say, Captain <last>? Do you want to be a hero to millions once again?"
units.italian: "Ho già preso accordi con il governo locale degli Hai. Il resto del parco accanto al fornitore è ora di mia proprietà, e intendo usarlo per costruire il cantiere. Ho anche contattato la Megaparsec e comprato una licenza per costruire le loro navi e alcuni degli equipaggiamenti che vendono su <planet>. I miei mercantili sono pronti nello spazioporto adesso. Tutto quello che deve fare è scortarli fino a <destination> e ritorno, e tra sei o sette mesi, quando il cantiere sarà finito, raccoglierà i frutti. Che ne dice, capitano <last>? Vuole essere di nuovo un eroe per milioni di persone?"

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Sure, this sounds like a great idea."|741|0
units.english: "Sure, this sounds like a great idea."
units.italian: "Certo, mi sembra un'ottima idea."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"I'm not interested in working with you anymore, Turner."|743|0
units.english: "I'm not interested in working with you anymore, Turner."
units.italian: "Non mi interessa più lavorare con te, Turner."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	Turner smirks at your response. "Understood, Captain <last>. I'll just save myself two thousand credits a day from now on by rescinding your salary. I'll be seeing myself out now."|745|0
units.english: Turner smirks at your response. "Understood, Captain <last>. I'll just save myself two thousand credits a day from now on by rescinding your salary. I'll be seeing myself out now."
units.italian: Turner sorride alla tua risposta. "Capito, capitano <last>. Da oggi risparmierò duemila crediti al giorno revocando il suo stipendio. Ora me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Goodbye."|747|0
units.english: "Goodbye."
units.italian: "Addio."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Wait! I changed my mind. I'll help you."|749|0
units.english: "Wait! I changed my mind. I'll help you."
units.italian: "Aspetta! Ho cambiato idea. Ti aiuterò."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|	"Excellent decision, Captain <last>. I'll meet you outside to send the ships off."|752|0
units.english: "Excellent decision, Captain <last>. I'll meet you outside to send the ships off."
units.italian: "Ottima decisione, capitano <last>. La aspetto fuori per far partire le navi."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|dialog|787|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but you've left one of the ships you're supposed to be escorting behind. Wait for Turner's ship and all the Bulk Freighters to arrive before landing.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una delle navi che devi scortare. Aspetta che arrivino la nave di Turner e tutti i Bulk Freighter prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [6]|dialog|790|0
units.english: The Bulk Freighters are loaded with supplies without any problem. When one of the spaceport workers asks Turner where the supplies are going, he replies, "These are just to expand a business venture of mine on, uh, Glory."
units.italian: I Bulk Freighter vengono caricati con i rifornimenti senza problemi. Quando un operaio dello spazioporto chiede a Turner dove sono diretti i rifornimenti, lui risponde: "Servono solo ad ampliare un affare mio su, ehm, Glory."

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [7]|name|796|0
units.english: A New Proposition
units.italian: Una nuova proposta

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [7]|description|797|0
units.english: Escort the freighters back to <destination> to begin construction on the shipyard.
units.italian: Scorta i mercantili indietro fino a <destination> per iniziare la costruzione del cantiere navale.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [7]|dialog|826|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but you've left one of the ships you're supposed to be escorting behind. Wait for Turner's ship and all the Bulk Freighters to arrive before landing.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una delle navi che devi scortare. Aspetta che arrivino la nave di Turner e tutti i Bulk Freighter prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [7]|	Construction on the shipyard begins almost immediately after the supplies are unloaded from the freighters, starting with the demolition of the rest of the park. A downtrodden-looking crowd gathers to watch the demolition, but Turner assures you that there are plenty of other parks in the city for them to go to.|831|0
units.english: Construction on the shipyard begins almost immediately after the supplies are unloaded from the freighters, starting with the demolition of the rest of the park. A downtrodden-looking crowd gathers to watch the demolition, but Turner assures you that there are plenty of other parks in the city for them to go to.
units.italian: La costruzione del cantiere inizia quasi subito dopo che i rifornimenti sono stati scaricati dai mercantili, a cominciare dalla demolizione del resto del parco. Una folla dall'aria abbattuta si raduna a guardare la demolizione, ma Turner ti assicura che in città ci sono molti altri parchi dove possono andare.

units.id: mission:Expanding Business [7]|	"Something big is going to come of this, Captain <last>," Turner says. "Just know that you were all part of it. You'll know the shipyard is done when you find an extra four thousand credits in your pocket each day. Goodbye until then, Captain <last>."|832|0
units.english: "Something big is going to come of this, Captain <last>," Turner says. "Just know that you were all part of it. You'll know the shipyard is done when you find an extra four thousand credits in your pocket each day. Goodbye until then, Captain <last>."
units.italian: "Ne verrà fuori qualcosa di grande, capitano <last>," dice Turner. "Sappia solo che lei ne è stato parte. Saprà che il cantiere è finito quando troverà quattromila crediti in più in tasca ogni giorno. Arrivederci ad allora, capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|description|895|0
units.english: Bring Arthur and his Hai friend Kiru to <destination> for a gaming convention by <date>.
units.italian: Porta Arthur e il suo amico Hai Kiru su <destination> per una convention di videogiochi entro il <date>.

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|While eating in a spaceport cafeteria that serves both Hai and human cuisine, you are approached by a teenage human and Hai. "Hello. Do you know how to get to <destination>?" the Hai asks.|908|0
units.english: While eating in a spaceport cafeteria that serves both Hai and human cuisine, you are approached by a teenage human and Hai. "Hello. Do you know how to get to <destination>?" the Hai asks.
units.italian: Mentre mangi in una caffetteria dello spazioporto che serve sia cucina Hai sia umana, vieni avvicinato da un umano adolescente e da un Hai. "Salve. Sa come arrivare a <destination>?" chiede l'Hai.

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|	"I do. Why do you want to go there?"|910|0
units.english: "I do. Why do you want to go there?"
units.italian: "Sì. Perché ci vuoi andare?"

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|	"I don't. You'll have to ask someone else."|911|0
units.english: "I don't. You'll have to ask someone else."
units.italian: "No. Dovrai chiedere a qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|	The human responds, "There's a massive convention on <planet> on <date> for a game called 'Boundless Frontiers.' The convention has a huge cosplaying scene, and I think Kiru would fit right in."|913|0
units.english: The human responds, "There's a massive convention on <planet> on <date> for a game called 'Boundless Frontiers.' The convention has a huge cosplaying scene, and I think Kiru would fit right in."
units.italian: L'umano risponde: "C'è una convention enorme su <planet> il <date> per un gioco chiamato 'Frontiere Infinite'. La convention ha una scena cosplay enorme, e penso che Kiru si inserirebbe benissimo."

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|	"Arthur and I have <payment> to give you if you bring us to the <planet>," Kiru says. "We can find our own way back to the Hai space, as well."|916|0
units.english: "Arthur and I have <payment> to give you if you bring us to the <planet>," Kiru says. "We can find our own way back to the Hai space, as well."
units.italian: "Io e Arthur abbiamo <payment> da darti se ci porti sul <planet>," dice Kiru. "Possiamo anche trovare da soli la via del ritorno nello spazio degli Hai."

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|	"Alright, I can take you there."|918|0
units.english: "Alright, I can take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, posso portarvi."

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|	"Sorry, you'll have to find someone else to bring you."|920|0
units.english: "Sorry, you'll have to find someone else to bring you."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, dovrete trovare qualcun altro che vi porti."

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|dialog|924|0
units.english: You look for Arthur and Kiru, but realize that they took a ride on one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Cerchi Arthur e Kiru, ma ti rendi conto che sono saliti su una delle tue scorte! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|dialog|927|0
units.english: Arthur and Kiru pay you <payment> before running off to the convention center. As they run away, you notice that Kiru is drawing a number of eyes from the crowd, but no one seems to suspect that he is an actual alien.
units.italian: Arthur e Kiru ti pagano <payment> prima di correre verso il centro congressi. Mentre si allontanano, noti che Kiru attira parecchi sguardi tra la folla, ma nessuno sembra sospettare che sia un alieno vero.

units.id: mission:Hiding in Plain Sight|log|928|0
units.english: Human and Hai respectively, both attended the Vinci cosplay convention without a costume, gaining much attention.
units.italian: Umano e Hai rispettivamente, entrambi hanno partecipato alla convention cosplay di Vinci senza costume, attirando molta attenzione.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|description|933|0
units.english: Bring Anaya and Touhar to <destination> for their honeymoon.
units.italian: Porta Anaya e Touhar su <destination> per la loro luna di miele.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|You hop around the spaceport of <origin>, trying to adjust to the low gravity of this moon, when you are approached by a toweringly tall human woman and an equally tall Hai male who are clearly having no trouble with <origin>'s gravity.|943|0
units.english: You hop around the spaceport of <origin>, trying to adjust to the low gravity of this moon, when you are approached by a toweringly tall human woman and an equally tall Hai male who are clearly having no trouble with <origin>'s gravity.
units.italian: Saltelli per lo spazioporto di <origin>, cercando di adattarti alla bassa gravità di questa luna, quando vieni avvicinato da una donna umana altissima e da un maschio Hai altrettanto alto, che chiaramente non hanno alcun problema con la gravità di <origin>.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"You look like you need help there, Captain," the woman says with a chuckle.|944|0
units.english: "You look like you need help there, Captain," the woman says with a chuckle.
units.italian: "Sembra che abbia bisogno di aiuto, capitano," dice la donna con una risatina.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Don't worry. I almost have the hang of it."|946|0
units.english: "Don't worry. I almost have the hang of it."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti. Ho quasi preso la mano."

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Maybe a little bit."|947|0
units.english: "Maybe a little bit."
units.italian: "Forse un pochino."

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"It's always fun watching captains when they step off the comfort of their ship," the Hai says.|948|0
units.english: "It's always fun watching captains when they step off the comfort of their ship," the Hai says.
units.italian: "È sempre divertente guardare i capitani quando scendono dal comfort della loro nave," dice l'Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"At least they're trying, Touhar," the woman says.|949|0
units.english: "At least they're trying, Touhar," the woman says.
units.italian: "Almeno ci stanno provando, Touhar," dice la donna.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Can I help you two with something?"|951|0
units.english: "Can I help you two with something?"
units.italian: "Posso aiutarvi in qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Is there something I can help you with, or are you just going to watch me?"|952|0
units.english: "Is there something I can help you with, or are you just going to watch me?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa in cui posso aiutarvi, o avete intenzione di guardarmi e basta?"

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Actually, there is something," the woman says. "My name is Anaya, and this is my husband, Touhar. And you are?"|953|0
units.english: "Actually, there is something," the woman says. "My name is Anaya, and this is my husband, Touhar. And you are?"
units.italian: "In realtà sì," dice la donna. "Mi chiamo Anaya, e questo è mio marito, Touhar. E tu sei?"

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"My name is <first> <last>."|955|0
units.english: "My name is <first> <last>."
units.italian: "Mi chiamo <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Wait, your husband?"|956|0
units.english: "Wait, your husband?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, tuo marito?"

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Very nice to meet you, Captain <last>," Touhar says to you.|959|0
units.english: "Very nice to meet you, Captain <last>," Touhar says to you.
units.italian: "Piacere di conoscerla, capitano <last>," ti dice Touhar.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"What, you've never seen an interspecies couple before?" Touhar asks with a hint of sarcasm in his voice.|963|0
units.english: "What, you've never seen an interspecies couple before?" Touhar asks with a hint of sarcasm in his voice.
units.italian: "Come, non hai mai visto una coppia interspecie?" chiede Touhar con una punta di sarcasmo nella voce.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"We got married last week, and we were hoping to travel to <destination> for our honeymoon. I know it's risky to bring Touhar into human space, but <planet> is a sparsely inhabited world, and I have a friend who owns a house in the mountains far from anyone who could see him."|966|0
units.english: "We got married last week, and we were hoping to travel to <destination> for our honeymoon. I know it's risky to bring Touhar into human space, but <planet> is a sparsely inhabited world, and I have a friend who owns a house in the mountains far from anyone who could see him."
units.italian: "Ci siamo sposati la settimana scorsa, e speravamo di viaggiare fino a <destination> per la luna di miele. So che è rischioso portare Touhar nello spazio umano, ma <planet> è un mondo scarsamente abitato, e ho un'amica che possiede una casa in montagna, lontano da chiunque possa vederlo."

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Said friend will be able to arrange for our return to <origin> as well," Touhar adds. "Will you take us?"|967|0
units.english: "Said friend will be able to arrange for our return to <origin> as well," Touhar adds. "Will you take us?"
units.italian: "La stessa amica potrà organizzare anche il nostro ritorno a <origin>," aggiunge Touhar. "Ci porti?"

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Sure."|969|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|	"Sorry, I can't travel that far from here."|971|0
units.english: "Sorry, I can't travel that far from here."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non posso spingermi così lontano da qui."

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|dialog|975|0
units.english: You look for Anaya and Touhar, but realize that they took a ride on one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Cerchi Anaya e Touhar, ma ti rendi conto che sono saliti su una delle tue scorte! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|dialog|978|0
units.english: Instead of landing in the spaceport where they can be seen, you drop Anaya and Touhar off as close as you can to where they will be staying. The house is a few kilometers away, but they assure you that they can make it on their own. They pay you <payment> and thank you for bringing them this far.
units.italian: Invece di atterrare nello spazioporto dove potrebbero essere visti, lasci Anaya e Touhar il più vicino possibile al posto dove alloggeranno. La casa è a qualche chilometro, ma ti assicurano che possono arrivarci da soli. Ti pagano <payment> e ti ringraziano per averli portati fin qui.

units.id: mission:Hai Honeymoon|log|979|0
units.english: A Hai-human interspecies couple that you transported to their secluded honeymoon on Featherweight in human space.
units.italian: Una coppia interspecie Hai-umana che hai trasportato per la loro luna di miele appartata su Featherweight, nello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [0]|name|984|0
units.english: Defend <system>
units.italian: Difendi <system>

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [0]|description|985|0
units.english: A sizable group of pirates has found their way into Hai space and is terrorizing the system. Help the Hai fight back against them.
units.italian: Un gruppo consistente di pirati si è fatto strada nello spazio degli Hai e sta terrorizzando il sistema. Aiuta gli Hai a respingerli.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [0]|The peaceful spaceport is suddenly filled with the harsh sound of sirens. You spot some Hai and a small number of humans running to their ships and speeding quickly into orbit. It appears that the system is under attack, but the Unfettered Hai never reach this far south. A loud speaker begins blaring throughout the spaceport: "Unfettered humans have entered the system in a large fleet and have begun attacking! Requesting all combat-worthy pilots to assist in the defense of our space. These enemies of harmony are not welcome here."|995|0
units.english: The peaceful spaceport is suddenly filled with the harsh sound of sirens. You spot some Hai and a small number of humans running to their ships and speeding quickly into orbit. It appears that the system is under attack, but the Unfettered Hai never reach this far south. A loud speaker begins blaring throughout the spaceport: "Unfettered humans have entered the system in a large fleet and have begun attacking! Requesting all combat-worthy pilots to assist in the defense of our space. These enemies of harmony are not welcome here."
units.italian: Lo spazioporto pacifico viene improvvisamente riempito dal suono aspro delle sirene. Vedi alcuni Hai e un piccolo numero di umani correre verso le loro navi e schizzare rapidamente in orbita. Sembra che il sistema sia sotto attacco, ma gli Hai Slegati non arrivano mai così a sud. Un altoparlante comincia a gridare in tutto lo spazioporto: "Umani slegati sono entrati nel sistema con una grande flotta e hanno iniziato ad attaccare! Si richiede a tutti i piloti idonei al combattimento di assistere nella difesa del nostro spazio. Questi nemici dell'armonia non sono graditi qui."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [0]|	You find the phrase "unfettered humans" odd, but guess that they may be referring to pirates. The Hai will probably be very gracious if you help, but this could also be an easy way to get yourself killed, especially if a group of pirates is bold enough to attack the Hai.|998|0
units.english: You find the phrase "unfettered humans" odd, but guess that they may be referring to pirates. The Hai will probably be very gracious if you help, but this could also be an easy way to get yourself killed, especially if a group of pirates is bold enough to attack the Hai.
units.italian: Trovi strana l'espressione "umani slegati", ma supponi che si riferiscano ai pirati. Gli Hai saranno probabilmente molto riconoscenti se aiuti, ma questo potrebbe anche essere un modo facile per farti uccidere, soprattutto se un gruppo di pirati è abbastanza audace da attaccare gli Hai.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [0]|	Your heart drops at the phrase "unfettered humans," as the last time you heard that was when the Unfettered Hai used that phrase to refer to the Alphas. If it is really the Alphas attacking the Hai, then it is probably a good idea to help.|1002|0
units.english: Your heart drops at the phrase "unfettered humans," as the last time you heard that was when the Unfettered Hai used that phrase to refer to the Alphas. If it is really the Alphas attacking the Hai, then it is probably a good idea to help.
units.italian: Il cuore ti si ferma alla frase "umani slegati", perché l'ultima volta che l'hai sentita era quando gli Hai Slegati la usavano per riferirsi agli Alpha. Se sono davvero gli Alpha ad attaccare gli Hai, probabilmente è una buona idea aiutare.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [0]|	(Join the defense fleet.)|1005|0
units.english: (Join the defense fleet.)
units.italian: (Unisciti alla flotta di difesa.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [0]|	(Stay here until the fight is over.)|1007|0
units.english: (Stay here until the fight is over.)
units.italian: (Resta qui finché la battaglia non è finita.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|name|1033|0
units.english: Unfettered Humans
units.italian: Umani slegati

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|description|1034|0
units.english: Track down the leaders of the pirate gang "Scar's Legion" and "persuade" them to stop attacking Hai space, then return to <destination> to tell the Hai.
units.italian: Trova i capi della banda di pirati "Legione di Scar" e "convincili" a smettere di attaccare lo spazio degli Hai, poi torna su <destination> per informare gli Hai.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|The battle has ended, but the spaceport still seems more hectic than usual. Ships are jumping in from the surrounding systems to help any injured and to repair any damage that may have occurred. After some hours pass and the commotion has died down, a Hai elder approaches you. "We have heard from the humans here that you are considered a seasoned fighter among your people. May you lend your combat prowess to us to resolve this issue?"|1048|0
units.english: The battle has ended, but the spaceport still seems more hectic than usual. Ships are jumping in from the surrounding systems to help any injured and to repair any damage that may have occurred. After some hours pass and the commotion has died down, a Hai elder approaches you. "We have heard from the humans here that you are considered a seasoned fighter among your people. May you lend your combat prowess to us to resolve this issue?"
units.italian: La battaglia è finita, ma lo spazioporto sembra ancora più caotico del solito. Navi saltano dentro dai sistemi circostanti per aiutare i feriti e riparare eventuali danni. Dopo alcune ore, quando il trambusto si è calmato, un anziano Hai ti si avvicina. "Abbiamo saputo dagli umani qui che lei è considerato un combattente esperto tra la sua gente. Potrebbe prestarci la sua abilità in combattimento per risolvere questa faccenda?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"I'd be glad to help. What can I do?"|1050|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help. What can I do?"
units.italian: "Sarò felice di aiutare. Cosa posso fare?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"What issue?"|1052|0
units.english: "What issue?"
units.italian: "Quale faccenda?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"I understand that you just defended this system from human pirates. That is the issue that needs resolved.|1053|0
units.english: "I understand that you just defended this system from human pirates. That is the issue that needs resolved.
units.italian: "Capisco che abbia appena difeso questo sistema dai pirati umani. È quella la faccenda da risolvere.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"Human attacks on our systems are very rare, but recently we have experienced an increased number of raids. Not all have been as unsuccessful as this one. We captured a crew member of this most recent attack who was attempting to flee in an escape pod, and he gave us information that a gang that calls themselves 'Scar's Legion' has discovered our territory and is responsible for the recent raids.|1055|0
units.english: "Human attacks on our systems are very rare, but recently we have experienced an increased number of raids. Not all have been as unsuccessful as this one. We captured a crew member of this most recent attack who was attempting to flee in an escape pod, and he gave us information that a gang that calls themselves 'Scar's Legion' has discovered our territory and is responsible for the recent raids.
units.italian: "Gli attacchi umani ai nostri sistemi sono molto rari, ma di recente abbiamo subito un numero crescente di incursioni. Non tutte sono andate male come questa. Abbiamo catturato un membro dell'equipaggio di quest'ultimo attacco che cercava di fuggire su una capsula di salvataggio, e ci ha dato informazioni: una banda che si fa chiamare 'Legione di Scar' ha scoperto il nostro territorio ed è responsabile delle incursioni recenti.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"Unfortunately, he would not tell us where this gang is, or who the leader is, so there is nothing we are able to do about it. Many humans who live peacefully among us told us that you might be capable of assistance, though."|1056|0
units.english: "Unfortunately, he would not tell us where this gang is, or who the leader is, so there is nothing we are able to do about it. Many humans who live peacefully among us told us that you might be capable of assistance, though."
units.italian: "Purtroppo non ci ha voluto dire dove si trovi questa banda, né chi sia il capo, quindi non possiamo farci nulla. Molti umani che vivono pacificamente tra noi ci hanno detto che lei potrebbe essere in grado di aiutarci."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"I'll see what I can do."|1058|0
units.english: "I'll see what I can do."
units.italian: "Vedrò cosa posso fare."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"You want me to hunt down Scar's Legion to stop them from attacking you?"|1060|0
units.english: "You want me to hunt down Scar's Legion to stop them from attacking you?"
units.italian: "Vuoi che dia la caccia alla Legione di Scar per fermare i loro attacchi?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"Sorry, I'm not interested."|1061|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"We understand that these humans are likely misguided. We ask that you resolve this peacefully if possible, but the loss of life from these continued attacks is unacceptable."|1063|0
units.english: "We understand that these humans are likely misguided. We ask that you resolve this peacefully if possible, but the loss of life from these continued attacks is unacceptable."
units.italian: "Capiamo che questi umani siano probabilmente fuorviati. Chiediamo che risolva la cosa pacificamente se possibile, ma la perdita di vite da questi attacchi continui è inaccettabile."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"I'll see what I can do."|1065|0
units.english: "I'll see what I can do."
units.italian: "Vedrò cosa posso fare."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"Sorry, but I'm not interested."|1067|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|	"Thank you. Please return to <destination> after you have sought to resolve this situation."|1070|0
units.english: "Thank you. Please return to <destination> after you have sought to resolve this situation."
units.italian: "Grazie. La preghiamo di tornare su <destination> dopo aver cercato di risolvere la situazione."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]|dialog|1073|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you haven't yet tracked down Scar's Legion. Perhaps you should ask around the spaceport of pirate planets near the wormhole into Hai space for information.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora rintracciato la Legione di Scar. Forse dovresti chiedere in giro nello spazioporto dei pianeti pirata vicino al cunicolo verso lo spazio degli Hai.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]: Farpoint|You visit the Navy outpost on <origin> and ask the officers there if they have any information on Scar's Legion. After running a background check on you to make sure you're not up to no good, an officer hands you a copy of a folder containing all the information that the Navy has on the gang. "Nothing in here is classified, so you're free to keep it," the officer says.|1089|0
units.english: You visit the Navy outpost on <origin> and ask the officers there if they have any information on Scar's Legion. After running a background check on you to make sure you're not up to no good, an officer hands you a copy of a folder containing all the information that the Navy has on the gang. "Nothing in here is classified, so you're free to keep it," the officer says.
units.italian: Visiti l'avamposto della Marina su <origin> e chiedi agli ufficiali se hanno informazioni sulla Legione di Scar. Dopo aver controllato il tuo background per assicurarsi che tu non abbia cattive intenzioni, un ufficiale ti consegna una copia di una cartella con tutte le informazioni che la Marina ha sulla banda. "Qui dentro niente è classificato, quindi puoi tenerla," dice l'ufficiale.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]: Farpoint|	You return to your ship and sift through the files. The leader of the gang is named Scar (to no one's surprise), who used to be an important member of another pirate gang before forming his own. The Navy estimates their numbers to be in the low thousands, mostly responsible for petty crime in the Far North and not a cause of too much trouble, but the files all date back to a number of years ago. Clearly something has changed in the time since these files were last updated if Scar's Legion is now powerful enough to even attempt to attack the Hai.|1090|0
units.english: You return to your ship and sift through the files. The leader of the gang is named Scar (to no one's surprise), who used to be an important member of another pirate gang before forming his own. The Navy estimates their numbers to be in the low thousands, mostly responsible for petty crime in the Far North and not a cause of too much trouble, but the files all date back to a number of years ago. Clearly something has changed in the time since these files were last updated if Scar's Legion is now powerful enough to even attempt to attack the Hai.
units.italian: Torni alla nave e sfogli i file. Il capo della banda si chiama Scar (con sorpresa di nessuno), ed era un membro importante di un'altra banda di pirati prima di formare la propria. La Marina stima che siano qualche migliaio, responsabili soprattutto di piccoli crimini nel Nord Lontano e non causa di troppi problemi, ma i file risalgono a diversi anni fa. Chiaramente qualcosa è cambiato da quando questi file sono stati aggiornati l'ultima volta, se la Legione di Scar è ora abbastanza potente da tentare persino di attaccare gli Hai.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]: Freedom or Zenith|You wander the <origin> spaceport on the lookout for anyone who might have any information on the whereabouts of Scar's Legion. A self-described fixer promises you information in exchange for payment, but after handing her the few credits that she's asking for, she runs off with her gun in her hands to discourage you from following. Perhaps someone on another nearby pirate planet will have actual information for you.|1105|0
units.english: You wander the <origin> spaceport on the lookout for anyone who might have any information on the whereabouts of Scar's Legion. A self-described fixer promises you information in exchange for payment, but after handing her the few credits that she's asking for, she runs off with her gun in her hands to discourage you from following. Perhaps someone on another nearby pirate planet will have actual information for you.
units.italian: Giri per lo spazioporto di <origin> in cerca di qualcuno che possa avere informazioni su dove si trovi la Legione di Scar. Una sedicente faccendiera ti promette informazioni in cambio di denaro, ma dopo averle dato i pochi crediti che chiede, scappa via con la pistola in mano per dissuaderti dal seguirla. Forse qualcuno su un altro pianeta pirata vicino avrà informazioni vere.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]: Haven|You order a drink from a small rundown bar in the <origin> spaceport and try to make small talk with the bartender to get him open to giving information about Scar's Legion. He seems reluctant at first, but eventually warms up to you. A few other patrons of the bar join in on the conversation. Luckily no one seems mad about you asking about Scar's Legion. One of the patrons makes it clear that Scar's Legion has no friends on this world, "at least not anymore."|1120|0
units.english: You order a drink from a small rundown bar in the <origin> spaceport and try to make small talk with the bartender to get him open to giving information about Scar's Legion. He seems reluctant at first, but eventually warms up to you. A few other patrons of the bar join in on the conversation. Luckily no one seems mad about you asking about Scar's Legion. One of the patrons makes it clear that Scar's Legion has no friends on this world, "at least not anymore."
units.italian: Ordini un drink in un piccolo bar malmesso nello spazioporto di <origin> e cerchi di fare conversazione con il barista per aprirlo a dare informazioni sulla Legione di Scar. All'inizio sembra riluttante, ma alla fine si scioglie. Altri avventori del bar si uniscono alla conversazione. Per fortuna nessuno sembra arrabbiato che tu chieda della Legione di Scar. Uno degli avventori chiarisce che la Legione di Scar non ha amici su questo mondo, "almeno non più".

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]: Haven|	You leave the bar after an hour or two. Once you return to your ship, you write down all the information you can remember. The gang used to operate exclusively out of the Far North until they crossed one of the larger gangs, causing them to flee the region a few years ago. One of the pirates guessed that they fled for the Core.|1121|0
units.english: You leave the bar after an hour or two. Once you return to your ship, you write down all the information you can remember. The gang used to operate exclusively out of the Far North until they crossed one of the larger gangs, causing them to flee the region a few years ago. One of the pirates guessed that they fled for the Core.
units.italian: Lasci il bar dopo un'ora o due. Una volta tornato alla nave, annoti tutte le informazioni che riesci a ricordare. La banda operava esclusivamente dal Nord Lontano finché non ha incrociato una delle bande più grandi, cosa che li ha costretti a fuggire dalla regione qualche anno fa. Uno dei pirati ha ipotizzato che siano fuggiti verso il Nucleo.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]: Haven|	Another person mentioned that the leader of the gang used to always talk about making their own base in an uninhabited system where no one would find it. "He always talked about hollowing out an asteroid to use as a hideout. My guess is he was just always high on the ringworld shavings his gang was dealing."|1122|0
units.english: Another person mentioned that the leader of the gang used to always talk about making their own base in an uninhabited system where no one would find it. "He always talked about hollowing out an asteroid to use as a hideout. My guess is he was just always high on the ringworld shavings his gang was dealing."
units.italian: Un'altra persona ha detto che il capo della banda parlava sempre di costruire una base propria in un sistema disabitato dove nessuno l'avrebbe trovata. "Parlava sempre di svuotare un asteroide per usarlo come covo. Secondo me era solo sempre fatto delle limature di mondo ad anello che spacciava la sua banda."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]: Stormhold|It doesn't take long for you to find someone who knows something about Scar's Legion. You meet someone who says he'll give you information "free of charge."|1136|0
units.english: It doesn't take long for you to find someone who knows something about Scar's Legion. You meet someone who says he'll give you information "free of charge."
units.italian: Non ci vuole molto perché tu trovi qualcuno che sa qualcosa sulla Legione di Scar. Incontri un tale che dice di darti informazioni "gratis".

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]: Stormhold|	"Scar's Legion have been a thorn in my side for months now. Wrecked my ship a while back, and have been causing me trouble ever since. If you're planning on taking them out, then I'll tell you everything you need to know."|1137|0
units.english: "Scar's Legion have been a thorn in my side for months now. Wrecked my ship a while back, and have been causing me trouble ever since. If you're planning on taking them out, then I'll tell you everything you need to know."
units.italian: "La Legione di Scar è una spina nel fianco da mesi ormai. Mi ha distrutto la nave tempo fa, e da allora mi crea problemi. Se hai intenzione di eliminarli, ti dirò tutto quello che devi sapere."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [1]: Stormhold|	The pirate tells you that he doesn't know where the base of Scar's Legion is, but he mentions that they spend a lot of time in the uninhabited systems of the Far North. "Nothing out there but cold rocks and gas giants, but if they're spending so much time out there then they must have set up a base of some sort on one of those frozen planets."|1138|0
units.english: The pirate tells you that he doesn't know where the base of Scar's Legion is, but he mentions that they spend a lot of time in the uninhabited systems of the Far North. "Nothing out there but cold rocks and gas giants, but if they're spending so much time out there then they must have set up a base of some sort on one of those frozen planets."
units.italian: Il pirata ti dice che non sa dove sia la base della Legione di Scar, ma accenna che passano molto tempo nei sistemi disabitati del Nord Lontano. "Là fuori non c'è altro che rocce fredde e giganti gassosi, ma se passano così tanto tempo là fuori devono aver messo su una base di qualche tipo su uno di quei pianeti ghiacciati."

units.id: planet:Scar's Hideout|description|1175|0
units.english: Scar's Hideout is a hollowed-out asteroid used by Scar's Legion as their main base of operations. From here they harass anyone making the journey through the uninhabited systems of the Far North. Recently the gang has discovered the wormhole to Hai space, leading them to start causing trouble for more than just unlucky merchants.
units.italian: Il Covo di Scar è un asteroide svuotato usato dalla Legione di Scar come base principale. Da qui molestano chiunque attraversi i sistemi disabitati del Nord Lontano. Di recente la banda ha scoperto il cunicolo verso lo spazio degli Hai, il che li ha portati a creare problemi a più che ai soli mercanti sfortunati.

units.id: planet:Scar's Hideout|spaceport|1176|0
units.english: The spaceport of Scar's Hideout is a massive hangar dug into the core of the asteroid, accessible only by a single blast door on the ceiling. Judging by the size of the hangar, you'd guess that about a third of the entire asteroid was hollowed out for the spaceport alone.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto del Covo di Scar è un enorme hangar scavato nel nucleo dell'asteroide, accessibile solo da un singolo portello a tenuta sul soffitto. A giudicare dalle dimensioni dell'hangar, diresti che circa un terzo dell'intero asteroide è stato svuotato solo per lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [2]|name|1182|0
units.english: Scar's Legion
units.italian: La Legione di Scar

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [2]|description|1183|0
units.english: You've pieced together enough information to find out that the Scar's Legion hideout is in one of four systems in the Far North. Search those systems for the gang's hideout and confront them.
units.italian: Hai messo insieme abbastanza informazioni per scoprire che il covo della Legione di Scar si trova in uno di quattro sistemi del Nord Lontano. Cerca il covo della banda in quei sistemi e affrontali.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [2]|After having visited various pirate worlds asking about Scar's Legion, you believe that you know where their hideout is.|1193|0
units.english: After having visited various pirate worlds asking about Scar's Legion, you believe that you know where their hideout is.
units.italian: Dopo aver visitato vari mondi pirata chiedendo della Legione di Scar, credi di sapere dove sia il loro covo.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [2]|	You know that the leader of Scar's Legion used to talk about wanting a hollowed out asteroid as a base. You also know that Scar's Legion has recently been very active in the uninhabited systems of the Far North.
