You conclude that the gang's hideout is likely an asteroid located in one of a few systems that are in proximity to the wormhole that leads to the Hai. You mark <waypoints> on your map and get ready to confront them.|1194|0
units.english: You know that the leader of Scar's Legion used to talk about wanting a hollowed out asteroid as a base. You also know that Scar's Legion has recently been very active in the uninhabited systems of the Far North. You conclude that the gang's hideout is likely an asteroid located in one of a few systems that are in proximity to the wormhole that leads to the Hai. You mark <waypoints> on your map and get ready to confront them.
units.italian: Sai che il capo della Legione di Scar parlava di volere un asteroide svuotato come base. Sai anche che la Legione di Scar è stata molto attiva di recente nei sistemi disabitati del Nord Lontano. Concludi che il covo della banda sia probabilmente un asteroide in uno di alcuni sistemi vicini al cunicolo che porta agli Hai. Segni <waypoints> sulla mappa e ti prepari ad affrontarli.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|name|1217|0
units.english: Scar's Legion
units.italian: La Legione di Scar

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|description|1218|0
units.english: Having declined the tribute, the leader of Scar's Legion has challenged you to a fight to the death. Defeat the Keloid, then return to <destination>.
units.italian: Avendo rifiutato il tributo, il capo della Legione di Scar ti ha sfidato a un duello all'ultimo sangue. Sconfiggi il Keloid, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|You've located the Scar's Hideout, a massive asteroid in orbit around a gas giant. As you fly over the asteroid's surface, you spot an open blast door. They must be inviting you inside. It surprises you that a gang of pirates would be capable of creating such a base, as the materials and time needed to make something like this are immense.|1226|0
units.english: You've located the Scar's Hideout, a massive asteroid in orbit around a gas giant. As you fly over the asteroid's surface, you spot an open blast door. They must be inviting you inside. It surprises you that a gang of pirates would be capable of creating such a base, as the materials and time needed to make something like this are immense.
units.italian: Hai localizzato il Covo di Scar, un enorme asteroide in orbita attorno a un gigante gassoso. Mentre sorvoli la superficie dell'asteroide, scorgi un portello a tenuta aperto. Devono invitarti a entrare. Ti sorprende che una banda di pirati sia capace di creare una base del genere, perché i materiali e il tempo necessari per fare una cosa simile sono enormi.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	Upon entering the blast door, it closes behind you, leaving you in complete dark. Suddenly, floodlights flash on all around your ship. The brightness of the lights prevents you from seeing anyone beyond them, but you suspect that there are a number of weapons pointed at your ship right now.|1227|0
units.english: Upon entering the blast door, it closes behind you, leaving you in complete dark. Suddenly, floodlights flash on all around your ship. The brightness of the lights prevents you from seeing anyone beyond them, but you suspect that there are a number of weapons pointed at your ship right now.
units.italian: Entrando dal portello, questo si chiude dietro di te, lasciandoti nel buio completo. All'improvviso si accendono dei riflettori tutto intorno alla nave. La luminosità ti impedisce di vedere chi ci sia oltre, ma sospetti che ci siano numerose armi puntate contro la tua nave in questo momento.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"Who are you and what do you want?" a voice booms from a loud speaker. You press a button to activate your ship's external speakers.|1228|0
units.english: "Who are you and what do you want?" a voice booms from a loud speaker. You press a button to activate your ship's external speakers.
units.italian: "Chi sei e cosa vuoi?" tuona una voce da un altoparlante. Premi un pulsante per attivare gli altoparlanti esterni della nave.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"I'm <first> <last>, here to negotiate on behalf of the Hai."|1230|0
units.english: "I'm <first> <last>, here to negotiate on behalf of the Hai."
units.italian: "Sono <first> <last>, qui per negoziare a nome degli Hai."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"I'm <first> <last>, here to take this gang down."|1232|0
units.english: "I'm <first> <last>, here to take this gang down."
units.italian: "Sono <first> <last>, qui per abbattere questa banda."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	The voice laughs. "Well too bad, because you're right in the middle of a hornet's nest. Fire, boys!"|1233|0
units.english: The voice laughs. "Well too bad, because you're right in the middle of a hornet's nest. Fire, boys!"
units.italian: La voce ride. "Peggio per te, perché sei proprio in mezzo a un vespaio. Fuoco, ragazzi!"

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	The voice laughs. "Ah, yes. Those squirrels. I take it they've had enough of us plundering their systems. Boys!"|1237|0
units.english: The voice laughs. "Ah, yes. Those squirrels. I take it they've had enough of us plundering their systems. Boys!"
units.italian: La voce ride. "Ah, sì. Quegli scoiattoli. Immagino che ne abbiano abbastanza delle nostre razzie nei loro sistemi. Ragazzi!"

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	The floodlights turn off, revealing a large room with what must be hundreds of pirates with guns of various sizes trained on your ship. One wrong move and you're toast. "Please, Captain. Step out of your ship."|1238|0
units.english: The floodlights turn off, revealing a large room with what must be hundreds of pirates with guns of various sizes trained on your ship. One wrong move and you're toast. "Please, Captain. Step out of your ship."
units.italian: I riflettori si spengono, rivelando una grande sala con quella che dev'essere centinaia di pirati con armi di varie dimensioni puntate sulla tua nave. Un passo falso e sei finito. "Per favore, capitano. Scenda dalla nave."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	(Comply with the orders.)|1240|0
units.english: (Comply with the orders.)
units.italian: (Obbedisci agli ordini.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	(Attempt to escape.)|1242|0
units.english: (Attempt to escape.)
units.italian: (Prova a fuggire.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	You activate your ship's engines to escape. The floodlights suddenly reactivate.|1243|0
units.english: You activate your ship's engines to escape. The floodlights suddenly reactivate.
units.italian: Attivi i motori della nave per fuggire. I riflettori si riaccendono all'improvviso.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	Before you can even react, several dozen lasers and streams of bullets come flying out from behind the floodlights. You attempt to pull your ship up and fly straight through the ceiling before your ship is too damaged to move, but then you spot a number of rockets flying straight at your cockpit. You die instantly as the rockets impact the glass in front of you.|1246|0
units.english: Before you can even react, several dozen lasers and streams of bullets come flying out from behind the floodlights. You attempt to pull your ship up and fly straight through the ceiling before your ship is too damaged to move, but then you spot a number of rockets flying straight at your cockpit. You die instantly as the rockets impact the glass in front of you.
units.italian: Prima ancora che tu possa reagire, dozzine di laser e raffiche di proiettili arrivano da dietro i riflettori. Cerchi di alzare la nave e volare dritto attraverso il soffitto prima che sia troppo danneggiata per muoversi, ma poi vedi numerosi razzi volare dritti verso la cabina. Muori all'istante quando i razzi colpiscono il vetro davanti a te.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	You step out of your ship, and a tall man with a scar across his cheek steps forward from the crowd of pirates, presumably the leader of the gang.|1250|0
units.english: You step out of your ship, and a tall man with a scar across his cheek steps forward from the crowd of pirates, presumably the leader of the gang.
units.italian: Scendi dalla nave, e un uomo alto con una cicatrice sulla guancia si fa avanti dalla folla di pirati, presumibilmente il capo della banda.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems."|1252|0
units.english: "The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems."
units.italian: "Gli Hai chiedono che smettiate di attaccare i loro sistemi."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"You must be Scar."|1254|0
units.english: "You must be Scar."
units.italian: "Tu devi essere Scar."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"No. Scar is long dead," the leader says.|1255|0
units.english: "No. Scar is long dead," the leader says.
units.italian: "No. Scar è morto da tempo," dice il capo.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"Oh, so does that make you Scab?"|1257|0
units.english: "Oh, so does that make you Scab?"
units.italian: "Oh, quindi questo ti rende Crosta?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems."|1258|0
units.english: "The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems."
units.italian: "Gli Hai chiedono che smettiate di attaccare i loro sistemi."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	The leader grimaces. "I'll cut your tongue out if you don't watch your mouth."|1260|0
units.english: The leader grimaces. "I'll cut your tongue out if you don't watch your mouth."
units.italian: Il capo fa una smorfia. "Ti taglio la lingua se non badi a come parli."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	You take a step back. "The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems," you say, attempting not to get shanked.|1261|0
units.english: You take a step back. "The Hai ask that you stop attacking their systems," you say, attempting not to get shanked.
units.italian: Fai un passo indietro. "Gli Hai chiedono che smettiate di attaccare i loro sistemi," dici, cercando di non farti pugnalare.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"Perhaps we will stop," the leader says with a smile. "Under one condition. We'd like a one time shipment of various Hai weapons and technology. The shipment should be as big as possible. I've seen the freighters those aliens have. They're massive. Load two or three up with the goods and we'll consider focusing our attention elsewhere."|1264|0
units.english: "Perhaps we will stop," the leader says with a smile. "Under one condition. We'd like a one time shipment of various Hai weapons and technology. The shipment should be as big as possible. I've seen the freighters those aliens have. They're massive. Load two or three up with the goods and we'll consider focusing our attention elsewhere."
units.italian: "Forse smetteremo," dice il capo con un sorriso. "A una condizione. Vogliamo una spedizione una tantum di varie armi e tecnologie Hai. La spedizione dovrà essere il più grande possibile. Ho visto i mercantili che hanno quegli alieni. Sono enormi. Caricane due o tre con la merce e considereremo l'idea di concentrarci altrove."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"Okay. I'll meet with the Hai and see what they can provide."|1266|0
units.english: "Okay. I'll meet with the Hai and see what they can provide."
units.italian: "Va bene. Mi incontrerò con gli Hai e vedrò cosa possono fornire."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"I'm afraid that I can't allow that."|1268|0
units.english: "I'm afraid that I can't allow that."
units.italian: "Temo che non possa permetterlo."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	The crowd of pirates response with a cacophony of jeers and boos. The leader raises his fist in the air, and the crowd falls silent. "Well I'm afraid that just won't do."|1269|0
units.english: The crowd of pirates response with a cacophony of jeers and boos. The leader raises his fist in the air, and the crowd falls silent. "Well I'm afraid that just won't do."
units.italian: La folla di pirati risponde con una cacofonia di fischi e sberleffi. Il capo alza il pugno, e la folla ammutolisce. "Beh, temo che così non vada bene."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	The leader paces back and forth in silence for a moment. "Well if we don't get what we want, then we're just going to need to keep on attacking. Which means that your presence here is pretty useless."|1270|0
units.english: The leader paces back and forth in silence for a moment. "Well if we don't get what we want, then we're just going to need to keep on attacking. Which means that your presence here is pretty useless."
units.italian: Il capo va avanti e indietro in silenzio per un momento. "Beh, se non otteniamo quello che vogliamo, dovremo semplicemente continuare ad attaccare. Il che significa che la tua presenza qui è piuttosto inutile."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	The leader turns to the crowd. "How about a fight? To the death!" The crowd erupts in cheers. The leader turns back to you. "We fight in this system only. Just you and me. You attempt to run, my men hunt you down. How's that sound?" You attempt to respond, but before you can, the leader pulls his gun and aims it at you. "Run."|1271|0
units.english: The leader turns to the crowd. "How about a fight? To the death!" The crowd erupts in cheers. The leader turns back to you. "We fight in this system only. Just you and me. You attempt to run, my men hunt you down. How's that sound?" You attempt to respond, but before you can, the leader pulls his gun and aims it at you. "Run."
units.italian: Il capo si volta verso la folla. "Che ne dite di un combattimento? All'ultimo sangue!" La folla esplode in acclamazioni. Il capo si volta di nuovo verso di te. "Combattiamo solo in questo sistema. Solo tu e io. Se cerchi di scappare, i miei uomini ti danno la caccia. Che ne dici?" Cerchi di rispondere, ma prima che tu possa, il capo estrae la pistola e la punta su di te. "Corri."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|	"Excellent!" the pirate says, which is met with cheers from the rest of the pirates in the room. "But make it quick. Wouldn't want to keep us waiting." The blast doors reopen, and you return to your ship to leave immediately.|1275|0
units.english: "Excellent!" the pirate says, which is met with cheers from the rest of the pirates in the room. "But make it quick. Wouldn't want to keep us waiting." The blast doors reopen, and you return to your ship to leave immediately.
units.italian: "Eccellente!" dice il pirata, accolto dalle acclamazioni del resto dei pirati nella sala. "Ma fai in fretta. Non vorremmo farci aspettare." I portelli a tenuta si riaprono, e torni alla nave per partire subito.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [3]|dialog|1287|0
units.english: You've defeated the leader of Scar's Legion. The various spectators to the fight aren't attacking you, but it may only be a matter of time before they decide to turn their guns on you for killing their leader. Better head to <destination> before that happens.
units.italian: Hai sconfitto il capo della Legione di Scar. I vari spettatori del combattimento non ti stanno attaccando, ma potrebbe essere solo questione di tempo prima che decidano di puntarti le armi per aver ucciso il loro capo. Meglio dirigersi su <destination> prima che accada.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|name|1310|0
units.english: Pirate Tribute
units.italian: Tributo ai pirati

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|description|1311|0
units.english: Escort the three Hai freighters carrying Hai weapons and technology to <stopovers>, then escort the freighters back to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta i tre mercantili Hai che trasportano armi e tecnologia Hai fino a <stopovers>, poi scorta i mercantili di ritorno su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|Upon landing on <origin>, the Hai authorities give you <payment> for your assistance in defending their systems and for helping to track down the culprits. You're sent to the council of elders, the elected ruling body of the Hai, to tell them about Scar's Legion. "Please, tell us what has occurred," one of the elders says.|1327|0
units.english: Upon landing on <origin>, the Hai authorities give you <payment> for your assistance in defending their systems and for helping to track down the culprits. You're sent to the council of elders, the elected ruling body of the Hai, to tell them about Scar's Legion. "Please, tell us what has occurred," one of the elders says.
units.italian: Atterrando su <origin>, le autorità Hai ti danno <payment> per il tuo aiuto nel difendere i loro sistemi e nel rintracciare i colpevoli. Vieni inviato al consiglio degli anziani, l'organo di governo eletto degli Hai, per raccontare della Legione di Scar. "Per favore, ci dica cosa è accaduto," dice uno degli anziani.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"They asked that you load three large freighters with various weapons and technology to give to them. Only then will they stop attacking you."|1331|0
units.english: "They asked that you load three large freighters with various weapons and technology to give to them. Only then will they stop attacking you."
units.italian: "Hanno chiesto che carichiate tre grandi mercantili con varie armi e tecnologie da dare a loro. Solo allora smetteranno di attaccarvi."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"A simple request," the elders says. "Little more than what the Unfettered ask of us. We shall load three Geocoris immediately."|1332|0
units.english: "A simple request," the elders says. "Little more than what the Unfettered ask of us. We shall load three Geocoris immediately."
units.italian: "Una richiesta semplice," dice l'anziano. "Poco più di quanto ci chiedono gli Slegati. Caricheremo subito tre Geocoris."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"Who is to say that they will not use our own weapons against us?" another elder chimes in. "This deal could only hurt us."|1333|0
units.english: "Who is to say that they will not use our own weapons against us?" another elder chimes in. "This deal could only hurt us."
units.italian: "Chi ci dice che non useranno le nostre stesse armi contro di noi?" interviene un altro anziano. "Questo accordo può solo farci male."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"There's no guarantee that they will not attack again, but they promised that they would focus elsewhere."|1335|0
units.english: "There's no guarantee that they will not attack again, but they promised that they would focus elsewhere."
units.italian: "Non c'è garanzia che non attacchino di nuovo, ma hanno promesso che si concentreranno altrove."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"I could return to them and defeat them if you desire."|1337|0
units.english: "I could return to them and defeat them if you desire."
units.italian: "Posso tornare da loro e sconfiggerli, se volete."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"No," says the elder. "We are not interested in condemning these humans to death if all they ask is for technology."|1338|0
units.english: "No," says the elder. "We are not interested in condemning these humans to death if all they ask is for technology."
units.italian: "No," dice l'anziano. "Non ci interessa condannare a morte questi umani se tutto ciò che chiedono è tecnologia."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"I believe a bigger issue here is how this will impact our human friends beyond the wormhole," an elder says. "If these pirates are not attacking us, then who will they be attacking? Will we not simply become weapons dealers for a far off war?"|1341|0
units.english: "I believe a bigger issue here is how this will impact our human friends beyond the wormhole," an elder says. "If these pirates are not attacking us, then who will they be attacking? Will we not simply become weapons dealers for a far off war?"
units.italian: "Credo che una questione più grande sia come questo influirà sui nostri amici umani oltre il cunicolo," dice un anziano. "Se questi pirati non attaccano noi, chi attaccheranno? Non diventeremo semplicemente fornitori di armi per una guerra lontana?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"We will inform the Republic Navy that we are providing these pirates with our technology for our own sake. They have been capable of combating our technology in the past. I am sure that they will be able to handle it now. Please, <first>, escort the freighters to these pirates so that they may leave us alone."|1342|0
units.english: "We will inform the Republic Navy that we are providing these pirates with our technology for our own sake. They have been capable of combating our technology in the past. I am sure that they will be able to handle it now. Please, <first>, escort the freighters to these pirates so that they may leave us alone."
units.italian: "Informeremo la Marina della Repubblica che forniamo la nostra tecnologia a questi pirati per il nostro bene. Sono stati capaci di combattere la nostra tecnologia in passato. Sono certo che sapranno gestirla anche ora. Per favore, <first>, scorta i mercantili fino a questi pirati così che ci lascino in pace."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"I defeated the leader of Scar's Legion. They shouldn't cause any more trouble for you now."|1346|0
units.english: "I defeated the leader of Scar's Legion. They shouldn't cause any more trouble for you now."
units.italian: "Ho sconfitto il capo della Legione di Scar. Non dovrebbero più crearvi problemi."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	One of the elders frowns. "Did you kill their leader in cold blood, or was it self defense?"|1347|0
units.english: One of the elders frowns. "Did you kill their leader in cold blood, or was it self defense?"
units.italian: Uno degli anziani si acciglia. "Ha ucciso il loro capo a sangue freddo, o è stata legittima difesa?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"They asked for a tribute of your weapons and technology, but I refused the offer, so they attacked me."|1349|0
units.english: "They asked for a tribute of your weapons and technology, but I refused the offer, so they attacked me."
units.italian: "Chiedevano un tributo delle vostre armi e tecnologie, ma ho rifiutato l'offerta, così mi hanno attaccato."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"They were not willing to negotiate, and I was forced to defend myself."|1351|0
units.english: "They were not willing to negotiate, and I was forced to defend myself."
units.italian: "Non erano disposti a negoziare, e sono stato costretto a difendermi."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"This is most unfortunate," another elder says. "But I am happy to hear that they will not cause any more loss of life among our people."|1352|0
units.english: "This is most unfortunate," another elder says. "But I am happy to hear that they will not cause any more loss of life among our people."
units.italian: "È molto spiacevole," dice un altro anziano. "Ma sono felice di sapere che non causeranno altre perdite di vite tra la nostra gente."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"This is most unfortunate," another elder says. "We would have been willing to provide them the technology they sought if only they had asked nicely in the first place."|1356|0
units.english: "This is most unfortunate," another elder says. "We would have been willing to provide them the technology they sought if only they had asked nicely in the first place."
units.italian: "È molto spiacevole," dice un altro anziano. "Saremmo stati disposti a dare loro la tecnologia che cercavano, se solo l'avessero chiesta con le buone fin dall'inizio."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	"Better that we eliminate a threat instead of making them stronger through becoming their weapons dealer," the first elder says. "These pirates might have attacked us with our own technology, or worse still, attacked other humans with them, making us complicit in this slaughter."|1357|0
units.english: "Better that we eliminate a threat instead of making them stronger through becoming their weapons dealer," the first elder says. "These pirates might have attacked us with our own technology, or worse still, attacked other humans with them, making us complicit in this slaughter."
units.italian: "Meglio eliminare una minaccia invece di renderla più forte diventando i loro fornitori di armi," dice il primo anziano. "Questi pirati avrebbero potuto attaccarci con la nostra stessa tecnologia o, peggio, attaccare altri umani con essa, rendendoci complici di quel massacro."

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|	The elders thank you for your assistance in this situation and send you on your way.|1360|0
units.english: The elders thank you for your assistance in this situation and send you on your way.
units.italian: Gli anziani ti ringraziano per l'aiuto in questa situazione e ti congedano.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|dialog|1380|0
units.english: You lead the Hai freighters into the blast doors. Despite the massive size of the freighters, they all manage to fit into the asteroid's spaceport with some room to spare, a testament to how much work was put into this base. The pirates of Scar's Legion unload all the Hai technology from the freighters. After the last crate is gone, the freighters quickly launch from the asteroid.
units.italian: Guidi i mercantili Hai dentro i portelli a tenuta. Nonostante le dimensioni enormi dei mercantili, riescono tutti a entrare nello spazioporto dell'asteroide con un po' di spazio avanzato, prova di quanto lavoro sia stato messo in questa base. I pirati della Legione di Scar scaricano tutta la tecnologia Hai dai mercantili. Dopo che l'ultima cassa è sparita, i mercantili decollano in fretta dall'asteroide.

units.id: mission:Pirate Troubles [4]|dialog|1392|0
units.english: With the freighters safely returned, the Hai thank you for resolving the situation with Scar's Legion and hand you <payment> for your help.
units.italian: Con i mercantili tornati sani e salvi, gli Hai ti ringraziano per aver risolto la faccenda con la Legione di Scar e ti consegnano <payment> per il tuo aiuto.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|name|1397|0
units.english: Escort Nanachi to <planet>
units.italian: Scorta Nanachi su <planet>

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|description|1398|0
units.english: Help Nanachi, a Hai who just bought her first ship, make a simple delivery to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Aiuta Nanachi, una Hai che ha appena comprato la sua prima nave, a fare una semplice consegna su <destination> entro il <date>.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|As you are making your way through the spaceport you notice a worried-looking Hai staring at the local job board and back at some sort of document they are holding.|1410|0
units.english: As you are making your way through the spaceport you notice a worried-looking Hai staring at the local job board and back at some sort of document they are holding.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto noti una Hai dall'aria preoccupata che guarda la bacheca delle offerte di lavoro e poi un documento che tiene in mano.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	(Approach the Hai.)|1412|0
units.english: (Approach the Hai.)
units.italian: (Avvicina la Hai.)

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	(Leave them alone.)|1413|0
units.english: (Leave them alone.)
units.italian: (Lasciala stare.)

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	The Hai is a bit startled, but quickly calms down. "Sorry, you caught me by surprise. I've just bought my first ship and need to find some jobs to do, but nobody I've talked to wants to trust a beginner captain. I just don't know what to do anymore, I've been working for so long to qualify for this loan, but I'm running out of time and I'll never be able to pay it like this."|1415|0
units.english: The Hai is a bit startled, but quickly calms down. "Sorry, you caught me by surprise. I've just bought my first ship and need to find some jobs to do, but nobody I've talked to wants to trust a beginner captain. I just don't know what to do anymore, I've been working for so long to qualify for this loan, but I'm running out of time and I'll never be able to pay it like this."
units.italian: La Hai trasalisce un po', ma si calma in fretta. "Scusa, mi hai colta di sorpresa. Ho appena comprato la mia prima nave e devo trovare qualche lavoro, ma nessuno con cui ho parlato vuole fidarsi di una capitana principiante. Non so più cosa fare, ho lavorato così tanto per qualificarmi per questo prestito, ma il tempo sta per scadere e così non riuscirò mai a pagarlo."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	Turns out the documents she is holding are the bank papers for the loan, somewhat similar to the one you took when you bought your first ship. You've come a long way since your days as a beginner, and know how hard it is to be starting out as a starship captain; you could probably convince someone here to offer a simple cargo job to this young Hai.|1416|0
units.english: Turns out the documents she is holding are the bank papers for the loan, somewhat similar to the one you took when you bought your first ship. You've come a long way since your days as a beginner, and know how hard it is to be starting out as a starship captain; you could probably convince someone here to offer a simple cargo job to this young Hai.
units.italian: Scopri che i documenti che tiene in mano sono le carte bancarie del prestito, in parte simili a quelle che firmasti tu quando comprasti la tua prima nave. Hai fatto molta strada dai tuoi giorni da principiante, e sai quanto sia difficile iniziare come capitano di astronave; probabilmente potresti convincere qualcuno qui a offrire un semplice lavoro di trasporto a questa giovane Hai.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	"If you're interested, I could try to help you find a job."|1418|0
units.english: "If you're interested, I could try to help you find a job."
units.italian: "Se ti interessa, potrei provare ad aiutarti a trovare un lavoro."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	"I've been there before; trust me, it gets better. I wish you the best of luck on finding a job."|1420|0
units.english: "I've been there before; trust me, it gets better. I wish you the best of luck on finding a job."
units.italian: "Ci sono passato anch'io; credimi, migliora. Ti auguro buona fortuna nella ricerca di un lavoro."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	She nods in sad understanding, and continues to swap focus from the job board to the papers in her hand.|1421|0
units.english: She nods in sad understanding, and continues to swap focus from the job board to the papers in her hand.
units.italian: Annuisce con triste comprensione, e continua a passare lo sguardo dalla bacheca alle carte che tiene in mano.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	(Help her out anyway.)|1423|0
units.english: (Help her out anyway.)
units.italian: (Aiutala comunque.)

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	(Leave her alone and continue on.)|1425|0
units.english: (Leave her alone and continue on.)
units.italian: (Lasciala stare e continua.)

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|label|1427|0
units.english: positive1
units.italian: positive1

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	Her ears twitch a bit, and her previously crestfallen eyes light up as she nearly jumps in joy at your offer. "Thank you so much Captain! My name is Nanachi, I promise I won't cause any trouble at all, just a few quick jobs and I'm sure I'll be fine by myself!"|1428|0
units.english: Her ears twitch a bit, and her previously crestfallen eyes light up as she nearly jumps in joy at your offer. "Thank you so much Captain! My name is Nanachi, I promise I won't cause any trouble at all, just a few quick jobs and I'm sure I'll be fine by myself!"
units.italian: Le sue orecchie si muovono un po', e i suoi occhi prima abbattuti si illuminano mentre quasi salta di gioia alla tua offerta. "Grazie mille, capitano! Mi chiamo Nanachi, prometto che non causerò nessun problema, solo qualche lavoro veloce e sono sicura che me la caverò da sola!"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	You introduce yourself to Nanachi and shake her paw. "Can you show me your ship so I can look for jobs it's best suited for?" you ask.|1429|0
units.english: You introduce yourself to Nanachi and shake her paw. "Can you show me your ship so I can look for jobs it's best suited for?" you ask.
units.italian: Ti presenti a Nanachi e le stringi la zampa. "Puoi mostrarmi la tua nave così cerco i lavori più adatti?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	She hesitates a bit, but leads you to her ship. You were expecting a small Hai ship, but to your surprise she shows you a rather beat-up Heavy Shuttle docked near your own ship.|1430|0
units.english: She hesitates a bit, but leads you to her ship. You were expecting a small Hai ship, but to your surprise she shows you a rather beat-up Heavy Shuttle docked near your own ship.
units.italian: Esita un po', ma ti porta alla sua nave. Ti aspettavi una piccola nave Hai, ma con tua sorpresa ti mostra un Heavy Shuttle piuttosto malconcio attraccato vicino alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	"You took a loan to buy a human ship?" you ask.|1431|0
units.english: "You took a loan to buy a human ship?" you ask.
units.italian: "Hai preso un prestito per comprare una nave umana?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	She looks at the ground, as if ashamed of it. "It'd take way too long for me to qualify for a loan for even an Aphid, but I recently met a human merchant who wanted to sell his old ship; it was difficult, but I managed to convince him to sell it to me instead of going to the shipyard office. I paid him its full price, but even for this one I had to take out the biggest loan I could. Its cargo hold isn't very impressive but it has more bunks than our smallest ships, if that helps."|1432|0
units.english: She looks at the ground, as if ashamed of it. "It'd take way too long for me to qualify for a loan for even an Aphid, but I recently met a human merchant who wanted to sell his old ship; it was difficult, but I managed to convince him to sell it to me instead of going to the shipyard office. I paid him its full price, but even for this one I had to take out the biggest loan I could. Its cargo hold isn't very impressive but it has more bunks than our smallest ships, if that helps."
units.italian: Guarda a terra, come se se ne vergognasse. "Ci vorrebbe troppo tempo per qualificarmi per un prestito anche solo per un Aphid, ma di recente ho conosciuto un mercante umano che voleva vendere la sua vecchia nave; è stato difficile, ma sono riuscita a convincerlo a venderla a me invece di andare all'ufficio del cantiere. L'ho pagata a prezzo pieno, ma anche per questa ho dovuto prendere il prestito più grande che potevo. La stiva non è granché, ma ha più cuccette delle nostre navi più piccole, se può servire."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	"Let's see if anyone in the spaceport needs a lift off the planet."|1434|0
units.english: "Let's see if anyone in the spaceport needs a lift off the planet."
units.italian: "Vediamo se qualcuno nello spazioporto ha bisogno di un passaggio fuori dal pianeta."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	"Let's take another look at the job board, maybe a smaller job will pop up."|1435|0
units.english: "Let's take another look at the job board, maybe a smaller job will pop up."
units.italian: "Diamo un'altra occhiata alla bacheca, magari salta fuori un lavoro più piccolo."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	Turns out this isn't as easy as you thought it'd be. The spaceport is almost empty, save for the occasional worker or drunken crew member, and the job board is filled with massive hauls of minerals, aside from a few small but dangerous jobs to human space. Eventually, as you two begin scouting the edge of the docking area, you spot a troubled human merchant near several crates. You approach him and he explains that his ship had some malfunctions and he cannot deliver his cargo of advanced surgical equipment to <destination>. "This is the worst! One jump away from the planet and the navigation system suddenly decides to go on strike! There's no way I can make it before the deadline!"|1436|0
units.english: Turns out this isn't as easy as you thought it'd be. The spaceport is almost empty, save for the occasional worker or drunken crew member, and the job board is filled with massive hauls of minerals, aside from a few small but dangerous jobs to human space. Eventually, as you two begin scouting the edge of the docking area, you spot a troubled human merchant near several crates. You approach him and he explains that his ship had some malfunctions and he cannot deliver his cargo of advanced surgical equipment to <destination>. "This is the worst! One jump away from the planet and the navigation system suddenly decides to go on strike! There's no way I can make it before the deadline!"
units.italian: Scopri che non è facile come pensavi. Lo spazioporto è quasi vuoto, a parte qualche operaio o membro d'equipaggio ubriaco, e la bacheca è piena di enormi carichi di minerali, oltre a qualche lavoro piccolo ma pericoloso verso lo spazio umano. Alla fine, mentre cominciate a perlustrare il bordo dell'area di attracco, notate un mercante umano in difficoltà vicino a diverse casse. Ti avvicini e ti spiega che la sua nave ha avuto dei malfunzionamenti e non può consegnare il suo carico di attrezzature chirurgiche avanzate su <destination>. "È il colmo! A un salto dal pianeta e il sistema di navigazione decide di scioperare! Non c'è modo che ce la faccia prima della scadenza!"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	"My friend Nanachi here could deliver it for you. We were heading there anyway; a few extra crates won't make a difference," you say, trying to sound as convincing as possible.|1437|0
units.english: "My friend Nanachi here could deliver it for you. We were heading there anyway; a few extra crates won't make a difference," you say, trying to sound as convincing as possible.
units.italian: "La mia amica Nanachi qui potrebbe consegnarlo per te. Stavamo andando lì comunque; qualche cassa in più non fa differenza," dici, cercando di sembrare il più convincente possibile.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	At first, he seems delighted that you two want to help him, but when Nanachi mentions that she's flying a Heavy Shuttle, he frowns, and looks back at the cargo. "Unfettered attacks make it so they need tons of medical supplies on <planet>, and quite frankly I'm not comfortable letting such a fragile ship go into dangerous territory carrying this equipment when it could be blasted to bits in an instant," he says. The captain glances around the deserted spaceport for a while, as if trying to find some other captain, before finally turning to Nanachi and saying, "but I guess beggars can't be choosers. Fine, I'll let you take the cargo there, but please be very careful."|1438|0
units.english: At first, he seems delighted that you two want to help him, but when Nanachi mentions that she's flying a Heavy Shuttle, he frowns, and looks back at the cargo. "Unfettered attacks make it so they need tons of medical supplies on <planet>, and quite frankly I'm not comfortable letting such a fragile ship go into dangerous territory carrying this equipment when it could be blasted to bits in an instant," he says. The captain glances around the deserted spaceport for a while, as if trying to find some other captain, before finally turning to Nanachi and saying, "but I guess beggars can't be choosers. Fine, I'll let you take the cargo there, but please be very careful."
units.italian: All'inizio sembra felice che vogliate aiutarlo, ma quando Nanachi accenna che sta pilotando un Heavy Shuttle, si acciglia e guarda di nuovo il carico. "Gli attacchi degli Slegati fanno sì che su <planet> servano tonnellate di forniture mediche, e francamente non mi sento a mio agio a mandare una nave così fragile in territorio pericoloso con queste attrezzature, quando potrebbe essere fatta a pezzi in un istante," dice. Il capitano si guarda intorno nello spazioporto deserto per un po', come cercando un altro capitano, prima di voltarsi finalmente verso Nanachi e dire: "ma immagino che chi non può scegliere si accontenti. Va bene, ti lascio portare il carico, ma per favore sii molto prudente."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|dialog|1446|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left Nanachi's ship behind! Better depart and wait for her to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave di Nanachi! Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|Shortly after her ship lands, you meet up with Nanachi, who is doing her best to hide her excitement at being on another planet for the first time, and is gawking at some Hai military ships in particular. "So, how did you like your first time doing a hyperspace jump?" you ask, to try and snap her out of it.|1449|0
units.english: Shortly after her ship lands, you meet up with Nanachi, who is doing her best to hide her excitement at being on another planet for the first time, and is gawking at some Hai military ships in particular. "So, how did you like your first time doing a hyperspace jump?" you ask, to try and snap her out of it.
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio della sua nave, ti incontri con Nanachi, che fa del suo meglio per nascondere l'entusiasmo di essere per la prima volta su un altro pianeta e fissa a bocca aperta soprattutto alcune navi militari Hai. "Allora, com'è stato il tuo primo salto nell'iperspazio?" chiedi, per cercare di riportarla alla realtà.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	"Oh um, I don't think I'll get used to the feeling anytime soon. I threw up a lot so I'm glad this wasn't a job with passengers. I've always dreamt of being on other worlds, exploring and learning everything about them. I'm glad I'm finally able to do it."|1450|0
units.english: "Oh um, I don't think I'll get used to the feeling anytime soon. I threw up a lot so I'm glad this wasn't a job with passengers. I've always dreamt of being on other worlds, exploring and learning everything about them. I'm glad I'm finally able to do it."
units.italian: "Oh, ehm, non credo che mi abituerò presto a quella sensazione. Ho vomitato parecchio, quindi sono contenta che non fosse un lavoro con passeggeri. Ho sempre sognato di stare su altri mondi, esplorare e imparare tutto di loro. Sono contenta di poterlo fare finalmente."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	You help her get the crates out of the cargo hold and contact the client. Nanachi's share of the payment is small, as the client transfers most of the money to the merchant she got the job from, but that doesn't make her any less excited about getting her first paycheck.|1451|0
units.english: You help her get the crates out of the cargo hold and contact the client. Nanachi's share of the payment is small, as the client transfers most of the money to the merchant she got the job from, but that doesn't make her any less excited about getting her first paycheck.
units.italian: La aiuti a tirare fuori le casse dalla stiva e contatti il cliente. La parte di Nanachi del pagamento è piccola, dato che il cliente trasferisce la maggior parte del denaro al mercante da cui ha preso il lavoro, ma questo non la rende meno entusiasta del suo primo stipendio.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	"So, want to go to the spaceport and try to get a job on your own? I'll help you again in case you can't do it yet." you say.|1452|0
units.english: "So, want to go to the spaceport and try to get a job on your own? I'll help you again in case you can't do it yet." you say.
units.italian: "Allora, vuoi andare allo spazioporto e provare a trovare un lavoro da sola? Ti aiuterò di nuovo se non ci riesci ancora," dici.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	"Just give me an hour or two to explore. Back home our shipyard is kind of small. I've never really gotten a chance to see a Shield Beetle up close, and there are many undergoing repairs here. I'll just go get a better look at them, I swear I'll be quick."|1453|0
units.english: "Just give me an hour or two to explore. Back home our shipyard is kind of small. I've never really gotten a chance to see a Shield Beetle up close, and there are many undergoing repairs here. I'll just go get a better look at them, I swear I'll be quick."
units.italian: "Dammi solo un'ora o due per esplorare. A casa nostra il cantiere è piuttosto piccolo. Non ho mai avuto davvero la possibilità di vedere uno Shield Beetle da vicino, e qui ce ne sono molti in riparazione. Vado solo a darci un'occhiata migliore, giuro che farò in fretta."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 1|	You two agree to meet in the spaceport in a few hours; maybe this time she will do fine on her own.|1454|0
units.english: You two agree to meet in the spaceport in a few hours; maybe this time she will do fine on her own.
units.italian: Concordate di incontrarvi allo spazioporto tra qualche ora; forse questa volta se la caverà da sola.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|name|1459|0
units.english: Escort Nanachi to <planet>
units.italian: Scorta Nanachi su <planet>

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|description|1460|0
units.english: Bring Nanachi and her passengers to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta Nanachi e i suoi passeggeri su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|You meet up with Nanachi in the spaceport, give her some tips to try and persuade someone into hiring her, and tell her you'll be nearby if she still has trouble getting a job. You watch her go around the spaceport and approach some groups of humans and even other Hai to no avail. Maybe since this is a world seeing combat often, they're too busy with military related activities to help a new pilot. She manages to grab the attention of a Hai family leaving a restaurant carrying way too much luggage, most likely tourists looking for a ride back home. Everything seems to be going well until the parents start to look worried. It seems as if they might go away if you don't step in.|1468|0
units.english: You meet up with Nanachi in the spaceport, give her some tips to try and persuade someone into hiring her, and tell her you'll be nearby if she still has trouble getting a job. You watch her go around the spaceport and approach some groups of humans and even other Hai to no avail. Maybe since this is a world seeing combat often, they're too busy with military related activities to help a new pilot. She manages to grab the attention of a Hai family leaving a restaurant carrying way too much luggage, most likely tourists looking for a ride back home. Everything seems to be going well until the parents start to look worried. It seems as if they might go away if you don't step in.
units.italian: Ti incontri con Nanachi allo spazioporto, le dai qualche consiglio per cercare di convincere qualcuno ad assumerla e le dici che sarai nei paraggi se ha ancora problemi a trovare un lavoro. La guardi girare per lo spazioporto e avvicinare alcuni gruppi di umani e persino altri Hai, senza successo. Forse, dato che questo è un mondo che vede spesso combattimenti, sono troppo occupati con attività militari per aiutare una pilota novizia. Riesce ad attirare l'attenzione di una famiglia Hai che esce da un ristorante con bagagli fin troppo numerosi, probabilmente turisti in cerca di un passaggio a casa. Tutto sembra andare bene finché i genitori non cominciano a sembrare preoccupati. Sembra che se ne andrebbero se tu non intervenissi.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|	You walk over to the group to help her, and get a better look at the family: a Hai couple carrying a baby, and three older children who aren't doing much to help their father carry their ludicrous number of bags.|1469|0
units.english: You walk over to the group to help her, and get a better look at the family: a Hai couple carrying a baby, and three older children who aren't doing much to help their father carry their ludicrous number of bags.
units.italian: Ti avvicini al gruppo per aiutarla e osservi meglio la famiglia: una coppia Hai con un neonato e tre figli più grandi che non fanno molto per aiutare il padre a portare il loro numero ridicolo di borse.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|	"Hey, what's going on?"|1471|0
units.english: "Hey, what's going on?"
units.italian: "Ehi, cosa succede?"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|	"Can I be of assistance?"|1472|0
units.english: "Can I be of assistance?"
units.italian: "Posso essere d'aiuto?"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|	You introduce yourself and the parents tell you that they've been on vacation here and need transport back to <destination>. "Don't take this the wrong way, but Captain Nanachi told us her ship is one of your human ships, a Heavy Shuttle was it? It has enough bunks for us but our sons already caused a ruckus on the way here in a Hai ship, we're worried that since they aren't used to the accommodations, they might end up giving her too much trouble."|1473|0
units.english: You introduce yourself and the parents tell you that they've been on vacation here and need transport back to <destination>. "Don't take this the wrong way, but Captain Nanachi told us her ship is one of your human ships, a Heavy Shuttle was it? It has enough bunks for us but our sons already caused a ruckus on the way here in a Hai ship, we're worried that since they aren't used to the accommodations, they might end up giving her too much trouble."
units.italian: Ti presenti e i genitori ti dicono che sono stati in vacanza qui e hanno bisogno di un trasporto di ritorno su <destination>. "Non prendertela, ma la capitana Nanachi ci ha detto che la sua nave è una delle vostre navi umane, un Heavy Shuttle, era? Ha abbastanza cuccette per noi, ma i nostri figli hanno già combinato un pandemonio all'andata su una nave Hai, e temiamo che, non essendo abituati all'allestimento, possano finire per darle troppo disturbo."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|	You reassure them that the trip will be very quick, and that the ship's interior is somewhat similar to that of Hai ships, until they finally agree on traveling with her. They settle on the pay and the two of you help the Hai get their baggage to Nanachi's ship. When the family is focused on a conversation, you quietly ask Nanachi what the issue she was having with the other people she encountered.|1474|0
units.english: You reassure them that the trip will be very quick, and that the ship's interior is somewhat similar to that of Hai ships, until they finally agree on traveling with her. They settle on the pay and the two of you help the Hai get their baggage to Nanachi's ship. When the family is focused on a conversation, you quietly ask Nanachi what the issue she was having with the other people she encountered.
units.italian: Li rassicuri che il viaggio sarà molto rapido e che l'interno della nave è in parte simile a quello delle navi Hai, finché alla fine accettano di viaggiare con lei. Concordano la paga e voi due aiutate gli Hai a portare i bagagli sulla nave di Nanachi. Mentre la famiglia è concentrata su una conversazione, chiedi piano a Nanachi quale fosse il problema con le altre persone che ha incontrato.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|	"They all seemed willing to give me a job, but I ended up blowing it when I asked for more money. I just really need to get out of debt so I guess I went a bit overboard." She tries to play it cool, but it's clear that she is embarrassed about losing so many potential jobs. When you reach her ship, you take a look at the prices for commodities in <system>. You decide to tell Nanachi to stock up on heavy metals to sell there, to help her make a bit more profit.|1475|0
units.english: "They all seemed willing to give me a job, but I ended up blowing it when I asked for more money. I just really need to get out of debt so I guess I went a bit overboard." She tries to play it cool, but it's clear that she is embarrassed about losing so many potential jobs. When you reach her ship, you take a look at the prices for commodities in <system>. You decide to tell Nanachi to stock up on heavy metals to sell there, to help her make a bit more profit.
units.italian: "Sembravano tutti disposti a darmi un lavoro, ma ho finito per rovinare tutto quando ho chiesto più soldi. Ho davvero bisogno di uscire dai debiti, quindi credo di essermi spinta un po' troppo." Cerca di fare la disinvolta, ma è chiaro che è imbarazzata per aver perso tanti lavori potenziali. Quando raggiungete la sua nave, dai un'occhiata ai prezzi delle merci su <system>. Decidi di dire a Nanachi di fare scorta di metalli pesanti da vendere lì, per aiutarla a ricavare un po' più di profitto.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|dialog|1483|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left Nanachi's ship behind! Better depart and wait for her to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave di Nanachi! Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|You help the family gather all their luggage and bid them farewell, but right as they disappear into a hallway Nanachi lets out a heavy sigh. "I bit off more than I could chew. Those kids kept wanting to play with the ship's controls, and one of them tried to go up the air vent in a game of hide-and-seek. I couldn't get any rest since I had to keep making sure they weren't about to dump their own bags into the void by accident."|1486|0
units.english: You help the family gather all their luggage and bid them farewell, but right as they disappear into a hallway Nanachi lets out a heavy sigh. "I bit off more than I could chew. Those kids kept wanting to play with the ship's controls, and one of them tried to go up the air vent in a game of hide-and-seek. I couldn't get any rest since I had to keep making sure they weren't about to dump their own bags into the void by accident."
units.italian: Aiuti la famiglia a radunare tutti i bagagli e la saluti, ma proprio mentre spariscono in un corridoio Nanachi emette un sospiro pesante. "Ho preso più di quanto potessi masticare. Quei bambini continuavano a voler giocare con i comandi della nave, e uno di loro ha provato a infilarsi nel condotto di ventilazione in un gioco a nascondino. Non ho potuto riposare perché dovevo continuare a controllare che non stessero per gettare le loro stesse borse nel vuoto per sbaglio."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|	"Do you want to get some sleep before trying to find another mission?" you ask, hoping she won't try to overwork herself.|1487|0
units.english: "Do you want to get some sleep before trying to find another mission?" you ask, hoping she won't try to overwork herself.
units.italian: "Vuoi dormire un po' prima di cercare un'altra missione?" chiedi, sperando che non si metta a lavorare troppo.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 2|	"Yes, I could really use that. Sorry to make you wait again Captain <last>. I'll rest a bit, see if I can't find a spot nearby to relax, and meet up with you in the spaceport after a while."|1488|0
units.english: "Yes, I could really use that. Sorry to make you wait again Captain <last>. I'll rest a bit, see if I can't find a spot nearby to relax, and meet up with you in the spaceport after a while."
units.italian: "Sì, mi servirebbe davvero. Scusa se ti faccio aspettare di nuovo, capitano <last>. Mi riposerò un po', vedrò se trovo un posto qui vicino per rilassarmi, e ci incontriamo allo spazioporto tra un po'."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|name|1493|0
units.english: Deliver spices with Nanachi
units.italian: Consegna spezie con Nanachi

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|description|1494|0
units.english: Accompany Nanachi to <stopovers> to pick up some Quarg spices for a festival on <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Accompagna Nanachi fino a <stopovers> a prendere delle spezie Quarg per una festa su <destination> entro il <date>.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|You send a message to Nanachi and you two meet up in the spaceport. You're still walking toward the job board, when she asks: "Back home I heard stories about how humans have a much larger population than the Hai, and that their home planet has even more people than Hai-home. Is it true that there are many other human worlds with spaceports this large?" You name her a few human planets that are extremely populous, and how even some planets with fewer people than this world have incredibly large spaceports.|1503|0
units.english: You send a message to Nanachi and you two meet up in the spaceport. You're still walking toward the job board, when she asks: "Back home I heard stories about how humans have a much larger population than the Hai, and that their home planet has even more people than Hai-home. Is it true that there are many other human worlds with spaceports this large?" You name her a few human planets that are extremely populous, and how even some planets with fewer people than this world have incredibly large spaceports.
units.italian: Mandi un messaggio a Nanachi e vi incontrate allo spazioporto. State ancora camminando verso la bacheca quando lei chiede: "A casa ho sentito storie su come gli umani abbiano una popolazione molto più grande degli Hai, e che il loro pianeta natale abbia persino più gente di Hai-home. È vero che ci sono molti altri mondi umani con spazioporti così grandi?" Le nomini alcuni pianeti umani estremamente popolosi, e le racconti che persino alcuni pianeti con meno gente di questo mondo hanno spazioporti incredibilmente grandi.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	While you tell her stories of many different planets you've visited, she seems to be particularly interested in Earth. "I've seen a bit of human architecture in videos of planets like Allhome, but I can't even imagine what your capital must look like. Tens of thousands of years of another species' history, it sounds even more exciting than what I heard about our landmarks on Hai-home. Captain, do you think that someday, when we no longer need to be kept hidden from humanity, that I'll be able to visit Earth, and see the beauty of your capital?" Seeing how little she knows about humanity, it's not surprising that she is unaware of the state that Earth is in.|1504|0
units.english: While you tell her stories of many different planets you've visited, she seems to be particularly interested in Earth. "I've seen a bit of human architecture in videos of planets like Allhome, but I can't even imagine what your capital must look like. Tens of thousands of years of another species' history, it sounds even more exciting than what I heard about our landmarks on Hai-home. Captain, do you think that someday, when we no longer need to be kept hidden from humanity, that I'll be able to visit Earth, and see the beauty of your capital?" Seeing how little she knows about humanity, it's not surprising that she is unaware of the state that Earth is in.
units.italian: Mentre le racconti storie dei molti pianeti che hai visitato, sembra particolarmente interessata alla Terra. "Ho visto un po' di architettura umana nei video di pianeti come Allhome, ma non riesco nemmeno a immaginare come debba essere la vostra capitale. Decine di migliaia di anni di storia di un'altra specie, suona ancora più emozionante di quello che ho sentito sui nostri monumenti su Hai-home. Capitano, pensa che un giorno, quando non dovremo più restare nascosti all'umanità, potrò visitare la Terra e vedere la bellezza della vostra capitale?" Vedendo quanto poco sappia dell'umanità, non sorprende che non sia consapevole dello stato in cui versa la Terra.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"I've never actually been to Earth before, so I couldn't tell you what it's like."|1506|0
units.english: "I've never actually been to Earth before, so I couldn't tell you what it's like."
units.italian: "Non sono mai stato davvero sulla Terra, quindi non saprei dirti com'è."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"Earth is a beautiful place, so it would be nice if you could see it."|1508|0
units.english: "Earth is a beautiful place, so it would be nice if you could see it."
units.italian: "La Terra è un posto bellissimo, quindi sarebbe bello se potessi vederla."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"Earth isn't actually that great a place to visit. Most of its inhabitants would take any chance they're given to leave it."|1510|0
units.english: "Earth isn't actually that great a place to visit. Most of its inhabitants would take any chance they're given to leave it."
units.italian: "La Terra non è in realtà un gran posto da visitare. La maggior parte dei suoi abitanti coglierebbe qualsiasi occasione per andarsene."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"Oh, sorry about that, shouldn't have assumed you knew everything, you're a starship captain after all, not a historian, I'll just ask someone else when I get the chance," says Nanachi.|1513|0
units.english: "Oh, sorry about that, shouldn't have assumed you knew everything, you're a starship captain after all, not a historian, I'll just ask someone else when I get the chance," says Nanachi.
units.italian: "Oh, scusa, non avrei dovuto dare per scontato che sapessi tutto, dopotutto sei un capitano di astronave, non uno storico, chiederò a qualcun altro quando ne avrò l'occasione," dice Nanachi.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	You start making up stories about how beautiful the skies of Earth are. You describe forests teeming with life, and do your best to remember ancient civilizations and their monuments. From the looks of it she believes you, and your lie seems to have sated her curiosity for now. If the day where the Hai are allowed to move around human space ever comes, though, she will no doubt be extremely disappointed.|1516|0
units.english: You start making up stories about how beautiful the skies of Earth are. You describe forests teeming with life, and do your best to remember ancient civilizations and their monuments. From the looks of it she believes you, and your lie seems to have sated her curiosity for now. If the day where the Hai are allowed to move around human space ever comes, though, she will no doubt be extremely disappointed.
units.italian: Cominci a inventare storie su quanto siano belli i cieli della Terra. Descrivi foreste brulicanti di vita e fai del tuo meglio per ricordare antiche civiltà e i loro monumenti. A quanto pare ti crede, e la tua bugia sembra aver placato per ora la sua curiosità. Se mai arriverà il giorno in cui agli Hai sarà permesso muoversi nello spazio umano, però, ne resterà senza dubbio estremamente delusa.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	She looks at you in confusion, as if trying to understand what you mean, so you explain it to her. "Despite how much humanity has advanced in the past centuries, Earth has been largely neglected. Most of the land has been turned into cities, which have over the years decayed into slums. If you ever managed to visit you'd be better off going to museums or monuments, but even then there are many thieves roaming the streets and it is very dangerous to be out at night. Lots of folks born there just think about how to get out."|1519|0
units.english: She looks at you in confusion, as if trying to understand what you mean, so you explain it to her. "Despite how much humanity has advanced in the past centuries, Earth has been largely neglected. Most of the land has been turned into cities, which have over the years decayed into slums. If you ever managed to visit you'd be better off going to museums or monuments, but even then there are many thieves roaming the streets and it is very dangerous to be out at night. Lots of folks born there just think about how to get out."
units.italian: Ti guarda confusa, come se cercasse di capire cosa intendi, così glielo spieghi. "Nonostante quanto l'umanità sia progredita negli ultimi secoli, la Terra è stata in gran parte trascurata. La maggior parte del territorio è diventata città, che negli anni sono degenerate in baraccopoli. Se mai riuscissi a visitarla, faresti meglio ad andare nei musei o ai monumenti, ma anche così ci sono molti ladri per le strade ed è molto pericoloso uscire di notte. Molti di quelli nati lì pensano solo a come andarsene."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	You keep telling her about the issues facing humanity's birthplace, and her previous eagerness to learn about the planet fades. "How could your ancestors let their own home become like this?"|1520|0
units.english: You keep telling her about the issues facing humanity's birthplace, and her previous eagerness to learn about the planet fades. "How could your ancestors let their own home become like this?"
units.italian: Continui a raccontarle i problemi che affliggono il luogo di nascita dell'umanità, e il suo precedente entusiasmo di saperne di più sul pianeta svanisce. "Come hanno potuto i vostri antenati lasciare che la loro stessa casa diventasse così?"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"Long-term planning has never been a strong trait of humanity as a whole."|1524|0
units.english: "Long-term planning has never been a strong trait of humanity as a whole."
units.italian: "La pianificazione a lungo termine non è mai stata un punto forte dell'umanità nel suo insieme."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"I guess it isn't too unlike how the Unfettered have treated their worlds."|1529|0
units.english: "I guess it isn't too unlike how the Unfettered have treated their worlds."
units.italian: "Immagino che non sia troppo diverso da come gli Slegati hanno trattato i loro mondi."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	Nanachi looks confused, so you continue to elaborate on that idea. "They're expecting to be able to have new worlds soon, so they consider the decay of their current ones as acceptable losses. Humans have also had issues with long-term planning and preparing for adverse events."|1530|0
units.english: Nanachi looks confused, so you continue to elaborate on that idea. "They're expecting to be able to have new worlds soon, so they consider the decay of their current ones as acceptable losses. Humans have also had issues with long-term planning and preparing for adverse events."
units.italian: Nanachi sembra confusa, così continui a elaborare quell'idea. "Si aspettano di poter avere presto nuovi mondi, quindi considerano il degrado di quelli attuali una perdita accettabile. Anche gli umani hanno avuto problemi con la pianificazione a lungo termine e la preparazione agli eventi avversi."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"I see..." She says. "I just thought it would be fun to hear about another large planet like Hai-home. Sorry for asking about it, Captain, I'm sure having to speak of it wasn't a pleasant feeling."|1533|0
units.english: "I see..." She says. "I just thought it would be fun to hear about another large planet like Hai-home. Sorry for asking about it, Captain, I'm sure having to speak of it wasn't a pleasant feeling."
units.italian: "Capisco..." dice. "Pensavo solo che sarebbe stato divertente sentire parlare di un altro pianeta grande come Hai-home. Scusa per avermelo chiesto, capitano, sono sicura che parlare di questo non è stato piacevole."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	Although you're sure that even in Hai space there is social inequality, she probably can't fathom that the home planet of a species could be in such bad shape, considering the Hai even go as far as to send aid to the Unfettered on a regular basis.|1534|0
units.english: Although you're sure that even in Hai space there is social inequality, she probably can't fathom that the home planet of a species could be in such bad shape, considering the Hai even go as far as to send aid to the Unfettered on a regular basis.
units.italian: Anche se sei certo che persino nello spazio degli Hai esista la disuguaglianza sociale, probabilmente lei non riesce a concepire che il pianeta natale di una specie possa versare in condizioni così cattive, considerando che gli Hai arrivano persino a mandare regolarmente aiuti agli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	You two reach the job board and decide to start looking for jobs suited for Nanachi's ship.|1537|0
units.english: You two reach the job board and decide to start looking for jobs suited for Nanachi's ship.
units.italian: Raggiungete la bacheca e decidete di cominciare a cercare lavori adatti alla nave di Nanachi.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"So, do you mind if I help out? I know the job board can be confusing the first few times you check it."|1539|0
units.english: "So, do you mind if I help out? I know the job board can be confusing the first few times you check it."
units.italian: "Allora, ti dispiace se do una mano? So che la bacheca può confondere le prime volte che la consulti."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"Do you think you need me to help out this time?"|1540|0
units.english: "Do you think you need me to help out this time?"
units.italian: "Pensi di aver bisogno che ti aiuti questa volta?"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"Thanks, but I have to do this on my own. I promise I won't mess this up by getting greedy again." She approaches the board on her own, and it becomes clear that it's much easier to get a job here; she's barely started talking to one of the desk workers before receiving a long list of jobs for smaller ships. She is certainly still very tired, but this seems to have cheered her up a bit; it is the first time she can get a job without your help, after all.|1541|0
units.english: "Thanks, but I have to do this on my own. I promise I won't mess this up by getting greedy again." She approaches the board on her own, and it becomes clear that it's much easier to get a job here; she's barely started talking to one of the desk workers before receiving a long list of jobs for smaller ships. She is certainly still very tired, but this seems to have cheered her up a bit; it is the first time she can get a job without your help, after all.
units.italian: "Grazie, ma devo farlo da sola. Prometto che non rovinerò tutto facendo di nuovo l'avida." Si avvicina alla bacheca da sola, e diventa chiaro che qui è molto più facile trovare un lavoro; ha appena iniziato a parlare con uno degli impiegati che riceve già una lunga lista di lavori per navi più piccole. È certamente ancora molto stanca, ma questo sembra averla un po' rincuorata; dopotutto è la prima volta che riesce a trovare un lavoro senza il tuo aiuto.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	While you thought she would've picked one or two jobs quickly and headed back to her ship, she keeps going through them and double checking the information for each one, as if something about them bothers her.|1542|0
units.english: While you thought she would've picked one or two jobs quickly and headed back to her ship, she keeps going through them and double checking the information for each one, as if something about them bothers her.
units.italian: Mentre pensavi che avrebbe scelto uno o due lavori in fretta e sarebbe tornata alla sua nave, continua a esaminarli e a ricontrollare le informazioni di ciascuno, come se qualcosa la disturbasse.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"What's wrong? Are you struggling to pick between two different jobs?" you ask.|1543|0
units.english: "What's wrong? Are you struggling to pick between two different jobs?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che c'è? Fai fatica a scegliere tra due lavori diversi?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"These all seem very easy and I could even accept many at a time, but the problem is their pay isn't very good." She grabs some worn papers from her pocket, and shows it to you: they're the documents for her loan. "The bank back home would only give me enough for the ship if I agreed on a short-term loan. I lost two days before you came along to help me, and if I don't get some better paying job soon, I won't even be able to pay the interest."|1544|0
units.english: "These all seem very easy and I could even accept many at a time, but the problem is their pay isn't very good." She grabs some worn papers from her pocket, and shows it to you: they're the documents for her loan. "The bank back home would only give me enough for the ship if I agreed on a short-term loan. I lost two days before you came along to help me, and if I don't get some better paying job soon, I won't even be able to pay the interest."
units.italian: "Sembrano tutti molto facili e potrei persino accettarne molti insieme, ma il problema è che la paga non è granché." Prende dalla tasca alcune carte consumate e te le mostra: sono i documenti del suo prestito. "La banca a casa mi avrebbe dato abbastanza per la nave solo se avessi accettato un prestito a breve termine. Ho perso due giorni prima che arrivassi tu ad aiutarmi, e se non trovo presto un lavoro che paghi meglio, non riuscirò nemmeno a pagare gli interessi."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	As you're trying to figure out a way to get the most out of the available missions, you feel a tap on your shoulder, and turn to see a Hai standing beside a human couple. The couple introduce themselves as Xavier and Vanessa, who are here with their Hai friend Narancia. "We overheard your conversation and are willing to pay a little extra for a job. We're part of a group organizing a big festival in Allhome to celebrate the friendship between humans and Hai, and we just got a last-minute idea: we'd like to get our hands on some Quarg spices."|1545|0
units.english: As you're trying to figure out a way to get the most out of the available missions, you feel a tap on your shoulder, and turn to see a Hai standing beside a human couple. The couple introduce themselves as Xavier and Vanessa, who are here with their Hai friend Narancia. "We overheard your conversation and are willing to pay a little extra for a job. We're part of a group organizing a big festival in Allhome to celebrate the friendship between humans and Hai, and we just got a last-minute idea: we'd like to get our hands on some Quarg spices."
units.italian: Mentre cerchi di capire come ricavare il massimo dalle missioni disponibili, senti un colpetto sulla spalla e ti volti verso un Hai in piedi accanto a una coppia umana. La coppia si presenta come Xavier e Vanessa, qui con la loro amica Hai Narancia. "Abbiamo sentito la vostra conversazione e siamo disposti a pagare un po' di più per un lavoro. Facciamo parte di un gruppo che organizza una grande festa su Allhome per celebrare l'amicizia tra umani e Hai, e ci è appena venuta un'idea dell'ultimo minuto: vorremmo procurarci delle spezie Quarg."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	Nanachi perks up during their conversation. "I'm sure I can get the spices to <planet> within two weeks. I won't let you down!"|1546|0
units.english: Nanachi perks up during their conversation. "I'm sure I can get the spices to <planet> within two weeks. I won't let you down!"
units.italian: Nanachi si rianima durante la loro conversazione. "Sono sicura di poter portare le spezie su <planet> entro due settimane. Non vi deluderò!"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|	"That's wonderful," Narancia says. They tell Nanachi that they won't be going along; they already have a transport to Allhome, and will stay here a bit longer to try and advertise the event. "Just come to Allhome after you've picked up the spices. Safe travels!"|1547|0
units.english: "That's wonderful," Narancia says. They tell Nanachi that they won't be going along; they already have a transport to Allhome, and will stay here a bit longer to try and advertise the event. "Just come to Allhome after you've picked up the spices. Safe travels!"
units.italian: "Che meraviglia," dice Narancia. Ti dicono che non verranno con voi; hanno già un trasporto per Allhome e resteranno qui ancora un po' per cercare di pubblicizzare l'evento. "Venite ad Allhome dopo aver preso le spezie. Buon viaggio!"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|A spaceport worker contacted Nanachi shortly before you two landed and made sure the spices were ready to be loaded in her ship. You help the workers and Nanachi make sure everything is in order, and prepare for your trip to Allhome.|1551|0
units.english: A spaceport worker contacted Nanachi shortly before you two landed and made sure the spices were ready to be loaded in her ship. You help the workers and Nanachi make sure everything is in order, and prepare for your trip to Allhome.
units.italian: Un operaio dello spazioporto ha contattato Nanachi poco prima che atterraste e si è assicurato che le spezie fossero pronte per essere caricate sulla sua nave. Aiuti gli operai e Nanachi a controllare che tutto sia in ordine, e vi preparate per il viaggio verso Allhome.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|dialog|1558|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you haven't finished the mission yet! Either you left Nanachi's ship behind or you haven't visited <stopovers>.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non hai ancora completato la missione! O hai lasciato indietro la nave di Nanachi o non hai visitato <stopovers>.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 3|Allhome's docking area shows much more traffic than usual. Many captains here are helping workers open cargo containers full of food, clothes, books, movies and even some mounted animals from human space. You finally meet up with the festival's organizers, who seem very excited to have acquired the exotic condiments, and have invited you two to a bar in the spaceport for a drink.|1561|0
units.english: Allhome's docking area shows much more traffic than usual. Many captains here are helping workers open cargo containers full of food, clothes, books, movies and even some mounted animals from human space. You finally meet up with the festival's organizers, who seem very excited to have acquired the exotic condiments, and have invited you two to a bar in the spaceport for a drink.
units.italian: L'area di attracco di Allhome mostra molto più traffico del solito. Molti capitani qui aiutano gli operai ad aprire container pieni di cibo, vestiti, libri, film e persino alcuni animali da sella provenienti dallo spazio umano. Alla fine incontri gli organizzatori della festa, che sembrano molto entusiasti di aver ottenuto i condimenti esotici, e vi hanno invitato in un bar dello spazioporto per un drink.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|name|1566|0
units.english: Protect Nanachi
units.italian: Proteggi Nanachi

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|description|1567|0
units.english: Bring Nanachi's ship to <stopovers>, keeping her safe from a pirate fleet that attacked a convoy heading to Hai space, then head back to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Porta la nave di Nanachi fino a <stopovers>, tenendola al sicuro da una flotta pirata che ha attaccato un convoglio diretto nello spazio degli Hai, poi torna su <destination> entro il <date>.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|The bar is just as busy as the docks. Many captains here must have transported something for the festival. "Captain <last>, Captain Nanachi!" shouts Narancia, beckoning the two of you to join her and the others at their table. You learn that they were inspired by the Hai's own March festival, and wanted to bring small parts of human culture to Hai space.|1575|0
units.english: The bar is just as busy as the docks. Many captains here must have transported something for the festival. "Captain <last>, Captain Nanachi!" shouts Narancia, beckoning the two of you to join her and the others at their table. You learn that they were inspired by the Hai's own March festival, and wanted to bring small parts of human culture to Hai space.
units.italian: Il bar è affollato quanto i moli. Molti capitani qui devono aver trasportato qualcosa per la festa. "Capitano <last>, capitana Nanachi!" grida Narancia, facendovi cenno di unirvi a lei e agli altri al loro tavolo. Scopri che si sono ispirati alla festa di marzo degli Hai e volevano portare piccole parti della cultura umana nello spazio degli Hai.
