units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	"They can't go to our planets and experience it for themselves yet, so we thought about bringing it to them!" Vanessa says.|1576|0
units.english: "They can't go to our planets and experience it for themselves yet, so we thought about bringing it to them!" Vanessa says.
units.italian: "Non possono ancora andare sui nostri pianeti e viverla di persona, quindi abbiamo pensato di portarla a loro!" dice Vanessa.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	"It was very hard to get enough sponsors for this, but after years of hard work we even managed to have famous art pieces be brought here, some of which date back to the European Renaissance!" Xavier adds.|1577|0
units.english: "It was very hard to get enough sponsors for this, but after years of hard work we even managed to have famous art pieces be brought here, some of which date back to the European Renaissance!" Xavier adds.
units.italian: "È stato molto difficile trovare abbastanza sponsor per questo, ma dopo anni di duro lavoro siamo riusciti persino a far portare qui opere d'arte famose, alcune delle quali risalgono al Rinascimento europeo!" aggiunge Xavier.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	Afterwards the conversation topic shifts to you as a captain, as you describe your journey after buying your first ship, and how you met Nanachi. You're about to order another drink for the group when a grizzled old man barges into the bar, and starts shouting: "The art convoy has been attacked! The freighter managed to escape but they're stranded on Prime now, and the pirates are still out there, patrolling the route to the wormhole!"|1578|0
units.english: Afterwards the conversation topic shifts to you as a captain, as you describe your journey after buying your first ship, and how you met Nanachi. You're about to order another drink for the group when a grizzled old man barges into the bar, and starts shouting: "The art convoy has been attacked! The freighter managed to escape but they're stranded on Prime now, and the pirates are still out there, patrolling the route to the wormhole!"
units.italian: Poi l'argomento si sposta su di te come capitano, mentre descrivi il tuo viaggio dopo aver comprato la tua prima nave e come hai conosciuto Nanachi. Stai per ordinare un altro drink per il gruppo quando un vecchio burbero irrompe nel bar e comincia a gridare: "Il convoglio d'arte è stato attaccato! Il mercantile è riuscito a fuggire ma ora sono bloccati su Prime, e i pirati sono ancora là fuori, a pattugliare la rotta verso il cunicolo!"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	Xavier stands up with a shocked expression. "How? We had a Leviathan escorting them!"|1579|0
units.english: Xavier stands up with a shocked expression. "How? We had a Leviathan escorting them!"
units.italian: Xavier si alza con un'espressione scioccata. "Come? Avevamo un Leviathan di scorta!"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	After catching his breath, the man at the door responds. "The pirates must have been stealing Hai tech from ships going back home. The freighter's captain said they shredded the escort!" Chaos spreads amongst the other captains, and the group sitting with you is in anguish.|1580|0
units.english: After catching his breath, the man at the door responds. "The pirates must have been stealing Hai tech from ships going back home. The freighter's captain said they shredded the escort!" Chaos spreads amongst the other captains, and the group sitting with you is in anguish.
units.italian: Dopo aver ripreso fiato, l'uomo alla porta risponde. "I pirati devono aver rubato tecnologia Hai dalle navi che tornavano a casa. Il capitano del mercantile ha detto che hanno fatto a pezzi la scorta!" Il caos si diffonde tra gli altri capitani, e il gruppo seduto con te è in angoscia.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	"Are those art pieces really that valuable?"|1582|0
units.english: "Are those art pieces really that valuable?"
units.italian: "Quelle opere d'arte valgono davvero così tanto?"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	"Can't you just postpone the festival until the pirates are taken care of?"|1583|0
units.english: "Can't you just postpone the festival until the pirates are taken care of?"
units.italian: "Non potete semplicemente rimandare la festa finché i pirati non saranno eliminati?"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	Xavier collapses back to the table, holding his head in both hands. "Those paintings and sculptures were our main attraction! They're worth tens of billions! It'll take months before the Navy ever notices the pirates there and makes it safe for the convoy to come here. The art exhibition is scheduled three weeks from now!"|1584|0
units.english: Xavier collapses back to the table, holding his head in both hands. "Those paintings and sculptures were our main attraction! They're worth tens of billions! It'll take months before the Navy ever notices the pirates there and makes it safe for the convoy to come here. The art exhibition is scheduled three weeks from now!"
units.italian: Xavier crolla di nuovo sul tavolo, tenendosi la testa tra le mani. "Quei dipinti e quelle sculture erano la nostra attrazione principale! Valgono decine di miliardi! Ci vorranno mesi prima che la Marina si accorga dei pirati laggiù e renda sicuro il passaggio del convoglio. La mostra d'arte è prevista tra tre settimane!"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	As they try to figure out what to do, Nanachi speaks up. "I'll go there. I pilot a human ship and if we just need to transfer cargo from one ship to the other, I could get out of there quickly. Nobody would notice that a Hai ever went there."|1585|0
units.english: As they try to figure out what to do, Nanachi speaks up. "I'll go there. I pilot a human ship and if we just need to transfer cargo from one ship to the other, I could get out of there quickly. Nobody would notice that a Hai ever went there."
units.italian: Mentre cercano di capire cosa fare, Nanachi prende la parola. "Ci andrò io. Piloto una nave umana e se dobbiamo solo trasferire il carico da una nave all'altra, potrei uscirne in fretta. Nessuno si accorgerebbe che una Hai è andata laggiù."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	"Are you insane?" Vanessa says, "If they managed to take down that Leviathan, you wouldn't last a second! Besides, our convoy was extremely fast. If even they were caught, your chances of outrunning the pirates are next to nothing!"|1586|0
units.english: "Are you insane?" Vanessa says, "If they managed to take down that Leviathan, you wouldn't last a second! Besides, our convoy was extremely fast. If even they were caught, your chances of outrunning the pirates are next to nothing!"
units.italian: "Sei pazza?" dice Vanessa. "Se sono riusciti ad abbattere quel Leviathan, non resisteresti un secondo! Inoltre il nostro convoglio era estremamente veloce. Se hanno preso anche loro, le tue possibilità di seminare i pirati sono quasi nulle!"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	"Captain <last>," Nanachi turns to you. "I know you already helped me way more than anyone would ever be willing to, and I'm really grateful for that, but would you be willing to help me one last time, to get to that planet, and travel back here?"|1587|0
units.english: "Captain <last>," Nanachi turns to you. "I know you already helped me way more than anyone would ever be willing to, and I'm really grateful for that, but would you be willing to help me one last time, to get to that planet, and travel back here?"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>," Nanachi si volta verso di te. "So che mi hai già aiutato molto più di quanto chiunque sarebbe disposto a fare, e te ne sono davvero grata, ma saresti disposto ad aiutarmi un'ultima volta, ad arrivare su quel pianeta e tornare qui?"

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	It's certain that for a pirate fleet to take down a Leviathan so easily they must be incredibly powerful, and this could be extremely dangerous. You're sure that if Nanachi tries to get to Prime by herself she'll just get herself killed.|1588|0
units.english: It's certain that for a pirate fleet to take down a Leviathan so easily they must be incredibly powerful, and this could be extremely dangerous. You're sure that if Nanachi tries to get to Prime by herself she'll just get herself killed.
units.italian: È certo che, per abbattere un Leviathan così facilmente, una flotta pirata debba essere incredibilmente potente, e questo potrebbe essere estremamente pericoloso. Sei sicuro che, se Nanachi cercasse di arrivare su Prime da sola, si farebbe semplicemente uccidere.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	"Alright, I'll make sure we reach Prime and get back here safely."|1590|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll make sure we reach Prime and get back here safely."
units.italian: "Va bene, mi assicurerò che arriviamo su Prime e torniamo qui sani e salvi."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	"No, I agreed to help you find and deal with some simple jobs, but I can't risk fighting such a fleet by myself."|1591|0
units.english: "No, I agreed to help you find and deal with some simple jobs, but I can't risk fighting such a fleet by myself."
units.italian: "No, avevo accettato di aiutarti a trovare e gestire qualche semplice lavoro, ma non posso rischiare di combattere una flotta del genere da solo."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	She thanks you profusely, and promises that she'll pay you for everything as soon as she can. The organizers are a bit hesitant, but seeing as no other captain here has decided to offer them help, they agree to let the two of you go to Prime and retrieve the cargo.|1593|0
units.english: She thanks you profusely, and promises that she'll pay you for everything as soon as she can. The organizers are a bit hesitant, but seeing as no other captain here has decided to offer them help, they agree to let the two of you go to Prime and retrieve the cargo.
units.italian: Ti ringrazia profusamente, e promette che ti pagherà per tutto il prima possibile. Gli organizzatori sono un po' esitanti, ma visto che nessun altro capitano qui si è offerto di aiutarli, accettano di lasciarvi andare su Prime a recuperare il carico.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	Vanessa grabs ahold of Nanachi's arm before she can run off to the spaceport. "Just remember, if you can't get back here by <day>, don't worry about it; we'll understand. I'm sure we can come up with some alternative to have the festival without our main attractions."|1594|0
units.english: Vanessa grabs ahold of Nanachi's arm before she can run off to the spaceport. "Just remember, if you can't get back here by <day>, don't worry about it; we'll understand. I'm sure we can come up with some alternative to have the festival without our main attractions."
units.italian: Vanessa afferra il braccio di Nanachi prima che possa correre allo spazioporto. "Ricordati solo che, se non riesci a tornare qui entro il <day>, non preoccuparti; capiremo. Sono sicura che possiamo trovare qualche alternativa per fare la festa senza le nostre attrazioni principali."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	As you're leaving the bar, Xavier pulls you aside, speaking very quietly, "<last>, I know you're just trying to help this girl, but don't get killed over this. If you run into those pirates don't try to fight them, just rush to Prime."|1595|0
units.english: As you're leaving the bar, Xavier pulls you aside, speaking very quietly, "<last>, I know you're just trying to help this girl, but don't get killed over this. If you run into those pirates don't try to fight them, just rush to Prime."
units.italian: Mentre uscite dal bar, Xavier ti tira da parte e parla molto piano: "<last>, so che stai solo cercando di aiutare questa ragazza, ma non farti uccidere per questo. Se incroci quei pirati non provare a combatterli, corri e basta verso Prime."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|dialog|1611|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you haven't finished the mission yet! Either you left Nanachi's ship behind or you haven't visited <stopovers>.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non hai ancora completato la missione! O hai lasciato indietro la nave di Nanachi o non hai visitato <stopovers>.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|The convoy's captain messaged you as you entered the system and told you to land on a remote, hidden area of Prime, where they have already prepared for all the cargo to be transferred. They refuel your ships and urge you two to go back. "Captain Nanachi can stay hidden with us here if you need supplies or anything from the outfitter, but please don't take too long."|1614|0
units.english: The convoy's captain messaged you as you entered the system and told you to land on a remote, hidden area of Prime, where they have already prepared for all the cargo to be transferred. They refuel your ships and urge you two to go back. "Captain Nanachi can stay hidden with us here if you need supplies or anything from the outfitter, but please don't take too long."
units.italian: Il capitano del convoglio ti ha mandato un messaggio appena sei entrato nel sistema e ti ha detto di atterrare in una zona remota e nascosta di Prime, dove hanno già preparato tutto per trasferire il carico. Riforniscono le vostre navi e vi esortano a tornare. "La capitana Nanachi può restare nascosta qui con noi se avete bisogno di rifornimenti o di qualcosa dal fornitore, ma per favore non metteteci troppo."

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|log|1617|0
units.english: A young Hai merchant captain who struggled in the beginning of her career. Her fortune turned when she was able, against difficult circumstances, to deliver a valuable collection of human arts on time to the organizers of a Hai festival.
units.italian: Una giovane capitana mercantile Hai che ha faticato all'inizio della carriera. La sua fortuna è cambiata quando, contro circostanze difficili, è riuscita a consegnare in tempo agli organizzatori di una festa Hai una preziosa collezione d'arte umana.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|Landing back on Allhome, the festival group gives you and Nanachi a warm hug. "We sold tens of thousands of tickets for the festival by promising to host a great art exhibition with pieces from all over human space. Without them it'd be a complete failure, and we'd be in serious trouble with our sponsors," Narancia explains.|1619|0
units.english: Landing back on Allhome, the festival group gives you and Nanachi a warm hug. "We sold tens of thousands of tickets for the festival by promising to host a great art exhibition with pieces from all over human space. Without them it'd be a complete failure, and we'd be in serious trouble with our sponsors," Narancia explains.
units.italian: Atterrando di nuovo su Allhome, il gruppo della festa abbraccia te e Nanachi con calore. "Abbiamo venduto decine di migliaia di biglietti per la festa promettendo di ospitare una grande mostra d'arte con pezzi da tutto lo spazio umano. Senza di essi sarebbe un fallimento totale, e saremmo in seri guai con i nostri sponsor," spiega Narancia.

units.id: mission:Nanachi 4|	As the cargo is rushed to the exhibition site, Nanachi shows you the chip she got as payment, and the balance of her bank account: this last payment allowed her to fully pay off her loan. "Captain," she speaks with some difficulty, and tries to hide her face, as if to wipe away some tears. "I'll never be able to thank you properly, if not for you I'd still be lost in that spaceport, and would eventually have to go back to my mining job. I'll work hard now; I'll save up and pay you for everything!" She hugs you and bows to you in a way you'd see in movies, as if trying to imitate the gesture. You two finally say goodbye, and head back to your ships.|1620|0
units.english: As the cargo is rushed to the exhibition site, Nanachi shows you the chip she got as payment, and the balance of her bank account: this last payment allowed her to fully pay off her loan. "Captain," she speaks with some difficulty, and tries to hide her face, as if to wipe away some tears. "I'll never be able to thank you properly, if not for you I'd still be lost in that spaceport, and would eventually have to go back to my mining job. I'll work hard now; I'll save up and pay you for everything!" She hugs you and bows to you in a way you'd see in movies, as if trying to imitate the gesture. You two finally say goodbye, and head back to your ships.
units.italian: Mentre il carico viene portato di corsa al sito della mostra, Nanachi ti mostra il chip che ha ricevuto come pagamento e il saldo del suo conto bancario: quest'ultimo pagamento le ha permesso di estinguere completamente il prestito. "Capitano," dice con una certa difficoltà, e cerca di nascondere il viso, come per asciugarsi qualche lacrima. "Non riuscirò mai a ringraziarti come si deve, se non fosse stato per te sarei ancora persa in quello spazioporto e alla fine avrei dovuto tornare al mio lavoro in miniera. D'ora in poi lavorerò sodo; risparmierò e ti pagherò per tutto!" Ti abbraccia e si inchina a te in un modo che vedresti nei film, come se cercasse di imitare il gesto. Alla fine vi salutate e tornate alle vostre navi.

units.id: mission:Nanachi: Payment|Shortly after you land, you get a message from Nanachi, the young Hai pilot who you helped start out. "Dear Captain <last>, I hope you're doing well! As I promised, ever since we parted ways, I've been working towards getting enough money to pay you for being so kind to help me. I've sent you <payment>. I'm deeply grateful to you for helping make my dream come true."|1637|0
units.english: Shortly after you land, you get a message from Nanachi, the young Hai pilot who you helped start out. "Dear Captain <last>, I hope you're doing well! As I promised, ever since we parted ways, I've been working towards getting enough money to pay you for being so kind to help me. I've sent you <payment>. I'm deeply grateful to you for helping make my dream come true."
units.italian: Poco dopo che atterri, ricevi un messaggio da Nanachi, la giovane pilota Hai che hai aiutato a iniziare. "Caro capitano <last>, spero che stia bene! Come avevo promesso, da quando ci siamo separati ho lavorato per mettere da parte abbastanza denaro da pagarla per essere stato così gentile da aiutarmi. Le ho inviato <payment>. Le sono profondamente grata per aver aiutato il mio sogno a realizzarsi."

units.id: mission:Nanachi Meeting|After you leave your ship and start making your way through the docking area, you notice a Hai running towards you and waving. As they get closer, you realize that it's Nanachi, the Hai pilot who you helped out years ago.|1655|0
units.english: After you leave your ship and start making your way through the docking area, you notice a Hai running towards you and waving. As they get closer, you realize that it's Nanachi, the Hai pilot who you helped out years ago.
units.italian: Dopo essere uscito dalla nave e aver iniziato ad attraversare l'area di attracco, noti una Hai che corre verso di te e ti saluta con la zampa. Quando si avvicina, capisci che è Nanachi, la pilota Hai che avevi aiutato anni fa.

units.id: mission:Nanachi Meeting|	"I was just about to go back to my crew when I saw you coming out of your ship. I know a nice snack bar here, let's go there!" Before you can even say hello, she's dragged you to the bar, and ordered some drinks for the two of you. She tells you about her last few years as a captain. She has long since sold her old ship, and now pilots a Geocoris, transporting large amounts of cargo across Hai space. You also tell her about how your life has been ever since you last met, of your adventures and how far you've come. You keep swapping stories for hours, until the bar is ready to close.|1656|0
units.english: "I was just about to go back to my crew when I saw you coming out of your ship. I know a nice snack bar here, let's go there!" Before you can even say hello, she's dragged you to the bar, and ordered some drinks for the two of you. She tells you about her last few years as a captain. She has long since sold her old ship, and now pilots a Geocoris, transporting large amounts of cargo across Hai space. You also tell her about how your life has been ever since you last met, of your adventures and how far you've come. You keep swapping stories for hours, until the bar is ready to close.
units.italian: "Stavo proprio per tornare dal mio equipaggio quando ti ho visto uscire dalla nave. Conosco un bel snack bar qui, andiamo!" Prima che tu possa persino salutarla, ti ha trascinato al bar e ha ordinato dei drink per voi due. Ti racconta i suoi ultimi anni come capitana. Ha venduto da tempo la sua vecchia nave e ora pilota un Geocoris, trasportando grandi quantità di carico per tutto lo spazio degli Hai. Anche tu le racconti com'è stata la tua vita da quando vi siete visti l'ultima volta, le tue avventure e quanta strada hai fatto. Continuate a scambiarvi storie per ore, finché il bar non è pronto a chiudere.

units.id: mission:Nanachi Meeting|	You thank her for the drinks, and get ready to say your goodbyes.|1657|0
units.english: You thank her for the drinks, and get ready to say your goodbyes.
units.italian: La ringrazi per i drink e ti prepari a salutarla.

units.id: mission:Nanachi Meeting|	"Oh wait, before you go Captain, let me give you something," she says, right as you're about to head to your ship. She grabs a small pendant from her pocket.|1658|0
units.english: "Oh wait, before you go Captain, let me give you something," she says, right as you're about to head to your ship. She grabs a small pendant from her pocket.
units.italian: "Oh aspetta, prima che vada capitano, lascia che ti dia una cosa," dice, proprio mentre stai per tornare alla nave. Prende un piccolo pendente dalla tasca.

units.id: mission:Nanachi Meeting|scene|1659|0
units.english: outfit/crystal pendant
units.italian: outfit/crystal pendant

units.id: mission:Nanachi Meeting|	"Back home in Giverstone, when I had some free time from the mining works, I took a hobby of sculpting some small stones into ship miniatures. I thought it'd be nice to make one for you, in case I ever saw you again. I made it from the same stones we use as good luck charms on our ships." She gives you the pendant, which has been sculpted into a Hai Shield Beetle. It is extremely well made, with different surface textures representing the different parts of the Shield Beetle. "I wanted it to be something to make your travels easier, the way you helped with starting mine. Thanks again, Captain!" You two part ways, and head back to your ships.|1660|0
units.english: "Back home in Giverstone, when I had some free time from the mining works, I took a hobby of sculpting some small stones into ship miniatures. I thought it'd be nice to make one for you, in case I ever saw you again. I made it from the same stones we use as good luck charms on our ships." She gives you the pendant, which has been sculpted into a Hai Shield Beetle. It is extremely well made, with different surface textures representing the different parts of the Shield Beetle. "I wanted it to be something to make your travels easier, the way you helped with starting mine. Thanks again, Captain!" You two part ways, and head back to your ships.
units.italian: "A casa, a Giverstone, quando avevo un po' di tempo libero dal lavoro in miniera, mi divertivo a scolpire piccole pietre per farne miniature di navi. Ho pensato che sarebbe stato bello farne una per te, nel caso ti avessi rivisto. L'ho fatta con le stesse pietre che usiamo come portafortuna sulle nostre navi." Ti dà il pendente, scolpito a forma di Shield Beetle Hai. È fatto estremamente bene, con diverse texture superficiali che rappresentano le diverse parti dello Shield Beetle. "Volevo che fosse qualcosa per rendere più facili i tuoi viaggi, come tu hai aiutato a iniziare i miei. Grazie ancora, capitano!" Vi separate e tornate alle vostre navi.

units.id: mission:Strider Alt Start|name|1667|0
units.english: New Unfettered ships
units.italian: Nuove navi degli Slegati

units.id: mission:Strider Alt Start|description|1668|0
units.english: Ambassador Sayari has informed the council of elders about the development of the Solifuge. The council is interested in meeting with you on <destination> to hear more.
units.italian: L'ambasciatrice Sayari ha informato il consiglio degli anziani dello sviluppo del Solifuge. Il consiglio è interessato a incontrarti su <destination> per saperne di più.

units.id: mission:Strider Alt Start|dialog|1682|0
units.english: After you finish landing, you're approached by a Hai in formal uniform. "Greetings, Captain <last>. Ambassador Sayari has sent word to the council of elders that our Unfettered brethren have created a new ship of great strength. The council has requested your presence on <planet>; Sayari said you have been in combat with these ships, and the elders are interested in your expertise."
units.italian: Dopo che hai finito di atterrare, vieni avvicinato da un Hai in uniforme formale. "Salve, capitano <last>. L'ambasciatrice Sayari ha fatto sapere al consiglio degli anziani che i nostri fratelli Slegati hanno creato una nuova nave di grande potenza. Il consiglio ha richiesto la sua presenza su <planet>; Sayari ha detto che lei è stato in combattimento con queste navi, e gli anziani sono interessati alla sua competenza."

units.id: mission:Strider 0|name|1690|0
units.english: Hull Repair Technology
units.italian: Tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo

units.id: mission:Strider 0|description|1691|0
units.english: The Hai are working on a drone carrier to counter the Unfettered Solifuge, but the creator of the ship is still developing hull repair technology to make it more effective in combat. Visit <planet> to help the Hai with this technology when you are able.
units.italian: Gli Hai stanno lavorando a una porta-droni per contrastare il Solifuge degli Slegati, ma il creatore della nave sta ancora sviluppando la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo per renderla più efficace in combattimento. Visita <planet> per aiutare gli Hai con questa tecnologia quando puoi.

units.id: mission:Strider 1|name|1707|0
units.english: Hull Repair Technology
units.italian: Tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo

units.id: mission:Strider 1|description|1708|0
units.english: The Hai are working on a drone carrier to counter the Unfettered Solifuge, but the creator of the ship is still developing hull repair technology to make it more effective in combat. Travel to <planet> to meet the delegation tasked with negotiating for this technology.
units.italian: Gli Hai stanno lavorando a una porta-droni per contrastare il Solifuge degli Slegati, ma il creatore della nave sta ancora sviluppando la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo per renderla più efficace in combattimento. Viaggia fino a <planet> per incontrare la delegazione incaricata di negoziare per questa tecnologia.

units.id: mission:Strider 1|You've returned to <origin>, but you don't have access to any hull repair technology. Explore the galaxy and earn the trust of an alien faction that has hull repair technology before returning.|1725|0
units.english: You've returned to <origin>, but you don't have access to any hull repair technology. Explore the galaxy and earn the trust of an alien faction that has hull repair technology before returning.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <origin>, ma non hai accesso ad alcuna tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo. Esplora la galassia e guadagnati la fiducia di una fazione aliena che possiede la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Strider 1|label|1728|0
units.english: know both
units.italian: know both

units.id: mission:Strider 1|You've returned to <origin> to help the Hai develop hull repair technology. Osen's father asked if you knew of any aliens with such technology, and you have met the Coalition, who have outfits capable of repairing hulls, and the Remnant, who have ships that repair themselves. Would you like to tell the elders about one of these groups?|1729|0

units.english: You've returned to <origin> to help the Hai develop hull repair technology. Osen's father asked if you knew of any aliens with such technology, and you have met the Remnant, who have ships that repair themselves. Would you like to tell the elders about the Remnant?
units.italian: Sei tornato su <origin> per aiutare gli Hai a sviluppare la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo. Il padre di Osen ha chiesto se conoscevi alieni con una tale tecnologia, e tu hai incontrato il Remnant, che ha navi che si riparano da sole. Vuoi parlare agli anziani del Remnant?

units.id: mission:Strider 1|	You inform the elders that you have discovered a group that could help them with creating hull repair technology, and they invite you to the council chamber. "Greetings, Captain <last>," one of the elders says to you upon entering the chamber. "What news do you have to bring us on your search for hull repair technology?"|1752|0
units.english: You inform the elders that you have discovered a group that could help them with creating hull repair technology, and they invite you to the council chamber. "Greetings, Captain <last>," one of the elders says to you upon entering the chamber. "What news do you have to bring us on your search for hull repair technology?"
units.italian: Informi gli anziani di aver scoperto un gruppo che potrebbe aiutarli a creare la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo, e ti invitano nella camera del consiglio. "Salve, capitano <last>," ti dice uno degli anziani entrando nella camera. "Che notizie ci porta sulla sua ricerca della tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo?"

units.id: mission:Strider 1|label|1763|0
units.english: tell both
units.italian: tell both

units.id: mission:Strider 1|	"There is a group of three alien species far from here known as the Coalition that have outfits able to repair a ship in flight."|1765|0
units.english: "There is a group of three alien species far from here known as the Coalition that have outfits able to repair a ship in flight."
units.italian: "C'è un gruppo di tre specie aliene lontano da qui, noto come la Coalizione, che ha equipaggiamenti capaci di riparare una nave in volo."

units.id: mission:Strider 1|	"There is a group of humans far from here known as the Remnant who have ships that can repair themselves."|1767|0
units.english: "There is a group of humans far from here known as the Remnant who have ships that can repair themselves."
units.italian: "C'è un gruppo di umani lontano da qui, noto come il Remnant, che ha navi capaci di ripararsi da sole."

units.id: mission:Strider 1|label|1770|0
units.english: tell remnant
units.italian: tell remnant

units.english: "There is a group of humans far from here known as the Remnant who have ships that can repair themselves."
units.italian: "Lontano da qui c'è un gruppo di umani chiamato il Remnant: le loro navi si riparano da sole."

units.id: mission:Strider 1|label|1775|0
units.english: tell coalition
units.italian: tell coalition

units.id: mission:Strider 1|	"There is a group of three alien species far from here known as the Coalition that have outfits able to repair a ship in flight."|1777|0

units.italian: "Lontano da qui c'è un gruppo di tre specie aliene, la Coalizione: hanno equipaggiamenti capaci di riparare una nave in volo."

units.id: mission:Strider 1|	"A group of humans with hull repair technology?" one of the elders asks with a puzzled look. "I am surprised that we have not heard of these humans before. Are they well known among the Republic?"|1783|0
units.english: "A group of humans with hull repair technology?" one of the elders asks with a puzzled look. "I am surprised that we have not heard of these humans before. Are they well known among the Republic?"
units.italian: "Un gruppo di umani con la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo?" chiede uno degli anziani con un'espressione perplessa. "Mi sorprende che non abbiamo mai sentito parlare di questi umani. Sono ben conosciuti nella Repubblica?"

units.id: mission:Strider 1|	"No," you explain. "They are a reclusive group unknown to most of humanity. They likely wouldn't take kindly to being visited by aliens."|1784|0
units.english: "No," you explain. "They are a reclusive group unknown to most of humanity. They likely wouldn't take kindly to being visited by aliens."
units.italian: "No," spieghi. "Sono un gruppo appartato, sconosciuto alla maggior parte dell'umanità. Probabilmente non apprezzerebbero una visita da parte di alieni."

units.id: mission:Strider 1|	"A group of three aliens?" one of the elders asks with a puzzled look. "It is not often in the galaxy that such groups appear."|1790|0
units.english: "A group of three aliens?" one of the elders asks with a puzzled look. "It is not often in the galaxy that such groups appear."
units.italian: "Un gruppo di tre alieni?" chiede uno degli anziani con un'espressione perplessa. "Non capita spesso nella galassia che compaiano gruppi simili."

units.id: mission:Strider 1|	"We will put together a delegation for you to transport to these people you mention. They will be waiting for you on <destination>," another elder says. "You may lead them to make contact with this group how you see fit. We trust that you will be capable in doing so."|1793|0
units.english: "We will put together a delegation for you to transport to these people you mention. They will be waiting for you on <destination>," another elder says. "You may lead them to make contact with this group how you see fit. We trust that you will be capable in doing so."
units.italian: "Metteremo insieme una delegazione perché lei la trasporti da queste persone di cui parla. La aspetteranno su <destination>," dice un altro anziano. "Può guidarli a fare contatto con questo gruppo come ritiene opportuno. Confidiamo che sarà all'altezza."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|name|1800|0
units.english: Contact the Remnant
units.italian: Contatta il Remnant

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|description|1801|0
units.english: Take a message from the Hai to <stopovers> to set up a meeting between the Remnant and the Hai, then return to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta un messaggio degli Hai fino a <stopovers> per organizzare un incontro tra il Remnant e gli Hai, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|You find the Hai delegation meant to travel to the Remnant to negotiate for the hull repair technology waiting for you in the spaceport. The leader of the delegation introduces herself as Ambassador Yashili. "I heard that we will be traveling a great distance across the galaxy. May we have a safe journey."|1808|0
units.english: You find the Hai delegation meant to travel to the Remnant to negotiate for the hull repair technology waiting for you in the spaceport. The leader of the delegation introduces herself as Ambassador Yashili. "I heard that we will be traveling a great distance across the galaxy. May we have a safe journey."
units.italian: Trovi la delegazione Hai incaricata di recarsi dal Remnant per negoziare la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo, che ti aspetta nello spazioporto. La capo della delegazione si presenta come ambasciatrice Yashili. "Ho saputo che viaggeremo per una grande distanza attraverso la galassia. Che il viaggio sia sicuro."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	The delegation begins making their way to your ship, but you stop them.|1809|0
units.english: The delegation begins making their way to your ship, but you stop them.
units.italian: La delegazione comincia a dirigersi verso la tua nave, ma tu la fermi.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"Wait a minute! This group doesn't react well to strangers. How about I set up a meeting first?"|1811|0
units.english: "Wait a minute! This group doesn't react well to strangers. How about I set up a meeting first?"
units.italian: "Aspettate un momento! Questo gruppo non reagisce bene agli estranei. Che ne dite se organizzo prima un incontro?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"Not so fast. The Remnant value their secrecy, and I haven't spoken to them about this situation. Let me set up a meeting first."|1812|0
units.english: "Not so fast. The Remnant value their secrecy, and I haven't spoken to them about this situation. Let me set up a meeting first."
units.italian: "Non così in fretta. Il Remnant tiene alla propria riservatezza, e non ho parlato con loro di questa situazione. Lasciate che organizzi prima un incontro."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	The Hai look at each other and chatter quietly among themselves, then Ambassador Yashili speaks up. "You know this group, and how to make the best impression on them." She pauses to whisper to another Hai, who runs off. The Ambassador turns back to you. "I will provide you with a letter that will include a brief introduction of the Hai, an explanation of why we would like to meet them, and an invitation to establish diplomatic relations."|1813|0
units.english: The Hai look at each other and chatter quietly among themselves, then Ambassador Yashili speaks up. "You know this group, and how to make the best impression on them." She pauses to whisper to another Hai, who runs off. The Ambassador turns back to you. "I will provide you with a letter that will include a brief introduction of the Hai, an explanation of why we would like to meet them, and an invitation to establish diplomatic relations."
units.italian: Gli Hai si guardano e chiacchierano piano tra loro, poi l'ambasciatrice Yashili prende la parola. "Lei conosce questo gruppo, e sa come fare la migliore impressione su di loro." Si ferma a sussurrare qualcosa a un altro Hai, che corre via. L'ambasciatrice si volta di nuovo verso di te. "Le fornirò una lettera che conterrà una breve presentazione degli Hai, una spiegazione del motivo per cui vorremmo incontrarli e un invito a stabilire relazioni diplomatiche."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	Moments later, the Hai who ran off returns carrying a sealed envelope and hands it to the Ambassador. She turns to you. "Here it is. Please take this to these reclusive humans for us. We will be waiting here for your return."|1814|0
units.english: Moments later, the Hai who ran off returns carrying a sealed envelope and hands it to the Ambassador. She turns to you. "Here it is. Please take this to these reclusive humans for us. We will be waiting here for your return."
units.italian: Pochi istanti dopo, l'Hai che era corso via torna portando una busta sigillata e la consegna all'ambasciatrice. Lei si volta verso di te. "Ecco. Per favore, la porti a questi umani appartati per noi. Noi aspetteremo qui il suo ritorno."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"Will do," you respond after taking the envelope. The delegation says its goodbyes, wishing you safe travels, before leaving.|1815|0
units.english: "Will do," you respond after taking the envelope. The delegation says its goodbyes, wishing you safe travels, before leaving.
units.italian: "Va bene," rispondi dopo aver preso la busta. La delegazione si congeda, augurandoti buon viaggio, prima di andarsene.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|Looking around the spaceport, you are not sure who to talk to about such a diplomatic request. Eventually, you go to the starport information desk to ask them. You hand the letter to the person at the desk, and after reading it, they invite you to wait in the cafeteria while they look for someone who can fulfill the request from the Hai.|1819|0
units.english: Looking around the spaceport, you are not sure who to talk to about such a diplomatic request. Eventually, you go to the starport information desk to ask them. You hand the letter to the person at the desk, and after reading it, they invite you to wait in the cafeteria while they look for someone who can fulfill the request from the Hai.
units.italian: Guardandoti intorno nello spazioporto, non sei sicuro con chi parlare di una richiesta diplomatica del genere. Alla fine vai al banco informazioni dello spazioporto a chiedere. Consegni la lettera alla persona al banco e, dopo averla letta, ti invita ad aspettare nella caffetteria mentre cerca qualcuno che possa soddisfare la richiesta degli Hai.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	After an hour of watching Remnant eating and gesturing to each other, an androgynous Remnant approaches your table. You try to guess what age they are, but while they do not seem young, neither do they seem particularly old.|1820|0
units.english: After an hour of watching Remnant eating and gesturing to each other, an androgynous Remnant approaches your table. You try to guess what age they are, but while they do not seem young, neither do they seem particularly old.
units.italian: Dopo un'ora passata a guardare Remnant che mangiano e si fanno gesti, un Remnant androgino si avvicina al tuo tavolo. Cerchi di indovinare quanti anni abbia, ma anche se non sembra giovane, non sembra nemmeno particolarmente vecchio.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"Greetings, Captain <first>," The stranger signs. "My name is Rayn, and my colleague said you had a request from another faction. It is my understanding that they desire the means to repair the hull of a ship in flight. Is this correct?"|1821|0
units.english: "Greetings, Captain <first>," The stranger signs. "My name is Rayn, and my colleague said you had a request from another faction. It is my understanding that they desire the means to repair the hull of a ship in flight. Is this correct?"
units.italian: "Salve, capitano <first>," ti comunica a gesti lo sconosciuto. "Mi chiamo Rayn, e il mio collega ha detto che aveva una richiesta da parte di un'altra fazione. Mi risulta che desiderino i mezzi per riparare lo scafo di una nave in volo. È corretto?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"Yes. The Hai are hoping to be able to improve a new carrier they are developing to repair its drones."|1823|0
units.english: "Yes. The Hai are hoping to be able to improve a new carrier they are developing to repair its drones."
units.italian: "Sì. Gli Hai sperano di riuscire a migliorare una nuova porta-droni che stanno sviluppando, per riparare i suoi droni."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"Yes. The Hai want to be able to repair the hulls of their ships to gain an edge against their enemies."|1824|0
units.english: "Yes. The Hai want to be able to repair the hulls of their ships to gain an edge against their enemies."
units.italian: "Sì. Gli Hai vogliono poter riparare gli scafi delle loro navi per ottenere un vantaggio sui loro nemici."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"So the Hai want to improve their military technology? I presume this is in response to their long-standing war against the Unfettered?"|1825|0
units.english: "So the Hai want to improve their military technology? I presume this is in response to their long-standing war against the Unfettered?"
units.italian: "Quindi gli Hai vogliono migliorare la loro tecnologia militare? Presumo che sia in risposta alla loro lunga guerra contro gli Slegati?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"Yes, although they don't think of it as such."|1827|0
units.english: "Yes, although they don't think of it as such."
units.italian: "Sì, anche se loro non la vedono così."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"It isn't a war; it's a defensive action."|1828|0
units.english: "It isn't a war; it's a defensive action."
units.italian: "Non è una guerra; è un'azione difensiva."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	Rayn looks amused. "It does not matter what they call it. A war by any name is just as bloody. But that aside, how do they know about us to make such a request?"|1829|0
units.english: Rayn looks amused. "It does not matter what they call it. A war by any name is just as bloody. But that aside, how do they know about us to make such a request?"
units.italian: Rayn sembra divertito. "Non importa come lo chiamino. Una guerra, con qualsiasi nome, è ugualmente sanguinosa. Ma a parte questo, come fanno a sapere di noi per fare una richiesta del genere?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"They were looking for someone who had repair technology, and I said I could find someone."|1831|0
units.english: "They were looking for someone who had repair technology, and I said I could find someone."
units.italian: "Cercavano qualcuno che avesse la tecnologia di riparazione, e ho detto che potevo trovarlo."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"They asked if I knew anyone who had in-flight repair technology, and I said I knew a group of human researchers."|1832|0
units.english: "They asked if I knew anyone who had in-flight repair technology, and I said I knew a group of human researchers."
units.italian: "Hanno chiesto se conoscevo qualcuno con la tecnologia di riparazione in volo, e ho detto che conoscevo un gruppo di ricercatori umani."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 1|	"So they do not actually know about us. That is good." Rayn looks thoughtful and closes their eyes for a moment, then continues. "Pick up the Hai diplomats, but do not tell them where you are going. Take them to these coordinates on Covert in the Gienah system. It is a location in an uninhabited area where we will be able to talk. We will be waiting with something that might be able to help them - if they can pay our price."|1833|0
units.english: "So they do not actually know about us. That is good." Rayn looks thoughtful and closes their eyes for a moment, then continues. "Pick up the Hai diplomats, but do not tell them where you are going. Take them to these coordinates on Covert in the Gienah system. It is a location in an uninhabited area where we will be able to talk. We will be waiting with something that might be able to help them - if they can pay our price."
units.italian: "Quindi in realtà non sanno di noi. È un bene." Rayn sembra pensieroso e chiude gli occhi per un momento, poi continua. "Prendi i diplomatici Hai, ma non dire loro dove stai andando. Portali a queste coordinate su Covert, nel sistema Gienah. È un luogo in una zona disabitata dove potremo parlare. Vi aspetteremo con qualcosa che potrebbe aiutarli, se possono pagare il nostro prezzo."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|name|1839|0
units.english: Meet with the Remnant
units.italian: Incontra il Remnant

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|description|1840|0
units.english: Transport Ambassador Yashili and her delegation to <destination> to attempt to obtain hull repair technology from the Remnant.
units.italian: Trasporta l'ambasciatrice Yashili e la sua delegazione su <destination> per tentare di ottenere la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo dal Remnant.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|blocked|1845|0
units.english: The Hai delegation to meet the Remnant requires 3 bunks for the trip, but you don't have enough available space! Return when you have room for the delegation.
units.italian: La delegazione Hai che deve incontrare il Remnant richiede 3 cuccette per il viaggio, ma non hai abbastanza spazio disponibile! Torna quando avrai posto per la delegazione.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|You message Ambassador Yashili and tell her that you have arranged a meeting with the Remnant. "This is good news. We will be meeting with you in the spaceport shortly."|1850|0
units.english: You message Ambassador Yashili and tell her that you have arranged a meeting with the Remnant. "This is good news. We will be meeting with you in the spaceport shortly."
units.italian: Mandi un messaggio all'ambasciatrice Yashili e le dici che hai organizzato un incontro con il Remnant. "È una buona notizia. Ci incontreremo con lei allo spazioporto a breve."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|	Some time later the delegation arrives at your ship. "Before we leave, is there anything we need to know about this group before we meet them?" Yashili asks.|1851|0
units.english: Some time later the delegation arrives at your ship. "Before we leave, is there anything we need to know about this group before we meet them?" Yashili asks.
units.italian: Qualche tempo dopo la delegazione arriva alla tua nave. "Prima di partire, c'è qualcosa che dobbiamo sapere di questo gruppo prima di incontrarlo?" chiede Yashili.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|	"The Remnant are a group of humans, so there isn't anything special you should need to know."|1853|0
units.english: "The Remnant are a group of humans, so there isn't anything special you should need to know."
units.italian: "Il Remnant è un gruppo di umani, quindi non c'è nulla di particolare che dobbiate sapere."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|	"The Remnant agreed to meet you on <planet>, a dangerous pirate world, so don't stray too far from the ship."|1855|0
units.english: "The Remnant agreed to meet you on <planet>, a dangerous pirate world, so don't stray too far from the ship."
units.italian: "Il Remnant ha accettato di incontrarvi su <planet>, un pericoloso mondo pirata, quindi non allontanatevi troppo dalla nave."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|	"Oh," Yashili exclaims with a surprised look. "Are these Remnant also dangerous people?"|1856|0
units.english: "Oh," Yashili exclaims with a surprised look. "Are these Remnant also dangerous people?"
units.italian: "Oh," esclama Yashili con un'espressione sorpresa. "Anche questo Remnant è gente pericolosa?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|	"No, they're friendly people," you reassure her. "They just don't want to meet in their own territory."|1857|0
units.english: "No, they're friendly people," you reassure her. "They just don't want to meet in their own territory."
units.italian: "No, sono persone amichevoli," la rassicuri. "Solo che non vogliono incontrarvi nel loro territorio."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|	The delegation thanks you for this information and boards your ship. You plot a course for <destination>. Hopefully, the Remnant will be willing to share with an alien species they just met.|1859|0
units.english: The delegation thanks you for this information and boards your ship. You plot a course for <destination>. Hopefully, the Remnant will be willing to share with an alien species they just met.
units.italian: La delegazione ti ringrazia per l'informazione e sale sulla tua nave. Tracci una rotta per <destination>. Speriamo che il Remnant sia disposto a condividere qualcosa con una specie aliena appena conosciuta.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 2|dialog|1862|0
units.english: It appears that the delegation is bunked on escorts that have not arrived in this system yet. Take off and wait for them.
units.italian: Sembra che la delegazione sia sistemata su scorte che non sono ancora arrivate in questo sistema. Decolla e aspettale.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|name|1868|0
units.english: Technology Obtained
units.italian: Tecnologia ottenuta

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|description|1869|0
units.english: The delegation has successfully obtained hull repair technology from the Remnant. Return to <destination> so that the Hai can begin developing this technology for their new ship.
units.italian: La delegazione ha ottenuto con successo la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo dal Remnant. Torna su <destination> così che gli Hai possano iniziare a sviluppare questa tecnologia per la loro nuova nave.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|blocked|1875|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to return the Hai delegation and the repair technology back to <planet>.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per riportare la delegazione Hai e la tecnologia di riparazione su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|log|1879|0
units.english: Helped the Hai get in contact with the Remnant in order to learn how to create in-flight hull repair technology. The Hai obtained a copy of the Remnant's research on Korath systems cores, along with a number of samples.
units.italian: Hai aiutato gli Hai a mettersi in contatto con il Remnant per imparare a creare la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo in volo. Gli Hai hanno ottenuto una copia delle ricerche del Remnant sui nuclei dei sistemi Korath, insieme a diversi campioni.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|At the designated coordinates, there is a small encampment set up that looks vaguely reminiscent of a desert trader outpost. Aside from a few camels tied near a water trough, the place looks abandoned. When you touch down next to it, the delegation steps out cautiously. "Is this the right place?" one of the Hai asks somewhat worriedly.|1881|0
units.english: At the designated coordinates, there is a small encampment set up that looks vaguely reminiscent of a desert trader outpost. Aside from a few camels tied near a water trough, the place looks abandoned. When you touch down next to it, the delegation steps out cautiously. "Is this the right place?" one of the Hai asks somewhat worriedly.
units.italian: Alle coordinate indicate c'è un piccolo accampamento che ricorda vagamente un avamposto di commercianti del deserto. A parte qualche cammello legato vicino a un abbeveratoio, il posto sembra abbandonato. Quando atterri accanto, la delegazione esce con cautela. "È il posto giusto?" chiede uno degli Hai un po' preoccupato.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	Before you can answer, a number of Remnant emerge from the tents, and you notice that Rayn is among them. "Welcome to our encampment, representatives," Rayn chants. "Captain <first> brought us your missive, and we asked them to bring you here. Would you care to come inside?" They gesture toward the largest of the tents. While obviously surprised, Ambassador Yashili acquiesces, and the Hai step inside. Rayn gestures for you to follow. The remaining Remnant begin patrolling around the camp.|1882|0
units.english: Before you can answer, a number of Remnant emerge from the tents, and you notice that Rayn is among them. "Welcome to our encampment, representatives," Rayn chants. "Captain <first> brought us your missive, and we asked them to bring you here. Would you care to come inside?" They gesture toward the largest of the tents. While obviously surprised, Ambassador Yashili acquiesces, and the Hai step inside. Rayn gestures for you to follow. The remaining Remnant begin patrolling around the camp.
units.italian: Prima che tu possa rispondere, diversi Remnant emergono dalle tende, e noti che Rayn è tra loro. "Benvenuti nel nostro accampamento, rappresentanti," canta Rayn. "Il capitano <first> ci ha portato il vostro messaggio, e gli abbiamo chiesto di condurvi qui. Vi va di entrare?" Fa un gesto verso la più grande delle tende. Pur essendo chiaramente sorpresa, l'ambasciatrice Yashili acconsente, e gli Hai entrano. Rayn ti fa cenno di seguirli. Gli altri Remnant cominciano a pattugliare intorno al campo.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	Rayn offers food and water to the Hai and then takes a seat on a cushion on the ground. The Hai politely refuse the food before joining Rayn on the cushions. Ambassador Yashili begins. "We come representing the Hai people, who live far from here. Some of our brothers and sisters have turned violent toward us, and have recently created a new ship that may cause us much trouble. We have created a ship of our own in retaliation, but we are still in need of technology capable of repairing the hull of a ship while in flight so that we may have an advantage. Captain <last> has told us that you have such technology, with ship hulls that repair themselves."|1883|0
units.english: Rayn offers food and water to the Hai and then takes a seat on a cushion on the ground. The Hai politely refuse the food before joining Rayn on the cushions. Ambassador Yashili begins. "We come representing the Hai people, who live far from here. Some of our brothers and sisters have turned violent toward us, and have recently created a new ship that may cause us much trouble. We have created a ship of our own in retaliation, but we are still in need of technology capable of repairing the hull of a ship while in flight so that we may have an advantage. Captain <last> has told us that you have such technology, with ship hulls that repair themselves."
units.italian: Rayn offre cibo e acqua agli Hai e poi si siede su un cuscino a terra. Gli Hai rifiutano educatamente il cibo prima di unirsi a Rayn sui cuscini. L'ambasciatrice Yashili comincia. "Veniamo in rappresentanza del popolo Hai, che vive lontano da qui. Alcune delle nostre sorelle e fratelli sono diventati violenti nei nostri confronti, e di recente hanno creato una nuova nave che potrebbe crearci molti problemi. In rappresaglia abbiamo creato una nostra nave, ma abbiamo ancora bisogno di tecnologia capace di riparare lo scafo di una nave in volo, per avere un vantaggio. Il capitano <last> ci ha detto che voi avete questa tecnologia, con scafi che si riparano da soli."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"It is true that our ships self-repair," Rayn responds. "But this is not technology that we are able to share. The property is intrinsic to the metals that we build our ships with - metals which are in low supply." Yashili looks concerned with this development; perhaps this journey was a worthless one.|1884|0
units.english: "It is true that our ships self-repair," Rayn responds. "But this is not technology that we are able to share. The property is intrinsic to the metals that we build our ships with - metals which are in low supply." Yashili looks concerned with this development; perhaps this journey was a worthless one.
units.italian: "È vero che le nostre navi si autoriparano," risponde Rayn. "Ma non è una tecnologia che possiamo condividere. La proprietà è intrinseca ai metalli con cui costruiamo le nostre navi, metalli di cui c'è scarsa disponibilità." Yashili sembra preoccuparsi di questo sviluppo; forse questo viaggio è stato inutile.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"So is there no way that you can help them?"|1886|0
units.english: "So is there no way that you can help them?"
units.italian: "Quindi non c'è modo che possiate aiutarli?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"There must be something we could do."|1887|0
units.english: "There must be something we could do."
units.italian: "Deve esserci qualcosa che possiamo fare."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"Do not fear, for we have something else. For many decades, we have been fighting and plundering Korath raiders from the Core. Their ships contain outfits capable of hull repair through the use of small robots. We have been unable to reproduce these robots with ease, but we may be able to provide for you our research and a number of samples that you may use."|1888|0
units.english: "Do not fear, for we have something else. For many decades, we have been fighting and plundering Korath raiders from the Core. Their ships contain outfits capable of hull repair through the use of small robots. We have been unable to reproduce these robots with ease, but we may be able to provide for you our research and a number of samples that you may use."
units.italian: "Non temete, perché abbiamo qualcos'altro. Per molti decenni abbiamo combattuto e saccheggiato i predoni Korath del Nucleo. Le loro navi contengono equipaggiamenti capaci di riparare gli scafi grazie a piccoli robot. Non siamo riusciti a riprodurre questi robot con facilità, ma potremmo fornirvi le nostre ricerche e diversi campioni che potrete usare."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"We too have encountered these Korath," Yashili says in response. "Although, we had not taken their technology. This may be of great use to us."|1889|0
units.english: "We too have encountered these Korath," Yashili says in response. "Although, we had not taken their technology. This may be of great use to us."
units.italian: "Anche noi abbiamo incontrato questi Korath," risponde Yashili. "Anche se non abbiamo preso la loro tecnologia. Potrebbe esserci di grande utilità."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"We would like to ask something in trade, however: a copy of your astronomical records. The history of the galaxy itself is a mystery to us, and we would like to learn more about it."|1890|0
units.english: "We would like to ask something in trade, however: a copy of your astronomical records. The history of the galaxy itself is a mystery to us, and we would like to learn more about it."
units.italian: "Vorremmo però chiedere qualcosa in cambio: una copia dei vostri registri astronomici. La storia della galassia stessa è un mistero per noi, e vorremmo saperne di più."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	Ambassador Yashili looks thoughtful, then nods. "Historical astronomical data is scientifically valuable, as is learning how to repair our ships in flight. This seems a fair trade. We should be able to have the data for you shortly. We only need use of Captain <first>'s ship to access the hyperspace communication relays." Yashili nods to another member of the delegation, who then scurries off to your ship.|1891|0
units.english: Ambassador Yashili looks thoughtful, then nods. "Historical astronomical data is scientifically valuable, as is learning how to repair our ships in flight. This seems a fair trade. We should be able to have the data for you shortly. We only need use of Captain <first>'s ship to access the hyperspace communication relays." Yashili nods to another member of the delegation, who then scurries off to your ship.
units.italian: L'ambasciatrice Yashili sembra pensierosa, poi annuisce. "I dati astronomici storici hanno valore scientifico, come imparare a riparare le nostre navi in volo. Mi sembra uno scambio equo. Dovremmo poter avere i dati a breve. Ci serve solo la nave del capitano <first> per accedere ai relais di comunicazione dell'iperspazio." Yashili fa un cenno a un altro membro della delegazione, che sfreccia verso la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"I imagine there will be a large amount of data to transfer," Rayn says. "Let us pass the time."|1892|0
units.english: "I imagine there will be a large amount of data to transfer," Rayn says. "Let us pass the time."
units.italian: "Immagino ci sarà una grande quantità di dati da trasferire," dice Rayn. "Passiamo il tempo."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	Ambassador Yashili and Rayn settle into diplomatic small talk. The conversational dance between a group of professional diplomats and a secretive group that are currently playing the role of nomadic desert traders is an odd one.|1893|0
units.english: Ambassador Yashili and Rayn settle into diplomatic small talk. The conversational dance between a group of professional diplomats and a secretive group that are currently playing the role of nomadic desert traders is an odd one.
units.italian: L'ambasciatrice Yashili e Rayn si lasciano andare a chiacchiere diplomatiche. La danza conversazionale tra un gruppo di diplomatici di professione e un gruppo riservato che al momento recita il ruolo di commercianti nomadi del deserto è davvero strana.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"While we wait, I am curious how you met these Remnant, Captain," Yashili says.|1894|0
units.english: "While we wait, I am curious how you met these Remnant, Captain," Yashili says.
units.italian: "Mentre aspettiamo, sono curiosa di sapere come ha conosciuto questo Remnant, capitano," dice Yashili.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"I spend much of my time exploring the galaxy. Sometimes you stumble upon interesting things."|1896|0
units.english: "I spend much of my time exploring the galaxy. Sometimes you stumble upon interesting things."
units.italian: "Passo molto del mio tempo esplorando la galassia. A volte ci si imbatte in cose interessanti."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"Well, the same way I'd imagine most people found you - by just wandering aimlessly."|1897|0
units.english: "Well, the same way I'd imagine most people found you - by just wandering aimlessly."
units.italian: "Beh, allo stesso modo in cui immagino la maggior parte della gente vi abbia trovati: vagando senza meta."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	Yashili nods. "This is an understandable situation."|1898|0
units.english: Yashili nods. "This is an understandable situation."
units.italian: Yashili annuisce. "È una situazione comprensibile."

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	An hour of conversation later, the Ambassador's assistant returns with a large data drive and hands it to her. The Remnant pull out a data chip of their own, and the two groups formally exchange the data. In response to an unseen signal, another Remnant pulls back one side of the tent, and a team carries in a segment from a systems core with several of the small robots. "There are more of these waiting outside, but here is a sample for you to inspect. Using the instructions we have provided, you should have no problem making use of this technology." They poke at the console, and the robots promptly spring to life and assemble a small pile of parts into a model ship.|1900|0
units.english: An hour of conversation later, the Ambassador's assistant returns with a large data drive and hands it to her. The Remnant pull out a data chip of their own, and the two groups formally exchange the data. In response to an unseen signal, another Remnant pulls back one side of the tent, and a team carries in a segment from a systems core with several of the small robots. "There are more of these waiting outside, but here is a sample for you to inspect. Using the instructions we have provided, you should have no problem making use of this technology." They poke at the console, and the robots promptly spring to life and assemble a small pile of parts into a model ship.
units.italian: Un'ora di conversazione dopo, l'assistente dell'ambasciatrice torna con un grande disco di dati e glielo consegna. Il Remnant tira fuori un chip di dati proprio, e i due gruppi si scambiano formalmente i dati. In risposta a un segnale invisibile, un altro Remnant scosta un lato della tenda, e una squadra porta dentro un segmento di un nucleo di sistema con diversi dei piccoli robot. "Ce ne sono altri fuori ad aspettare, ma ecco un campione da ispezionare. Usando le istruzioni che vi abbiamo fornito, non dovreste avere problemi a usare questa tecnologia." Armeggiano con la console, e i robot si animano subito e assemblano un mucchio di pezzi in una nave modello.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	"Thank you for doing business with us," says Ambassador Yashili. "You have a friend in the Hai." She bows and the Remnant return the bow with fluid grace before quickly shouldering the Korath equipment. They load everything onto the <ship> as the delegation boards, and you set out to return to <planet>.|1901|0
units.english: "Thank you for doing business with us," says Ambassador Yashili. "You have a friend in the Hai." She bows and the Remnant return the bow with fluid grace before quickly shouldering the Korath equipment. They load everything onto the <ship> as the delegation boards, and you set out to return to <planet>.
units.italian: "Grazie per aver fatto affari con noi," dice l'ambasciatrice Yashili. "Avete un'amica tra gli Hai." Si inchina e il Remnant ricambia l'inchino con grazia fluida prima di caricarsi in fretta l'equipaggiamento Korath sulle spalle. Caricano tutto sulla <ship> mentre la delegazione sale, e ti metti in viaggio per tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Strider: Remnant 3|	As you take off, a final glance at your exterior cameras shows the Remnant have already almost finished packing up their encampment onto the camels. As one tent comes down, it reveals an anti-aircraft artillery cannon installed on a sled. Despite the rustic appearance they portrayed, the Remnant certainly took their security seriously. There is still no ship visible, but you suspect that a Starling or Gull is undoubtedly hiding nearby.|1902|0
units.english: As you take off, a final glance at your exterior cameras shows the Remnant have already almost finished packing up their encampment onto the camels. As one tent comes down, it reveals an anti-aircraft artillery cannon installed on a sled. Despite the rustic appearance they portrayed, the Remnant certainly took their security seriously. There is still no ship visible, but you suspect that a Starling or Gull is undoubtedly hiding nearby.
units.italian: Mentre decolli, un ultimo sguardo alle telecamere esterne mostra che i Remnant hanno già quasi finito di caricare il loro accampamento sui cammelli. Quando una tenda viene smontata, rivela un cannone antiaereo installato su una slitta. Nonostante l'apparenza rustica che ostentavano, il Remnant prendeva certo sul serio la propria sicurezza. Non si vede ancora nessuna nave, ma sospetti che uno Starling o un Gull si nasconda senza dubbio nei paraggi.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|name|1909|0
units.english: Contact the Coalition
units.italian: Contatta la Coalizione

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|description|1910|0
units.english: Transport Ambassador Yashili and her delegation to <destination> to attempt to obtain hull repair technology from the Coalition.
units.italian: Trasporta l'ambasciatrice Yashili e la sua delegazione su <destination> per tentare di ottenere la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo dalla Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|blocked|1914|0
units.english: The Hai delegation to meet the Coalition requires 3 bunks for the trip, but you don't have enough available space! Return when you have room for the delegation.
units.italian: La delegazione Hai che deve incontrare la Coalizione richiede 3 cuccette per il viaggio, ma non hai abbastanza spazio disponibile! Torna quando avrai posto per la delegazione.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|You find the Hai delegation meant to travel to the Coalition to negotiate for the hull repair technology waiting for you in the spaceport. The leader of the delegation introduces herself as Ambassador Yashili. "I heard that we will be traveling a great distance across the galaxy. May we have a safe journey."|1919|0
units.english: You find the Hai delegation meant to travel to the Coalition to negotiate for the hull repair technology waiting for you in the spaceport. The leader of the delegation introduces herself as Ambassador Yashili. "I heard that we will be traveling a great distance across the galaxy. May we have a safe journey."
units.italian: Trovi la delegazione Hai incaricata di recarsi dalla Coalizione per negoziare la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo, che ti aspetta nello spazioporto. La capo della delegazione si presenta come ambasciatrice Yashili. "Ho saputo che viaggeremo per una grande distanza attraverso la galassia. Che il viaggio sia sicuro."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|	"Is there anything that we should know about this Coalition before meeting them?" another member of the delegation asks.|1920|0
units.english: "Is there anything that we should know about this Coalition before meeting them?" another member of the delegation asks.
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che dovremmo sapere di questa Coalizione prima di incontrarla?" chiede un altro membro della delegazione.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|	"The Coalition are a group of three species that live in harmony, just like the humans and Hai here. They should enjoy meeting new aliens."|1922|0
units.english: "The Coalition are a group of three species that live in harmony, just like the humans and Hai here. They should enjoy meeting new aliens."
units.italian: "La Coalizione è un gruppo di tre specie che vivono in armonia, proprio come gli umani e gli Hai qui. Dovrebbero essere felici di incontrare nuovi alieni."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|	"The Coalition hate the Quarg and went to war with them many millennia ago in order to drive them out of their space."|1924|0
units.english: "The Coalition hate the Quarg and went to war with them many millennia ago in order to drive them out of their space."
units.italian: "La Coalizione odia i Quarg ed è andata in guerra con loro molte migliaia di anni fa per scacciarli dal loro spazio."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|	"That is most concerning," Yashili says with nods of agreement from the other two members of the delegation. "Hopefully the presence of the Quarg in Hai space will be of no issue to them." Yashili thinks for a moment. "Or perhaps we could use this information to our advantage."|1925|0
units.english: "That is most concerning," Yashili says with nods of agreement from the other two members of the delegation. "Hopefully the presence of the Quarg in Hai space will be of no issue to them." Yashili thinks for a moment. "Or perhaps we could use this information to our advantage."
units.italian: "È molto preoccupante," dice Yashili, con cenni di assenso degli altri due membri della delegazione. "Speriamo che la presenza dei Quarg nello spazio degli Hai non sia un problema per loro." Yashili riflette un momento. "O forse potremmo usare questa informazione a nostro vantaggio."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|	The delegation gathers their things and boards your ship, and you plot a course for <destination>. Hopefully the Coalition will be willing to share with an alien species they just met.|1927|0
units.english: The delegation gathers their things and boards your ship, and you plot a course for <destination>. Hopefully the Coalition will be willing to share with an alien species they just met.
units.italian: La delegazione raccoglie le sue cose e sale sulla tua nave, e tracci una rotta per <destination>. Speriamo che la Coalizione sia disposta a condividere con una specie aliena appena conosciuta.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 1|dialog|1930|0
units.english: It appears that the delegation is bunked on escorts that have not arrived in this system yet. Take off and wait for them.
units.italian: Sembra che la delegazione sia sistemata su scorte che non sono ancora arrivate in questo sistema. Decolla e aspettale.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|name|1936|0
units.english: Technology Obtained
units.italian: Tecnologia ottenuta

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|description|1937|0
units.english: The delegation has successfully obtained hull repair technology from the Coalition. Return to <destination> so that the Hai can begin developing this technology for their new ship.
units.italian: La delegazione ha ottenuto con successo la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo dalla Coalizione. Torna su <destination> così che gli Hai possano iniziare a sviluppare questa tecnologia per la loro nuova nave.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|blocked|1943|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to return the Hai delegation and the repair technology back to <planet>.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per riportare la delegazione Hai e la tecnologia di riparazione su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|log|1947|0
units.english: Helped the Hai get in contact with the Coalition in order to learn how to create in-flight hull repair technology. The Hai obtained a schematic of the Coalition's repair modules, along with a number of samples.
units.italian: Hai aiutato gli Hai a mettersi in contatto con la Coalizione per imparare a creare la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo in volo. Gli Hai hanno ottenuto uno schema dei moduli di riparazione della Coalizione, insieme a diversi campioni.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|Before landing, you notify the Heliarch that you're bringing alien ambassadors to meet with them, and sure enough a Heliarch delegation is waiting for you when you land. They briefly salute you, but appear to be much more interested in the strange new beings you've brought to their center of government.|1949|0
units.english: Before landing, you notify the Heliarch that you're bringing alien ambassadors to meet with them, and sure enough a Heliarch delegation is waiting for you when you land. They briefly salute you, but appear to be much more interested in the strange new beings you've brought to their center of government.
units.italian: Prima di atterrare, avverti gli Heliarch che stai portando ambasciatori alieni a incontrarli, e in effetti una delegazione Heliarch ti aspetta quando atterri. Ti salutano brevemente, ma sembrano molto più interessati agli strani nuovi esseri che hai portato al loro centro di governo.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	The Hai delegation is momentarily confused by the unusual speech pattern the Coalition species have, but snap out of it shortly. The Heliarch then start explaining their story to the Hai, the same they told you when you first met them, including their warning about the Quarg. While both delegations are engaged in conversation, a Heliarch agent approaches you, asking, "To this precious encounter, with what purpose have you brought these people, Captain?"|1950|0
units.english: The Hai delegation is momentarily confused by the unusual speech pattern the Coalition species have, but snap out of it shortly. The Heliarch then start explaining their story to the Hai, the same they told you when you first met them, including their warning about the Quarg. While both delegations are engaged in conversation, a Heliarch agent approaches you, asking, "To this precious encounter, with what purpose have you brought these people, Captain?"
units.italian: La delegazione Hai è momentaneamente confusa dal modo di parlare insolito delle specie della Coalizione, ma si riprende in fretta. Gli Heliarch cominciano poi a raccontare la loro storia agli Hai, la stessa che raccontarono a te quando li incontrasti la prima volta, compreso il loro avvertimento sui Quarg. Mentre le due delegazioni sono impegnate a conversare, un agente Heliarch ti si avvicina e chiede: "A questo prezioso incontro, con quale scopo hai portato questa gente, capitano?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"They're in need of your help."|1952|0
units.english: "They're in need of your help."
units.italian: "Hanno bisogno del vostro aiuto."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"They come seeking technology."|1953|0
units.english: "They come seeking technology."
units.italian: "Vengono in cerca di tecnologia."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	You start talking to them about the Hai and their conflict with the Unfettered, but as you're explaining you hear a loud collective gasp coming from the Heliarchs that are conversing with the Hai. A member of the Heliarch delegation approaches you. "Captain <last>, kindly telling us about their territory and society, your friend Yashili has. Truthful, is it, that close to the Hai planets, a ringworld the Quarg have constructed?"|1954|0
units.english: You start talking to them about the Hai and their conflict with the Unfettered, but as you're explaining you hear a loud collective gasp coming from the Heliarchs that are conversing with the Hai. A member of the Heliarch delegation approaches you. "Captain <last>, kindly telling us about their territory and society, your friend Yashili has. Truthful, is it, that close to the Hai planets, a ringworld the Quarg have constructed?"
units.italian: Cominci a parlare con loro degli Hai e del loro conflitto con gli Slegati, ma mentre spieghi senti un forte sussurro collettivo arrivare dagli Heliarch che conversano con gli Hai. Un membro della delegazione Heliarch ti si avvicina. "Capitano <last>, raccontando gentilmente del loro territorio e della loro società, la vostra amica Yashili ci ha parlato. È vero, che vicino ai pianeti degli Hai c'è un mondo ad anello che i Quarg hanno costruito?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	The others seem to be in an excited conversation of their own, after changing their translation devices to no longer speak human. Yashili and the other Hai also turn to you, looking somewhat confused, waiting for you to respond for them.|1955|0
