units.english: The others seem to be in an excited conversation of their own, after changing their translation devices to no longer speak human. Yashili and the other Hai also turn to you, looking somewhat confused, waiting for you to respond for them.
units.italian: Gli altri sembrano impegnati in una loro conversazione eccitata, dopo aver modificato i loro dispositivi di traduzione per non parlare più umano. Anche Yashili e gli altri Hai si voltano verso di te, un po' confusi, aspettando che risponda per loro.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"The Quarg are indeed there, but they stay out of Hai business, and the Hai stay out of theirs."|1957|0
units.english: "The Quarg are indeed there, but they stay out of Hai business, and the Hai stay out of theirs."
units.italian: "I Quarg sono davvero lì, ma restano fuori dagli affari degli Hai, e gli Hai restano fuori dai loro."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"Yes, the Quarg have a single system there with a complete ringworld, where many Hai and even some humans also live."|1959|0
units.english: "Yes, the Quarg have a single system there with a complete ringworld, where many Hai and even some humans also live."
units.italian: "Sì, i Quarg hanno un solo sistema lì con un mondo ad anello completo, dove vivono anche molti Hai e persino alcuni umani."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	The Heliarchs speak among themselves at a rapid pace, and before you know it several dozen other agents are around. One of them, an older Saryd with a golden circlet, says, "Tell us more about this ringworld, you must, Hai friends. Accompany us, would you?"|1960|0
units.english: The Heliarchs speak among themselves at a rapid pace, and before you know it several dozen other agents are around. One of them, an older Saryd with a golden circlet, says, "Tell us more about this ringworld, you must, Hai friends. Accompany us, would you?"
units.italian: Gli Heliarch parlano tra loro a ritmo serrato, e prima che tu te ne accorga ci sono attorno diverse dozzine di altri agenti. Uno di loro, un Saryd anziano con un cerchietto dorato, dice: "Raccontarci di più su questo mondo ad anello, dovete, amici Hai. Accompagnarci, volete?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	Without waiting for the Hai delegation to answer, they practically drag them to a restricted section of the ringworld without you. About an hour later, the Hai are brought back, most with tired expressions.|1961|0
units.english: Without waiting for the Hai delegation to answer, they practically drag them to a restricted section of the ringworld without you. About an hour later, the Hai are brought back, most with tired expressions.
units.italian: Senza aspettare la risposta della delegazione Hai, praticamente la trascinano in una sezione riservata del mondo ad anello senza di te. Circa un'ora dopo, gli Hai vengono riportati indietro, la maggior parte con espressioni stanche.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"Had I known we would be interrogated on the engineering aspects and the inner workings of a ringworld, I would have had an engineer come with us," Yashili whispers to you.|1962|0
units.english: "Had I known we would be interrogated on the engineering aspects and the inner workings of a ringworld, I would have had an engineer come with us," Yashili whispers to you.
units.italian: "Se avessi saputo che ci avrebbero interrogato sugli aspetti ingegneristici e sul funzionamento interno di un mondo ad anello, avrei portato un ingegnere con noi," ti sussurra Yashili.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	The Heliarchs once again warn the Hai to be careful with the Quarg before finally letting the Hai explain the reason for their trip here.|1965|0
units.english: The Heliarchs once again warn the Hai to be careful with the Quarg before finally letting the Hai explain the reason for their trip here.
units.italian: Gli Heliarch avvertono ancora una volta gli Hai di stare attenti ai Quarg, prima di lasciarli finalmente spiegare il motivo del loro viaggio.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	The delegation still looks a bit overwhelmed, as if still processing all the history the Heliarch just told them, but Yashili has kept her composure and begins speaking. "We come representing the Hai people, who live far from here. Some of our brothers and sisters have turned violent toward us, and have recently created a new ship that may cause us much trouble. We have created a ship of our own in retaliation, but we are still in need of technology capable of repairing the hull of a ship while in flight so that we may have an advantage. Captain <last> has told us that you possess such technology."|1966|0
units.english: The delegation still looks a bit overwhelmed, as if still processing all the history the Heliarch just told them, but Yashili has kept her composure and begins speaking. "We come representing the Hai people, who live far from here. Some of our brothers and sisters have turned violent toward us, and have recently created a new ship that may cause us much trouble. We have created a ship of our own in retaliation, but we are still in need of technology capable of repairing the hull of a ship while in flight so that we may have an advantage. Captain <last> has told us that you possess such technology."
units.italian: La delegazione sembra ancora un po' sopraffatta, come se stesse ancora elaborando tutta la storia che gli Heliarch hanno appena raccontato, ma Yashili ha mantenuto la compostezza e comincia a parlare. "Veniamo in rappresentanza del popolo Hai, che vive lontano da qui. Alcune delle nostre sorelle e fratelli sono diventati violenti nei nostri confronti, e di recente hanno creato una nuova nave che potrebbe crearci molti problemi. In rappresaglia abbiamo creato una nostra nave, ma abbiamo ancora bisogno di tecnologia capace di riparare lo scafo di una nave in volo, per avere un vantaggio. Il capitano <last> ci ha detto che voi possedete questa tecnologia."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"Developed such technology, indeed we have," an Arach agent responds. "Composed of several dozens of small repair bots, and their center of command, such outfits are."|1967|0
units.english: "Developed such technology, indeed we have," an Arach agent responds. "Composed of several dozens of small repair bots, and their center of command, such outfits are."
units.italian: "Sviluppato una tale tecnologia, in effetti l'abbiamo," risponde un agente Arach. "Composti da diverse dozzine di piccoli robot di riparazione, e dal loro centro di comando, tali equipaggiamenti sono."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"Would you be willing to give or sell one of those outfits to the Hai?"|1969|0
units.english: "Would you be willing to give or sell one of those outfits to the Hai?"
units.italian: "Sareste disposti a dare o vendere uno di quegli equipaggiamenti agli Hai?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"Would you be willing to share how those outfits are mass-produced with the Hai?"|1970|0
units.english: "Would you be willing to share how those outfits are mass-produced with the Hai?"
units.italian: "Sareste disposti a condividere con gli Hai come quegli equipaggiamenti vengono prodotti in serie?"

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"Much involved in the production of our repair modules, House Chamgar is," the same Arach says. "Contact their representatives in this ring, we will."|1971|0
units.english: "Much involved in the production of our repair modules, House Chamgar is," the same Arach says. "Contact their representatives in this ring, we will."
units.italian: "Molto coinvolta nella produzione dei nostri moduli di riparazione, la Casa Chamgar è," dice lo stesso Arach. "Contattare i loro rappresentanti in questo anello, li faremo."

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"Do you desire anything in return?" Yashili asks the agent.|1972|0
units.english: "Do you desire anything in return?" Yashili asks the agent.
units.italian: "Desiderate qualcosa in cambio?" chiede Yashili all'agente.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	"In return, we ask nothing. Helping you extend beyond the limits placed upon you by the Quarg, enough of a reward is," the Arach responds. Yashili looks somewhat puzzled, but does not press the issue any further.|1973|0
units.english: "In return, we ask nothing. Helping you extend beyond the limits placed upon you by the Quarg, enough of a reward is," the Arach responds. Yashili looks somewhat puzzled, but does not press the issue any further.
units.italian: "In cambio, non chiediamo nulla. Aiutarvi a estendervi oltre i limiti che i Quarg vi hanno imposto, una ricompensa sufficiente è," risponde l'Arach. Yashili sembra un po' perplessa, ma non insiste oltre.

units.id: mission:Strider: Coalition 2|	A short time later, a group of Arachi representing House Chamgar arrive. They have the Hai describe their ships, using this information to optimize the repair module for Hai ships. They then prepare a copy of the blueprints, handing a data chip containing the schematics for the hull repair modules and their hull-walking robots to the Hai. Some workers then load a crate with two small modules onto your ship for the Hai to use as examples. Yashili thanks the Coalition for their generosity and boards your ship, ready to return to <destination>.|1974|0
units.english: A short time later, a group of Arachi representing House Chamgar arrive. They have the Hai describe their ships, using this information to optimize the repair module for Hai ships. They then prepare a copy of the blueprints, handing a data chip containing the schematics for the hull repair modules and their hull-walking robots to the Hai. Some workers then load a crate with two small modules onto your ship for the Hai to use as examples. Yashili thanks the Coalition for their generosity and boards your ship, ready to return to <destination>.
units.italian: Poco dopo arriva un gruppo di Arachi che rappresentano la Casa Chamgar. Fanno descrivere agli Hai le loro navi, usando queste informazioni per ottimizzare il modulo di riparazione per le navi Hai. Preparano poi una copia dei progetti e consegnano agli Hai un chip di dati contenente gli schemi dei moduli di riparazione dello scafo e dei loro robot camminatori. Alcuni operai caricano poi sulla tua nave una cassa con due piccoli moduli perché gli Hai li usino come esempi. Yashili ringrazia la Coalizione per la generosità e sale sulla tua nave, pronta a tornare su <destination>.

units.id: event:pond strider mass production v2|"Baellie" Atomic Engines|2004|0
units.english: "Baellie" Atomic Engines
units.italian: Motori atomici "Baellie"

units.id: event:pond strider mass production v2|"Baellie" Atomic Engines|2009|0
units.english: "Baellie" Atomic Engines
units.italian: Motori atomici "Baellie"

units.id: mission:Strider 3|Yashili contacts the elders as you land, informing them that you have obtained the hull repair technology. They agree to meet you in the spaceport along with Osen. A group of spaceport workers begins unloading the samples from your cargo bay after you land.|2048|0
units.english: Yashili contacts the elders as you land, informing them that you have obtained the hull repair technology. They agree to meet you in the spaceport along with Osen. A group of spaceport workers begins unloading the samples from your cargo bay after you land.
units.italian: Yashili contatta gli anziani mentre atterri, informandoli che hai ottenuto la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo. Accettano di incontrarti allo spazioporto insieme a Osen. Un gruppo di operai dello spazioporto comincia a scaricare i campioni dalla tua stiva dopo l'atterraggio.

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	As you depart your ship, you spot the Hai elders and Osen approaching. Ambassador Yashili and the Hai delegation step forward to meet them.|2049|0
units.english: As you depart your ship, you spot the Hai elders and Osen approaching. Ambassador Yashili and the Hai delegation step forward to meet them.
units.italian: Mentre lasci la nave, scorgi gli anziani Hai e Osen che si avvicinano. L'ambasciatrice Yashili e la delegazione Hai si fanno avanti per incontrarli.

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"I hope the Remnant treated you well," one of the elders says.|2053|0
units.english: "I hope the Remnant treated you well," one of the elders says.
units.italian: "Spero che il Remnant vi abbia trattati bene," dice uno degli anziani.

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"They were an interesting group. Very reclusive, and not willing to share much about their people, but they were more than willing to help after we provided them with a copy of our historical astronomical data."|2054|0
units.english: "They were an interesting group. Very reclusive, and not willing to share much about their people, but they were more than willing to help after we provided them with a copy of our historical astronomical data."
units.italian: "Erano un gruppo interessante. Molto appartati, e non disposti a condividere molto del loro popolo, ma più che disposti ad aiutarci dopo che abbiamo fornito loro una copia dei nostri dati astronomici storici."

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"I hope the Coalition treated you well," one of the elders says.|2058|0
units.english: "I hope the Coalition treated you well," one of the elders says.
units.italian: "Spero che la Coalizione vi abbia trattati bene," dice uno degli anziani.

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"They were an interesting group. Very enthusiastic about meeting new people, although very touchy on the subject of the Quarg."|2059|0
units.english: "They were an interesting group. Very enthusiastic about meeting new people, although very touchy on the subject of the Quarg."
units.italian: "Erano un gruppo interessante. Molto entusiasti di incontrare gente nuova, anche se molto suscettibili sul tema dei Quarg."

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	Yashili then hands the copy of the data to Osen. "You'll be needing this," she says.|2062|0
units.english: Yashili then hands the copy of the data to Osen. "You'll be needing this," she says.
units.italian: Yashili consegna poi la copia dei dati a Osen. "Ti servirà," dice.

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"And I'll certainly love it," Osen responds. "The spaceport workers have already sent the cargo en route to my shipyard. I'll begin working on integrating it into the Pond Strider immediately."|2063|0
units.english: "And I'll certainly love it," Osen responds. "The spaceport workers have already sent the cargo en route to my shipyard. I'll begin working on integrating it into the Pond Strider immediately."
units.italian: "E di sicuro lo adorerò," risponde Osen. "Gli operai dello spazioporto hanno già mandato il carico verso il mio cantiere. Comincerò subito a integrarlo nel Pond Strider."

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"Pond Strider?"|2065|0
units.english: "Pond Strider?"
units.italian: "Pond Strider?"

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"I hope you have fun with that."|2066|0
units.english: "I hope you have fun with that."
units.italian: "Spero che ti divertirai."

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"Yes. That is the name that we settled on for the ship, and its drones will be named the Flea."|2069|0
units.english: "Yes. That is the name that we settled on for the ship, and its drones will be named the Flea."
units.italian: "Sì. È il nome su cui ci siamo accordati per la nave, e i suoi droni si chiameranno Flea."

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"I'm getting itchy just thinking about it," one of the elders jokes.|2070|0
units.english: "I'm getting itchy just thinking about it," one of the elders jokes.
units.italian: "Mi prudono le mani solo a pensarci," scherza uno degli anziani.

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"It's hard not to have fun when you love doing your job."|2074|0
units.english: "It's hard not to have fun when you love doing your job."
units.italian: "È difficile non divertirsi quando ami il tuo lavoro."

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	Osen is about to run off, but one of the elders stops him. "Can you give us an estimate on how long it will take to make use of this information?"|2077|0
units.english: Osen is about to run off, but one of the elders stops him. "Can you give us an estimate on how long it will take to make use of this information?"
units.italian: Osen sta per correre via, ma uno degli anziani lo ferma. "Può darci una stima di quanto tempo servirà per usare queste informazioni?"

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"Oh, yes," Osen says. "It may take us a few months to get everything working. At least a single month, if we are lucky."|2078|0
units.english: "Oh, yes," Osen says. "It may take us a few months to get everything working. At least a single month, if we are lucky."
units.italian: "Oh, sì," dice Osen. "Potrebbero servirci alcuni mesi per far funzionare tutto. Almeno un mese, se siamo fortunati."

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"This is good to know. The sooner we have these ships functional, the better."|2079|0
units.english: "This is good to know. The sooner we have these ships functional, the better."
units.italian: "È bene saperlo. Prima avremo queste navi funzionanti, meglio è."

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	Osen once again gets ready to run off, but this time stops himself and turns to you. "Thank you Captain. Without this information, it could have taken me years to finish this project." You nod in response, and Osen finally runs off to his shipyard.|2080|0
units.english: Osen once again gets ready to run off, but this time stops himself and turns to you. "Thank you Captain. Without this information, it could have taken me years to finish this project." You nod in response, and Osen finally runs off to his shipyard.
units.italian: Osen si prepara di nuovo a correre via, ma questa volta si ferma e si volta verso di te. "Grazie, capitano. Senza queste informazioni, avrei potuto impiegare anni per finire questo progetto." Annuisci in risposta, e Osen corre finalmente al suo cantiere.

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"I would like to thank you as well," Yashili says. "It has been some time since I have had the chance to leave our space. It is always exciting to go to new places and meet new people." Yashili bows to you, and you return a bow of your own.|2081|0
units.english: "I would like to thank you as well," Yashili says. "It has been some time since I have had the chance to leave our space. It is always exciting to go to new places and meet new people." Yashili bows to you, and you return a bow of your own.
units.italian: "Vorrei ringraziarla anch'io," dice Yashili. "È passato un po' di tempo dall'ultima volta che ho avuto la possibilità di lasciare il nostro spazio. È sempre emozionante andare in posti nuovi e incontrare gente nuova." Yashili si inchina a te, e tu ricambi l'inchino.

units.id: mission:Strider 3|	"And we also need to express our gratitude," one of the elders says. "It is good to have you as a friend of the Hai. We shall keep you no longer, though. May you stay safe on your adventures."|2082|0
units.english: "And we also need to express our gratitude," one of the elders says. "It is good to have you as a friend of the Hai. We shall keep you no longer, though. May you stay safe on your adventures."
units.italian: "E anche noi dobbiamo esprimere la nostra gratitudine," dice uno degli anziani. "È bello avere lei come amico degli Hai. Ma non la tratterremo oltre. Che sia al sicuro nelle sue avventure."

units.id: mission:Strider notification|scene|2096|0
units.english: thumbnail/hai pond strider
units.italian: thumbnail/hai pond strider

units.id: mission:Strider notification|Upon landing on <planet>, you receive a message from Osen. "Hello Captain <last>! I hope this message finds you well. I would like to thank you once again for your help on the Pond Strider, and would like to inform you that we have finished integrating the hull repair technology that you have provided us into the Pond Strider. We have now put the ship into mass production. You may also be interested to learn that we have developed new weaponry for the Pond Strider's drone, the Flea. I won't spoil the surprise for you, though. Check out the shipyard on Hai-home the next time you stop by and take a look at the Flea yourself."|2097|0
units.english: Upon landing on <planet>, you receive a message from Osen. "Hello Captain <last>! I hope this message finds you well. I would like to thank you once again for your help on the Pond Strider, and would like to inform you that we have finished integrating the hull repair technology that you have provided us into the Pond Strider. We have now put the ship into mass production. You may also be interested to learn that we have developed new weaponry for the Pond Strider's drone, the Flea. I won't spoil the surprise for you, though. Check out the shipyard on Hai-home the next time you stop by and take a look at the Flea yourself."
units.italian: Atterrando su <planet>, ricevi un messaggio da Osen. "Salve capitano <last>! Spero che questo messaggio la trovi bene. Vorrei ringraziarla ancora una volta per il suo aiuto con il Pond Strider, e informarla che abbiamo finito di integrare nel Pond Strider la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo che ci ha fornito. Abbiamo ora avviato la produzione in serie della nave. Potrebbe anche interessarle sapere che abbiamo sviluppato nuove armi per il drone del Pond Strider, il Flea. Però non le rovinerò la sorpresa. Passi dal cantiere su Hai-home la prossima volta che capita e dia un'occhiata al Flea di persona."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|name|2104|0
units.english: Hai film crew to <planet>
units.italian: Troupe cinematografica Hai per <planet>

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|description|2105|0
units.english: Bring a film crew from <origin> to <destination>, so that they can shoot a horror film there. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Porta una troupe cinematografica da <origin> a <destination>, così che possano girarci un film dell'orrore. La paga è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|A rapid tapping on your shoulder dissipates any intentions you might have had about touring this spaceport in peace. You turn around to find a Hai, short even by their standards, looking up at you.|2118|0
units.english: A rapid tapping on your shoulder dissipates any intentions you might have had about touring this spaceport in peace. You turn around to find a Hai, short even by their standards, looking up at you.
units.italian: Un rapido tamburellare sulla spalla dissolve qualsiasi intenzione tu avessi di visitare questo spazioporto in pace. Ti volti e trovi una Hai, bassa persino per i loro standard, che ti guarda dal basso in alto.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"You're a ship captain, yes? Would you like to be part of cinema history?" she asks.|2119|0
units.english: "You're a ship captain, yes? Would you like to be part of cinema history?" she asks.
units.italian: "Lei è un capitano di nave, vero? Le piacerebbe far parte della storia del cinema?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"I'm not much of a movie buff. I'll pass."|2121|0
units.english: "I'm not much of a movie buff. I'll pass."
units.italian: "Non sono un appassionato di film. Passo."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Sure, what do you need me to do?"|2123|0
units.english: "Sure, what do you need me to do?"
units.italian: "Certo, di cosa hai bisogno che faccia?"

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"What do you mean?"|2124|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"My name is Likeet, and I'm the director of an independent film production. We need you to bring <bunks> crew members and <tons> of film equipment to <planet>, then bring us back after about a month. We can pay you <payment>, but the immaterial rewards of being involved in an ambitious project such as this will be priceless."|2125|0
units.english: "My name is Likeet, and I'm the director of an independent film production. We need you to bring <bunks> crew members and <tons> of film equipment to <planet>, then bring us back after about a month. We can pay you <payment>, but the immaterial rewards of being involved in an ambitious project such as this will be priceless."
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Likeet, e sono la regista di una produzione cinematografica indipendente. Abbiamo bisogno che porti <bunks> membri della troupe e <tons> di attrezzature cinematografiche su <planet>, poi che ci riporti indietro dopo circa un mese. Possiamo pagarla <payment>, ma le ricompense immateriali di partecipare a un progetto ambizioso come questo non avranno prezzo."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Why would you want to film in <planet>? Isn't that an abandoned station?"|2127|0
units.english: "Why would you want to film in <planet>? Isn't that an abandoned station?"
units.italian: "Perché vorreste girare su <planet>? Non è una stazione abbandonata?"

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"What's so special about <planet> for filming?"|2130|0
units.english: "What's so special about <planet> for filming?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ha di speciale <planet> per le riprese?"

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Sure, I can take you there."|2133|0
units.english: "Sure, I can take you there."
units.italian: "Certo, posso portarvi lì."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"I'm not going that way. You'll need to find some other captain."|2135|0
units.english: "I'm not going that way. You'll need to find some other captain."
units.italian: "Non vado in quella direzione. Dovrete trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Ah, you must not know about <planet>. There are many tales which swirl around the station, chief among them being the existence of ghosts and monsters haunting its corridors. We'd like to take advantage of the popular image of <planet> in the creation of our horror film by using it as a backdrop. It's sort of the human equivalent of setting your film in a 'haunted' forest. Don't worry, we'll bring enough food to last us for the month."|2137|0
units.english: "Ah, you must not know about <planet>. There are many tales which swirl around the station, chief among them being the existence of ghosts and monsters haunting its corridors. We'd like to take advantage of the popular image of <planet> in the creation of our horror film by using it as a backdrop. It's sort of the human equivalent of setting your film in a 'haunted' forest. Don't worry, we'll bring enough food to last us for the month."
units.italian: "Ah, lei non deve sapere niente di <planet>. Ci sono molte storie che girano attorno alla stazione, e la principale è l'esistenza di fantasmi e mostri che infestano i suoi corridoi. Vorremmo sfruttare l'immagine popolare di <planet> per la creazione del nostro film dell'orrore usandola come sfondo. È più o meno l'equivalente umano di ambientare il film in una foresta 'infestata'. Non si preoccupi, porteremo cibo a sufficienza per un mese."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Why do people think it's haunted?"|2139|0
units.english: "Why do people think it's haunted?"
units.italian: "Perché la gente pensa che sia infestata?"

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Alright then, I can take you there."|2140|0
units.english: "Alright then, I can take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, allora posso portarvi lì."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"I'm not going that way. You'll need to find some other captain."|2142|0
units.english: "I'm not going that way. You'll need to find some other captain."
units.italian: "Non vado in quella direzione. Dovrete trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Back when the station was still in use, there was a mysterious malfunction in one of the hatches which released oxygen out the airlock. Hundreds on board suffocated to death. To this day, no one knows what caused it, and legends have grown out of the event."|2144|0
units.english: "Back when the station was still in use, there was a mysterious malfunction in one of the hatches which released oxygen out the airlock. Hundreds on board suffocated to death. To this day, no one knows what caused it, and legends have grown out of the event."
units.italian: "Ai tempi in cui la stazione era ancora in uso, ci fu un misterioso guasto in uno dei portelli che liberò ossigeno fuori dalla camera di equilibrio. Centinaia di persone a bordo morirono soffocate. A tutt'oggi nessuno sa cosa lo abbia causato, e le leggende sono nate da quell'evento."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"What makes you think I'm parking my ship at a haunted station?"|2146|0
units.english: "What makes you think I'm parking my ship at a haunted station?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ti fa pensare che parcheggerò la nave in una stazione infestata?"

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Alright then, I can take you there."|2147|0
units.english: "Alright then, I can take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, allora posso portarvi lì."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"I'm not going that way. You'll need to find some other captain."|2149|0
units.english: "I'm not going that way. You'll need to find some other captain."
units.italian: "Non vado in quella direzione. Dovrete trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	Likeet gives a laugh. "It's not actually haunted, of course. Those are just stories. Do you think I'd send an entire film crew and all their expensive equipment to a place that was actually dangerous?"|2151|0
units.english: Likeet gives a laugh. "It's not actually haunted, of course. Those are just stories. Do you think I'd send an entire film crew and all their expensive equipment to a place that was actually dangerous?"
units.italian: Likeet ride. "Non è davvero infestata, naturalmente. Sono solo storie. Crede che manderei un'intera troupe con tutte le loro costose attrezzature in un posto davvero pericoloso?"

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Alright then, I can take you there."|2153|0
units.english: "Alright then, I can take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, allora posso portarvi lì."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"I'm not going that way. You'll need to find some other captain."|2154|0
units.english: "I'm not going that way. You'll need to find some other captain."
units.italian: "Non vado in quella direzione. Dovrete trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Excellent! I'll let the crew know where to find you."|2157|0
units.english: "Excellent! I'll let the crew know where to find you."
units.italian: "Eccellente! Dirò alla troupe dove trovarla."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|You help your passengers unload all of their film equipment once you arrive on <planet>. The props seem to get more and more elaborate as they are unpacked from your ship; you note the presence of countless rubber limbs, mechanical monsters, and cans of fake blood being carried onto the set. Once you are finished, Likeet approaches you.|2165|0
units.english: You help your passengers unload all of their film equipment once you arrive on <planet>. The props seem to get more and more elaborate as they are unpacked from your ship; you note the presence of countless rubber limbs, mechanical monsters, and cans of fake blood being carried onto the set. Once you are finished, Likeet approaches you.
units.italian: Aiuti i tuoi passeggeri a scaricare tutte le loro attrezzature cinematografiche una volta arrivato su <planet>. Gli oggetti di scena sembrano diventare sempre più elaborati mentre vengono estratti dalla nave; noti la presenza di innumerevoli arti di gomma, mostri meccanici e lattine di sangue finto portate sul set. Quando hai finito, Likeet ti si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"What's your movie about, anyways?"|2167|0
units.english: "What's your movie about, anyways?"
units.italian: "Di che cosa parla il tuo film, comunque?"

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"I better get going, then."|2168|0
units.english: "I better get going, then."
units.italian: "Meglio che vada, allora."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"I don't want to spoil anything, but it's a psychological horror film that explores the nature of isolation, and the shadow that our own mortality casts over our lives." She continues to elaborate on more philosophical themes that seemingly have less and less to do with the actual film, until she notices that your eyes have long since glazed over.|2170|0
units.english: "I don't want to spoil anything, but it's a psychological horror film that explores the nature of isolation, and the shadow that our own mortality casts over our lives." She continues to elaborate on more philosophical themes that seemingly have less and less to do with the actual film, until she notices that your eyes have long since glazed over.
units.italian: "Non voglio rovinarti niente, ma è un film horror psicologico che esplora la natura dell'isolamento e l'ombra che la nostra stessa mortalità getta sulle nostre vite." Continua a dilungarsi su temi sempre più filosofici che sembrano avere sempre meno a che fare con il film vero e proprio, finché non nota che i tuoi occhi sono ormai vitrei da un pezzo.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Well, anyways, thanks for your help, Captain. I'll contact you in a month once we're finished filming," says Likeet.|2171|0
units.english: "Well, anyways, thanks for your help, Captain. I'll contact you in a month once we're finished filming," says Likeet.
units.italian: "Beh, comunque, grazie per l'aiuto, capitano. La contatterò tra un mese, quando avremo finito le riprese," dice Likeet.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 1|	"Thanks for your help, Captain. I'll contact you in a month once we're finished," says Likeet.|2174|0
units.english: "Thanks for your help, Captain. I'll contact you in a month once we're finished," says Likeet.
units.italian: "Grazie per l'aiuto, capitano. La contatterò tra un mese, quando avremo finito," dice Likeet.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 2|name|2184|0
units.english: Pick up Hai film crew on <planet>
units.italian: Preleva la troupe Hai su <planet>

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 2|description|2185|0
units.english: Go to <destination> to pick up the film crew you transported there.
units.italian: Vai su <destination> a prendere la troupe cinematografica che hai trasportato lì.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 2|Upon landing your ship you receive a voice call. Although the sender didn't bother to identify themselves, you soon recognize it as the voice of Likeet, the movie director that you brought to Darkrest a month ago.|2193|0
units.english: Upon landing your ship you receive a voice call. Although the sender didn't bother to identify themselves, you soon recognize it as the voice of Likeet, the movie director that you brought to Darkrest a month ago.
units.italian: Atterrando con la nave ricevi una chiamata vocale. Anche se il mittente non si è preso la briga di identificarsi, ben presto riconosci la voce di Likeet, la regista che hai portato su Darkrest un mese fa.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 2|	"Captain <last>! Good to see you again! We've finished filming here and need a ride off this place. I'll see you soon." Before you can say anything, she hangs up.|2194|0
units.english: "Captain <last>! Good to see you again! We've finished filming here and need a ride off this place. I'll see you soon." Before you can say anything, she hangs up.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>! Che bello rivederla! Abbiamo finito le riprese qui e ci serve un passaggio per andarcene da questo posto. Ci vediamo presto." Prima che tu possa dire qualcosa, riattacca.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 3|name|2200|0
units.english: Hai film crew to <planet>
units.italian: Troupe cinematografica Hai per <planet>

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 3|description|2201|0
units.english: Take Likeet's film crew home to their studio on <destination>, so that they can process the film they shot on <origin>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Riporta la troupe di Likeet al loro studio su <destination>, così che possano sviluppare il film girato su <origin>. La paga è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 3|blocked|2204|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai libero lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 3|The first thing you notice when you land on Darkrest is the mess. It looks as if a tornado has touched down on the set, and you don't remember Likeet talking about natural disasters when she described the movie.|2213|0
units.english: The first thing you notice when you land on Darkrest is the mess. It looks as if a tornado has touched down on the set, and you don't remember Likeet talking about natural disasters when she described the movie.
units.italian: La prima cosa che noti atterrando su Darkrest è il disordine. Sembra che un tornado si sia abbattuto sul set, e non ricordi che Likeet parlasse di disastri naturali quando descriveva il film.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 3|	"Controlled chaos, I call it," says Likeet, who has somehow materialized beside you. "We're just clearing everything out right now, making sure we didn't forget anything, the usual."|2214|0
units.english: "Controlled chaos, I call it," says Likeet, who has somehow materialized beside you. "We're just clearing everything out right now, making sure we didn't forget anything, the usual."
units.italian: "Caos controllato, lo chiamo io," dice Likeet, che in qualche modo si è materializzata accanto a te. "Stiamo solo svuotando tutto adesso, assicurandoci di non aver dimenticato niente, le solite cose."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 3|	It takes a few hours to load everything onto your ship. Once you're finished, the only sign that anyone was here is that the station's surfaces are free of dust.|2215|0
units.english: It takes a few hours to load everything onto your ship. Once you're finished, the only sign that anyone was here is that the station's surfaces are free of dust.
units.italian: Ci vogliono alcune ore per caricare tutto sulla tua nave. Quando hai finito, l'unico segno che qualcuno sia stato qui è che le superfici della stazione sono libere dalla polvere.

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 3|	"Alright, Captain. We'll need to get to <planet> so that we can edit the raw footage in our studio. Gonna be nice to finally be back on a planet instead of this tin can." She pauses, as if she's trying to remember a line. "Oh yeah, I'll pay you <payment> once we've arrived. Let's get out of here."|2216|0
units.english: "Alright, Captain. We'll need to get to <planet> so that we can edit the raw footage in our studio. Gonna be nice to finally be back on a planet instead of this tin can." She pauses, as if she's trying to remember a line. "Oh yeah, I'll pay you <payment> once we've arrived. Let's get out of here."
units.italian: "Bene, capitano. Dovremo andare su <planet> per montare il girato nel nostro studio. Sarà bello tornare finalmente su un pianeta invece di questa lattina." Si ferma, come se cercasse di ricordare una battuta. "Oh già, la pagherò <payment> una volta arrivati. Andiamocene da qui."

units.id: mission:Hai Film Crew 3|When you land on <planet>, you are approached by Likeet, who is carrying a large can of fake blood. "Thanks for the ride, Captain. Keep a lookout for my film in theaters. You'll know it when you see it." Once the cargo has been unloaded, she almost sprints away in excitement, no doubt trying to make it to her studio as quickly as possible. You notice that <payment> have been deposited into your account.|2223|0
units.english: When you land on <planet>, you are approached by Likeet, who is carrying a large can of fake blood. "Thanks for the ride, Captain. Keep a lookout for my film in theaters. You'll know it when you see it." Once the cargo has been unloaded, she almost sprints away in excitement, no doubt trying to make it to her studio as quickly as possible. You notice that <payment> have been deposited into your account.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <planet>, ti si avvicina Likeet, che porta una grande lattina di sangue finto. "Grazie per il passaggio, capitano. Tenga d'occhio il mio film nei cinema. Lo riconoscerà quando lo vedrà." Una volta scaricato il carico, quasi scatta via per l'emozione, senza dubbio cercando di arrivare al suo studio il prima possibile. Noti che <payment> sono stati depositati sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|name|2229|0
units.english: Bring students to <planet>
units.italian: Porta gli studenti su <planet>

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|description|2230|0
units.english: Bring a group of Hai and human students to <destination> to explore the abandoned station. They promise to pay you <payment>.
units.italian: Porta un gruppo di studenti Hai e umani su <destination> per esplorare la stazione abbandonata. Promettono di pagarti <payment>.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|It is a sunny afternoon as you idly walk through the spaceport alone, until you somehow find yourself surrounded by a group of young humans and Hai.|2240|0
units.english: It is a sunny afternoon as you idly walk through the spaceport alone, until you somehow find yourself surrounded by a group of young humans and Hai.
units.italian: È un pomeriggio soleggiato mentre cammini oziosamente per lo spazioporto da solo, finché in qualche modo ti ritrovi circondato da un gruppo di giovani umani e Hai.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"You're a spaceship captain, right? Could you take us to <planet>?" says one of the Hai, as if he had practiced this line for a while now.|2241|0
units.english: "You're a spaceship captain, right? Could you take us to <planet>?" says one of the Hai, as if he had practiced this line for a while now.
units.italian: "Lei è un capitano di navi spaziali, vero? Potrebbe portarci su <planet>?" dice uno degli Hai, come se avesse provato questa battuta per un po'.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	The human next to him gives him a nudge. "Don't forget to ask for a trip back, Tagreep, unless you want to be stranded there."|2242|0
units.english: The human next to him gives him a nudge. "Don't forget to ask for a trip back, Tagreep, unless you want to be stranded there."
units.italian: L'umano accanto gli dà una gomitata. "Non dimenticare di chiedere anche il viaggio di ritorno, Tagreep, a meno che tu non voglia restare bloccato là."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"What would you want to do on <planet>? Isn't that an abandoned station?"|2244|0
units.english: "What would you want to do on <planet>? Isn't that an abandoned station?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vorreste fare su <planet>? Non è una stazione abbandonata?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Why do you want to go to <planet>?"|2248|0
units.english: "Why do you want to go to <planet>?"
units.italian: "Perché volete andare su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Sure, I can take you there and back."|2252|0
units.english: "Sure, I can take you there and back."
units.italian: "Certo, posso portarvi lì e riportarvi indietro."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"How much can you pay me?"|2254|0
units.english: "How much can you pay me?"
units.italian: "Quanto potete pagarmi?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Sorry, I'm busy right now. Go ask some other captain."|2255|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm busy right now. Go ask some other captain."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, sono occupato adesso. Chiedete a un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	The group starts to shuffle around with a nervous air. "Well, we're still in school, so money's kind of tight right now... but we can pay you!" Tagreep pauses to glance at his friends and, in almost a whisper, says, "Is <payment> okay?"|2257|0
units.english: The group starts to shuffle around with a nervous air. "Well, we're still in school, so money's kind of tight right now... but we can pay you!" Tagreep pauses to glance at his friends and, in almost a whisper, says, "Is <payment> okay?"
units.italian: Il gruppo comincia a muoversi con un'aria nervosa. "Beh, andiamo ancora a scuola, quindi i soldi scarseggiano... ma possiamo pagarla!" Tagreep si ferma a guardare gli amici e, quasi sussurrando, dice: "Vanno bene <payment>?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Why would you want to pay money to go to <planet>, anyhow? Isn't that an abandoned station?"|2259|0
units.english: "Why would you want to pay money to go to <planet>, anyhow? Isn't that an abandoned station?"
units.italian: "Perché mai vorreste pagare per andare su <planet>? Non è una stazione abbandonata?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Why do you want to go to <planet>?"|2262|0
units.english: "Why do you want to go to <planet>?"
units.italian: "Perché volete andare su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Sure, I'm not hurting for cash right now."|2266|0
units.english: "Sure, I'm not hurting for cash right now."
units.italian: "Certo, non sono a corto di soldi adesso."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"No way, that's too low. Find someone else."|2268|0
units.english: "No way, that's too low. Find someone else."
units.italian: "Assolutamente no, è troppo poco. Trovate qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Well, that's kind of why we want to go there," says another one of the Hai. "Some guy in our dorm told us that there's ghosts haunting <planet>, and we wanted to call his bluff."|2271|0
units.english: "Well, that's kind of why we want to go there," says another one of the Hai. "Some guy in our dorm told us that there's ghosts haunting <planet>, and we wanted to call his bluff."
units.italian: "Beh, è proprio per questo che vogliamo andarci," dice un altro degli Hai. "Un tipo del nostro dormitorio ci ha detto che ci sono fantasmi che infestano <planet>, e volevamo smentirlo."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|label|2273|0
units.english: question 1
units.italian: question 1

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Some guy in our dorm told us that there's ghosts haunting <planet>," says another one of the Hai, "and we wanted to call his bluff."|2274|0
units.english: "Some guy in our dorm told us that there's ghosts haunting <planet>," says another one of the Hai, "and we wanted to call his bluff."
units.italian: "Un tipo del nostro dormitorio ci ha detto che ci sono fantasmi che infestano <planet>," dice un altro degli Hai, "e volevamo smentirlo."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"We're planning to look around for an afternoon, see what we can find," one of the human students says, grinning. "Once we're done we'll let you know, and then we can leave."|2276|0
units.english: "We're planning to look around for an afternoon, see what we can find," one of the human students says, grinning. "Once we're done we'll let you know, and then we can leave."
units.italian: "Abbiamo in programma di guardarci intorno per un pomeriggio, vedere cosa troviamo," dice uno degli studenti umani, sorridendo. "Quando avremo finito te lo faremo sapere, e poi potremo andare."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	One of the shorter Hai in the back pipes up. "I brought cameras for the trip!" He is ignored by the rest of the group.|2277|0
units.english: One of the shorter Hai in the back pipes up. "I brought cameras for the trip!" He is ignored by the rest of the group.
units.italian: Uno degli Hai più bassi in fondo si fa sentire. "Ho portato le telecamere per il viaggio!" Il resto del gruppo lo ignora.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Is this legal?"|2279|0
units.english: "Is this legal?"
units.italian: "È legale?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"Not my business where you spend your vacations. Come aboard."|2280|0
units.english: "Not my business where you spend your vacations. Come aboard."
units.italian: "Non sono affari miei dove passate le vacanze. Salite a bordo."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	The students look at each other, considering this question for what is apparently the first time. "We've heard of other people going there with no problems, as long as they were... discreet about it," says one of the students, trying to assure both you and their fellow classmates. Another mentions having heard something about needing a permit to enter, but he is quickly shushed by the rest of the group.|2282|0
units.english: The students look at each other, considering this question for what is apparently the first time. "We've heard of other people going there with no problems, as long as they were... discreet about it," says one of the students, trying to assure both you and their fellow classmates. Another mentions having heard something about needing a permit to enter, but he is quickly shushed by the rest of the group.
units.italian: Gli studenti si guardano, considerando la domanda per quella che è evidentemente la prima volta. "Abbiamo sentito di altra gente che è andata lì senza problemi, purché fossero... discreti," dice uno degli studenti, cercando di rassicurare sia te sia i compagni. Un altro accenna di aver sentito qualcosa sulla necessità di un permesso per entrare, ma viene subito zittito dal resto del gruppo.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"I'm not about to risk getting in trouble for this. Find someone else."|2284|0
units.english: "I'm not about to risk getting in trouble for this. Find someone else."
units.italian: "Non ho intenzione di rischiare guai per questo. Trovate qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	"If anyone asks, I'll say I didn't know a permit was needed. Come aboard."|2286|0
units.english: "If anyone asks, I'll say I didn't know a permit was needed. Come aboard."
units.italian: "Se qualcuno chiede, dirò che non sapevo servisse un permesso. Salite a bordo."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|	The students race onboard your ship. As they settle into their bunks, you can hear them speculating about what they will find on <planet>.|2288|0
units.english: The students race onboard your ship. As they settle into their bunks, you can hear them speculating about what they will find on <planet>.
units.italian: Gli studenti corrono a bordo della tua nave. Mentre si sistemano nelle cuccette, li senti fare supposizioni su cosa troveranno su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 1|dialog|2291|0
units.english: You look for the group of students you were transporting, but realize that they took a ride on one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Cerchi il gruppo di studenti che stavi trasportando, ma ti rendi conto che sono saliti su una delle tue scorte! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|name|2297|0
units.english: Bring students home to <planet>
units.italian: Riporta gli studenti a casa su <planet>

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|description|2298|0
units.english: Bring a group of Hai and human classmates back home to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta a casa un gruppo di compagni Hai e umani su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|Your passengers' journey mainly consisted of trying to scare each other by telling ghost stories and jumping out of dimly-lit corners of your ship. Despite these annoyances, you land at the station with no issues. Your passengers practically jump off your ship after hastily paying you <payment>.|2307|0
units.english: Your passengers' journey mainly consisted of trying to scare each other by telling ghost stories and jumping out of dimly-lit corners of your ship. Despite these annoyances, you land at the station with no issues. Your passengers practically jump off your ship after hastily paying you <payment>.
units.italian: Il viaggio dei tuoi passeggeri è consistito soprattutto nel cercare di spaventarsi a vicenda raccontando storie di fantasmi e saltando fuori dagli angoli bui della tua nave. Nonostante questi fastidi, atterri alla stazione senza problemi. I passeggeri quasi saltano giù dalla nave dopo averti pagato in fretta <payment>.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	After passing the time in your ship for a few hours, you are startled by a loudspeaker sternly pronouncing something in Hai. You then notice your passengers rushing towards your ship with a panicked look in their eyes. You imagine that they want to take advantage of that return trip you promised as soon as possible; however, disassociating yourself from them may save you some trouble with law enforcement.|2308|0
units.english: After passing the time in your ship for a few hours, you are startled by a loudspeaker sternly pronouncing something in Hai. You then notice your passengers rushing towards your ship with a panicked look in their eyes. You imagine that they want to take advantage of that return trip you promised as soon as possible; however, disassociating yourself from them may save you some trouble with law enforcement.
units.italian: Dopo aver passato qualche ora sulla nave, vieni fatto sobbalzare da un altoparlante che pronuncia severamente qualcosa in Hai. Noti poi i tuoi passeggeri correre verso la nave con uno sguardo di panico negli occhi. Immagini che vogliano approfittare il prima possibile del viaggio di ritorno che hai promesso; tuttavia, dissociarti da loro potrebbe risparmiarti qualche problema con le forze dell'ordine.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	(Wait for my passengers.)|2310|0
units.english: (Wait for my passengers.)
units.italian: (Aspetta i miei passeggeri.)

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	(Bail.)|2312|0
units.english: (Bail.)
units.italian: (Fuggi.)

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	You take off just before your passengers are able to reach your ship. Their wailing is quickly drowned out by the sound of your engines as you maneuver out of the station.|2313|0
units.english: You take off just before your passengers are able to reach your ship. Their wailing is quickly drowned out by the sound of your engines as you maneuver out of the station.
units.italian: Decolli appena prima che i tuoi passeggeri riescano a raggiungere la nave. I loro lamenti vengono presto coperti dal rumore dei motori mentre ti allontani dalla stazione.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	The station is bathed in a garish orange light and the booming voice continues to play. Your red-faced passengers rush back onto your ship shouting at each other in a mixture of languages, and once they're through the airlock you take off before something worse happens.|2316|0
units.english: The station is bathed in a garish orange light and the booming voice continues to play. Your red-faced passengers rush back onto your ship shouting at each other in a mixture of languages, and once they're through the airlock you take off before something worse happens.
units.italian: La stazione è immersa in una luce arancione sgargiante e la voce tonante continua a risuonare. I tuoi passeggeri con il viso rosso si precipitano di nuovo sulla nave gridandosi addosso in un misto di lingue, e una volta passati dalla camera di equilibrio decolli prima che succeda qualcosa di peggio.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|dialog|2319|0
units.english: You look for the group of students you were transporting, but realize that they took a ride on one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Cerchi il gruppo di studenti che stavi trasportando, ma ti rendi conto che sono saliti su una delle tue scorte! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|Upon landing, you are accosted by the local police on <planet>.|2322|0
units.english: Upon landing, you are accosted by the local police on <planet>.
units.italian: All'atterraggio vieni fermato dalla polizia locale su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	"Captain <last>?" says a Hai officer. "Could you come with me for a moment?"|2323|0
units.english: "Captain <last>?" says a Hai officer. "Could you come with me for a moment?"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>?" dice un ufficiale Hai. "Potrebbe venire con me un momento?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	"Am I in trouble?"|2325|0
units.english: "Am I in trouble?"
units.italian: "Sono nei guai?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	"I'm innocent!"|2327|0
units.english: "I'm innocent!"
units.italian: "Sono innocente!"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	(Run away.)|2329|0
units.english: (Run away.)
units.italian: (Scappa.)

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	Almost as soon as you turn around to run you feel a sharp pain in your side as your consciousness fades away.|2330|0
units.english: Almost as soon as you turn around to run you feel a sharp pain in your side as your consciousness fades away.
units.italian: Quasi appena ti volti per correre senti un dolore acuto al fianco mentre la coscienza svanisce.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	You look up, lying in the spot you just stood. Above you is the same officer which asked you to follow him, waving off another officer with a Pulse Rifle. Apparently you were not out for long.|2331|0
units.english: You look up, lying in the spot you just stood. Above you is the same officer which asked you to follow him, waving off another officer with a Pulse Rifle. Apparently you were not out for long.
units.italian: Alzi lo sguardo, sdraiato nel punto in cui stavi in piedi. Sopra di te c'è lo stesso ufficiale che ti ha chiesto di seguirlo, che allontana un altro ufficiale con un Pulse Rifle. A quanto pare non sei stato privo di sensi a lungo.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	"We just want to let you know what happened," the officer says. He leads you away from your passengers, who are currently being examined by a medic for any potential injuries, and sits you down at a table nearby.|2333|0
units.english: "We just want to let you know what happened," the officer says. He leads you away from your passengers, who are currently being examined by a medic for any potential injuries, and sits you down at a table nearby.
units.italian: "Vogliamo solo informarla di cosa è successo," dice l'ufficiale. Ti allontana dai tuoi passeggeri, che in questo momento vengono visitati da un medico per eventuali ferite, e ti fa sedere a un tavolo vicino.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	"I think you can tell by now that your passengers weren't exactly 'sanctioned visitors' to Darkrest. However, they didn't break anything - that announcement you heard was just a warning to refrain from touching a computer system without proper training, but it apparently spooked your passengers enough that they made a run for it. They're not in trouble, as there's no law against just wandering around a station as long as you're not destructive, but typically people who do so get permission first." He gives a wry smile. "Saves us from having to deal with false alarms like this."|2334|0
units.english: "I think you can tell by now that your passengers weren't exactly 'sanctioned visitors' to Darkrest. However, they didn't break anything - that announcement you heard was just a warning to refrain from touching a computer system without proper training, but it apparently spooked your passengers enough that they made a run for it. They're not in trouble, as there's no law against just wandering around a station as long as you're not destructive, but typically people who do so get permission first." He gives a wry smile. "Saves us from having to deal with false alarms like this."
units.italian: "Credo che ormai lo abbia capito: i suoi passeggeri non erano esattamente 'visitatori autorizzati' di Darkrest. Però non hanno rotto niente, l'annuncio che ha sentito era solo un avvertimento a non toccare un sistema informatico senza la dovuta preparazione, ma a quanto pare ha spaventato i suoi passeggeri abbastanza da farli scappare. Non sono nei guai, perché non c'è nessuna legge contro il girare per una stazione purché non si faccia danni, ma di solito chi lo fa chiede prima il permesso." Sorride con ironia. "Ci risparmia falsi allarmi come questo."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	"So, am I in trouble or not?"|2336|0
units.english: "So, am I in trouble or not?"
units.italian: "Quindi sono nei guai o no?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	"Are my passengers going to be okay?"|2338|0
units.english: "Are my passengers going to be okay?"
units.italian: "I miei passeggeri staranno bene?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	"Yeah, they're fine. We're basically just here to make sure they didn't injure themselves. Don't imagine that their parents are going to be too thrilled with them, though.|2339|0
units.english: "Yeah, they're fine. We're basically just here to make sure they didn't injure themselves. Don't imagine that their parents are going to be too thrilled with them, though.
units.italian: "Sì, stanno bene. Siamo qui praticamente solo per assicurarci che non si siano fatti male. Non immagini però che i loro genitori ne saranno entusiasti.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	"Simply bringing a paying passenger somewhere they requested to go isn't illegal. Your passengers were of age and knew what they were getting into, and you weren't deliberately enabling them to break the law. You're fine."|2341|0
units.english: "Simply bringing a paying passenger somewhere they requested to go isn't illegal. Your passengers were of age and knew what they were getting into, and you weren't deliberately enabling them to break the law. You're fine."
units.italian: "Portare un passeggero pagante dove ha chiesto di andare non è illegale. I suoi passeggeri erano maggiorenni e sapevano a cosa andavano incontro, e lei non li stava deliberatamente aiutando a infrangere la legge. È a posto."

units.id: mission:Station Exploration 2|	The officer gets up. "Next time though, you should probably think twice before bringing some college kids somewhere to go 'ghost-hunting.'" He chuckles as he leaves.|2342|0
units.english: The officer gets up. "Next time though, you should probably think twice before bringing some college kids somewhere to go 'ghost-hunting.'" He chuckles as he leaves.
units.italian: L'ufficiale si alza. "La prossima volta, però, dovrebbe pensarci due volte prima di portare dei ragazzi del college da qualche parte a 'dare la caccia ai fantasmi'." Ridacchia andandosene.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|Upon landing, you are accosted by the local police on <origin>. Behind your ship, you see your passengers disembarking from another Hai ship. Some of them are red-faced and crying, but they appear uninjured.|2357|0
units.english: Upon landing, you are accosted by the local police on <origin>. Behind your ship, you see your passengers disembarking from another Hai ship. Some of them are red-faced and crying, but they appear uninjured.
units.italian: All'atterraggio vieni fermato dalla polizia locale su <origin>. Dietro la tua nave, vedi i tuoi passeggeri scendere da un'altra nave Hai. Alcuni hanno il viso rosso e piangono, ma sembrano illesi.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|	"Captain <last>?" says a Hai officer. "Could you come with me for a moment?"|2358|0
units.english: "Captain <last>?" says a Hai officer. "Could you come with me for a moment?"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>?" dice un ufficiale Hai. "Potrebbe venire con me un momento?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|	"Am I in trouble?"|2360|0
units.english: "Am I in trouble?"
units.italian: "Sono nei guai?"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|	"I'm innocent!"|2362|0
units.english: "I'm innocent!"
units.italian: "Sono innocente!"

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|	(Run away.)|2364|0
units.english: (Run away.)
units.italian: (Scappa.)

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|	Almost as soon as you turn around to run you feel a sharp pain in your side as your consciousness fades away.|2365|0
units.english: Almost as soon as you turn around to run you feel a sharp pain in your side as your consciousness fades away.
units.italian: Quasi appena ti volti per correre senti un dolore acuto al fianco mentre la coscienza svanisce.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|	You look up, lying in the spot you just stood. Above you is the same officer which asked you to follow him, waving off another officer with a Pulse Rifle. Apparently you were not out for long.|2366|0
units.english: You look up, lying in the spot you just stood. Above you is the same officer which asked you to follow him, waving off another officer with a Pulse Rifle. Apparently you were not out for long.
units.italian: Alzi lo sguardo, sdraiato nel punto in cui stavi in piedi. Sopra di te c'è lo stesso ufficiale che ti ha chiesto di seguirlo, che allontana un altro ufficiale con un Pulse Rifle. A quanto pare non sei stato privo di sensi a lungo.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|	You can clearly tell that the officer has little patience for your questions. He leads you away from your passengers, who are currently being examined by a medic for any potential injuries.|2369|0
units.english: You can clearly tell that the officer has little patience for your questions. He leads you away from your passengers, who are currently being examined by a medic for any potential injuries.
units.italian: Si capisce chiaramente che l'ufficiale ha poca pazienza per le tue domande. Ti allontana dai tuoi passeggeri, che in questo momento vengono visitati da un medico per eventuali ferite.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|	You can clearly tell that the officer has little patience for your antics. He leads you away from your passengers, who are currently being examined by a medic for any potential injuries.|2372|0
units.english: You can clearly tell that the officer has little patience for your antics. He leads you away from your passengers, who are currently being examined by a medic for any potential injuries.
units.italian: Si capisce chiaramente che l'ufficiale ha poca pazienza per le tue scene. Ti allontana dai tuoi passeggeri, che in questo momento vengono visitati da un medico per eventuali ferite.

units.id: mission:Station Exploration Abandon Ship|	"You are being fined <fine> for abandoning your passengers without warning. You're lucky you didn't end up with a more serious punishment." After further chewing you out for endangering your passengers' safety, he walks away from you in a huff.|2374|0
units.english: "You are being fined <fine> for abandoning your passengers without warning. You're lucky you didn't end up with a more serious punishment." After further chewing you out for endangering your passengers' safety, he walks away from you in a huff.
units.italian: "Le viene inflitta una multa di <fine> per aver abbandonato i suoi passeggeri senza preavviso. È fortunato a non aver ricevuto una punizione più severa." Dopo averti rimproverato ancora per aver messo in pericolo la sicurezza dei passeggeri, si allontana indispettito.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|name|2377|0
units.english: Hai spiritual leader to <planet>
units.italian: Guida spirituale Hai per <planet>

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|description|2378|0
units.english: Bring a Hai spiritual leader to <destination>. He will pay you <payment>.
units.italian: Porta una guida spirituale Hai su <destination>. Ti pagherà <payment>.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|It is an unusually foggy day on <origin>; the air is so thick with moisture that you cannot see more than a few paces in front of you. Perhaps that's why you're so startled when you turn around and see a Hai standing right next to you. He is so close you can see dewdrops on his whiskers, and you immediately notice the prominent jewelry that he is wearing. He appears to be quite old, judging by his stooped-over posture and the white fur around his muzzle.|2394|0
units.english: It is an unusually foggy day on <origin>; the air is so thick with moisture that you cannot see more than a few paces in front of you. Perhaps that's why you're so startled when you turn around and see a Hai standing right next to you. He is so close you can see dewdrops on his whiskers, and you immediately notice the prominent jewelry that he is wearing. He appears to be quite old, judging by his stooped-over posture and the white fur around his muzzle.
units.italian: È una giornata insolitamente nebbiosa su <origin>; l'aria è così densa di umidità che non vedi oltre qualche passo davanti a te. Forse è per questo che trasalisci quando ti volti e vedi un Hai in piedi proprio accanto a te. È così vicino che riesci a vedere gocce di rugiada sui suoi baffi, e noti subito i vistosi gioielli che indossa. Sembra piuttosto vecchio, a giudicare dalla postura curva e dal pelo bianco attorno al muso.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"I see that you are wiser than most humans here," he says, pointing toward your ship. Its hatch is open, prominently displaying your keystone to any potential travelers. "You carry a shield against the tempest of space. Let no one else tell you otherwise." He pauses to take a breath. "Now, onto more worldly things. My name is Hareek. Are you willing and able to take me to <destination> for <payment>?"|2404|0
units.english: "I see that you are wiser than most humans here," he says, pointing toward your ship. Its hatch is open, prominently displaying your keystone to any potential travelers. "You carry a shield against the tempest of space. Let no one else tell you otherwise." He pauses to take a breath. "Now, onto more worldly things. My name is Hareek. Are you willing and able to take me to <destination> for <payment>?"
units.italian: "Vedo che è più saggio della maggior parte degli umani qui," dice, indicando la tua nave. Il portello è aperto e mostra bene la tua pietra chiave a qualsiasi viaggiatore potenziale. "Porta uno scudo contro la tempesta dello spazio. Nessun altro le dica il contrario." Si ferma a prendere fiato. "Ora, passiamo a cose più mondane. Mi chiamo Hareek. È disposto e in grado di portarmi su <destination> per <payment>?"

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"The keystone you carry is a strange one, human," he says, pointing toward your ship. Its hatch is open, prominently displaying your Key Stone to any potential travelers. He walks up to it to get a closer look. "Very unusual. No proper mounting either - must be a human design." He sighs. "Well, at least the keystone itself looks authentic. It will have to do." He turns to you. "You carry a shield against the tempest of space. Let no one else tell you otherwise. If your people have access to keystones as well, then I hope they too become wise to its power and learn to treat them with more reverence. Now, onto more worldly things. My name is Hareek. Are you willing and able to take me to <destination> for <payment>?"|2407|0
units.english: "The keystone you carry is a strange one, human," he says, pointing toward your ship. Its hatch is open, prominently displaying your Key Stone to any potential travelers. He walks up to it to get a closer look. "Very unusual. No proper mounting either - must be a human design." He sighs. "Well, at least the keystone itself looks authentic. It will have to do." He turns to you. "You carry a shield against the tempest of space. Let no one else tell you otherwise. If your people have access to keystones as well, then I hope they too become wise to its power and learn to treat them with more reverence. Now, onto more worldly things. My name is Hareek. Are you willing and able to take me to <destination> for <payment>?"
units.italian: "La pietra chiave che porta è strana, umano," dice, indicando la tua nave. Il portello è aperto e mostra bene la tua Pietra Chiave a qualsiasi viaggiatore potenziale. Si avvicina per guardarla meglio. "Molto insolita. E senza un supporto adeguato: dev'essere un progetto umano." Sospira. "Beh, almeno la pietra chiave in sé sembra autentica. Dovrà bastare." Si volta verso di te. "Porta uno scudo contro la tempesta dello spazio. Nessun altro le dica il contrario. Se anche la sua gente ha accesso alle pietre chiave, spero che diventi consapevole del loro potere e impari a trattarle con più reverenza. Ora, passiamo a cose più mondane. Mi chiamo Hareek. È disposto e in grado di portarmi su <destination> per <payment>?"

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"A unique design you have here, Captain," he says, pointing toward your ship. Its hatch is open, prominently displaying Nanachi's pendant to any potential travelers. "A gift, I presume? You are lucky you have someone looking out for you. You carry a shield against the tempest of space. Let no one else tell you otherwise." He pauses to take a breath. "Now, onto more worldly things. My name is Hareek. Are you willing and able to take me to <destination> for <payment>?"|2410|0
units.english: "A unique design you have here, Captain," he says, pointing toward your ship. Its hatch is open, prominently displaying Nanachi's pendant to any potential travelers. "A gift, I presume? You are lucky you have someone looking out for you. You carry a shield against the tempest of space. Let no one else tell you otherwise." He pauses to take a breath. "Now, onto more worldly things. My name is Hareek. Are you willing and able to take me to <destination> for <payment>?"
units.italian: "Un design davvero unico, capitano," dice, indicando la tua nave. Il portello è aperto e mostra bene il pendente di Nanachi a qualsiasi viaggiatore potenziale. "Un regalo, presumo? È fortunato ad avere qualcuno che veglia su di lei. Porta uno scudo contro la tempesta dello spazio. Nessun altro le dica il contrario." Si ferma a prendere fiato. "Ora, passiamo a cose più mondane. Mi chiamo Hareek. È disposto e in grado di portarmi su <destination> per <payment>?"

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"I've never seen anything like this... thing you have," he says, pointing toward your ship. Its hatch is open, prominently displaying the Tree Skeleton Key Stone to any potential travelers. The Hai sounds more than a little disgusted. "I hope you haven't done anything you'll regret."|2413|0
units.english: "I've never seen anything like this... thing you have," he says, pointing toward your ship. Its hatch is open, prominently displaying the Tree Skeleton Key Stone to any potential travelers. The Hai sounds more than a little disgusted. "I hope you haven't done anything you'll regret."
units.italian: "Non ho mai visto niente come questa... cosa che ha," dice, indicando la tua nave. Il portello è aperto e mostra bene la Pietra Chiave Scheletro d'Albero a qualsiasi viaggiatore potenziale. L'Hai sembra più che un po' disgustato. "Spero che non abbia fatto qualcosa di cui si pentirà."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	He takes a closer look. "It seems to be made out of the same material as a keystone, and yet it is entirely foreign to me. Where you got this, I have no idea. Well, at least the material itself looks authentic. It will have to do." He sighs and turns to you. "I suspect that whoever you got this from is not happy it is out of their hands. I would show more respect for keystones if I were you." He pauses to take a breath. "Now, onto more worldly things. My name is Hareek. Are you willing and able to take me to <destination> for <payment>?"|2414|0
units.english: He takes a closer look. "It seems to be made out of the same material as a keystone, and yet it is entirely foreign to me. Where you got this, I have no idea. Well, at least the material itself looks authentic. It will have to do." He sighs and turns to you. "I suspect that whoever you got this from is not happy it is out of their hands. I would show more respect for keystones if I were you." He pauses to take a breath. "Now, onto more worldly things. My name is Hareek. Are you willing and able to take me to <destination> for <payment>?"
units.italian: La guarda più da vicino. "Sembra fatta dello stesso materiale di una pietra chiave, eppure mi è del tutto estranea. Dove l'abbia presa, non ne ho idea. Beh, almeno il materiale in sé sembra autentico. Dovrà bastare." Sospira e si volta verso di te. "Sospetto che chiunque gliel'abbia data non sia felice che sia fuori dalle sue mani. Se fossi in lei, mostrerei più rispetto per le pietre chiave." Si ferma a prendere fiato. "Ora, passiamo a cose più mondane. Mi chiamo Hareek. È disposto e in grado di portarmi su <destination> per <payment>?"

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"I can take you there."|2417|0
units.english: "I can take you there."
units.italian: "Posso portarla lì."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Why would you want to go to <destination>? Isn't that an Unfettered planet?"|2419|0
units.english: "Why would you want to go to <destination>? Isn't that an Unfettered planet?"
units.italian: "Perché vorresti andare su <destination>? Non è un pianeta degli Slegati?"

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"I'm not going there. You'll have to ask someone else."|2426|0
units.english: "I'm not going there. You'll have to ask someone else."
units.italian: "Non ci vado. Dovrai chiedere a qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	The Hai pauses for a moment, as if unsure of what to say. "My teachings and prophecies are more... appreciated among our northern brethren."|2429|0
units.english: The Hai pauses for a moment, as if unsure of what to say. "My teachings and prophecies are more... appreciated among our northern brethren."
units.italian: L'Hai si ferma un momento, come se non sapesse cosa dire. "I miei insegnamenti e le mie profezie sono... più apprezzati tra i nostri fratelli del nord."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Teachings?"|2431|0
units.english: "Teachings?"
units.italian: "Insegnamenti?"

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Alright, I'll take you there."|2432|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, la porto lì."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Unfettered space is too dangerous for me. You'll have to find someone else."|2434|0
units.english: "Unfettered space is too dangerous for me. You'll have to find someone else."
units.italian: "Lo spazio degli Slegati è troppo pericoloso per me. Dovrai trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	An unreadable expression appears on Hareek's face. "Ah, apologies for my rudeness - you probably do not know who I am. How do I explain this... You have your preachers and wise ones among the humans, yes? I am something similar. Now, will you take me to <destination>?"|2437|0
units.english: An unreadable expression appears on Hareek's face. "Ah, apologies for my rudeness - you probably do not know who I am. How do I explain this... You have your preachers and wise ones among the humans, yes? I am something similar. Now, will you take me to <destination>?"
units.italian: Sul volto di Hareek compare un'espressione indecifrabile. "Ah, chiedo scusa per la mia scortesia, probabilmente non sa chi sono. Come spiegarlo... Tra gli umani avete i vostri predicatori e i vostri saggi, giusto? Io sono qualcosa di simile. Ora, mi porterà su <destination>?"

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"So you're going to preach to the Unfettered?"|2439|0
units.english: "So you're going to preach to the Unfettered?"
units.italian: "Quindi andrà a predicare agli Slegati?"

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"I can take you."|2440|0
units.english: "I can take you."
units.italian: "Posso portarla."
