units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Unfettered space is too dangerous for me. You'll have to find someone else."|2442|0
units.english: "Unfettered space is too dangerous for me. You'll have to find someone else."
units.italian: "Lo spazio degli Slegati è troppo pericoloso per me. Dovrai trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"That is an oversimplification, but it is not something I can explain adequately to a human." He turns away, looking into the fog. "There are portentous events occurring in the galaxy, and I must warn others of the turmoil I have foreseen. The Unfettered crave turmoil, so naturally they are more inclined to believe me." He gives a wry smile.|2444|0
units.english: "That is an oversimplification, but it is not something I can explain adequately to a human." He turns away, looking into the fog. "There are portentous events occurring in the galaxy, and I must warn others of the turmoil I have foreseen. The Unfettered crave turmoil, so naturally they are more inclined to believe me." He gives a wry smile.
units.italian: "È una semplificazione eccessiva, ma non è qualcosa che posso spiegare adeguatamente a un umano." Si volta, guardando nella nebbia. "Stanno accadendo eventi forieri nella galassia, e devo avvertire gli altri del turbamento che ho previsto. Gli Slegati bramano il turbamento, quindi naturalmente sono più inclini a credermi." Sorride con ironia.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Alright, I can take you there."|2446|0
units.english: "Alright, I can take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, posso portarla lì."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Sorry, but this whole thing sounds a little too strange for me."|2448|0
units.english: "Sorry, but this whole thing sounds a little too strange for me."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma tutta questa storia mi sembra un po' troppo strana."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Unfettered space is too dangerous for me. You'll have to find someone else."|2450|0
units.english: "Unfettered space is too dangerous for me. You'll have to find someone else."
units.italian: "Lo spazio degli Slegati è troppo pericoloso per me. Dovrai trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	He snorts. "Dangerous? I am approaching 300 years of age, and yet I do not fear a trip to Unfettered space." He walks away, clearly disappointed.|2452|0
units.english: He snorts. "Dangerous? I am approaching 300 years of age, and yet I do not fear a trip to Unfettered space." He walks away, clearly disappointed.
units.italian: Sbuffa. "Pericoloso? Sto per compiere 300 anni, eppure non temo un viaggio nello spazio degli Slegati." Si allontana, chiaramente deluso.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	He sighs. "That's alright. I would not expect you to understand." He walks away, disappearing into the mist.|2455|0
units.english: He sighs. "That's alright. I would not expect you to understand." He walks away, disappearing into the mist.
units.italian: Sospira. "Non importa. Non mi aspetterei che lei capisse." Si allontana, sparendo nella nebbia.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Excellent. Arriving in a human ship would be an auspicious start to my journey, but there are not many human captains who take proper precautions when traveling through space. I'm glad to see that you have some sense, at least." He lowers his voice.|2458|0
units.english: "Excellent. Arriving in a human ship would be an auspicious start to my journey, but there are not many human captains who take proper precautions when traveling through space. I'm glad to see that you have some sense, at least." He lowers his voice.
units.italian: "Eccellente. Arrivare su una nave umana sarebbe un inizio propizio per il mio viaggio, ma non ci sono molti capitani umani che prendono le dovute precauzioni viaggiando nello spazio. Sono lieto di vedere che lei, almeno, ha un po' di buon senso." Abbassa la voce.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|	"Since you seem to be a trustworthy captain, I will tell you of some things I have seen. Many years ago, I defended our space against the Korath raids. One day, we were caught unprepared and hit by a massive fleet. Every single ship in my patrol group was destroyed, except for ours - the only one with a keystone. I learned two things in my time against the Korath: that the old legends are true, and that the stability we have enjoyed as a species is ending. Changes in the galaxy are inevitable, and those changes are arriving soon." He begins to move toward your ship. "But let us not speak of this now. I have business to attend to."|2459|0
units.english: "Since you seem to be a trustworthy captain, I will tell you of some things I have seen. Many years ago, I defended our space against the Korath raids. One day, we were caught unprepared and hit by a massive fleet. Every single ship in my patrol group was destroyed, except for ours - the only one with a keystone. I learned two things in my time against the Korath: that the old legends are true, and that the stability we have enjoyed as a species is ending. Changes in the galaxy are inevitable, and those changes are arriving soon." He begins to move toward your ship. "But let us not speak of this now. I have business to attend to."
units.italian: "Dato che sembra un capitano affidabile, le racconterò alcune cose che ho visto. Molti anni fa difesi il nostro spazio dalle incursioni dei Korath. Un giorno fummo colti impreparati e investiti da una flotta enorme. Ogni singola nave del mio gruppo di pattuglia fu distrutta, tranne la nostra, l'unica con una pietra chiave. In quel periodo contro i Korath ho imparato due cose: che le vecchie leggende sono vere, e che la stabilità di cui abbiamo goduto come specie sta finendo. I cambiamenti nella galassia sono inevitabili, e quei cambiamenti arriveranno presto." Comincia a dirigersi verso la tua nave. "Ma non parliamo di questo ora. Ho faccende da sbrigare."

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|dialog|2463|0
units.english: You look for Hareek, but realize that he took a ride on one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Cerchi Hareek, ma ti rendi conto che è salito su una delle tue scorte! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|Hareek was quite tight-lipped about what he planned to do once on <planet>. The most you could get out of him was more stories about his past as a military pilot. Once you land, Hareek jumps off your ship, moving surprisingly fast for his age.|2468|0
units.english: Hareek was quite tight-lipped about what he planned to do once on <planet>. The most you could get out of him was more stories about his past as a military pilot. Once you land, Hareek jumps off your ship, moving surprisingly fast for his age.
units.italian: Hareek è stato piuttosto reticente su cosa avesse intenzione di fare una volta su <planet>. Il massimo che sei riuscito a ottenere sono altre storie sul suo passato di pilota militare. Una volta atterrato, Hareek salta giù dalla nave, muovendosi sorprendentemente in fretta per la sua età.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|"Thank you, Captain, for making this journey. I apologize for not telling you more about me; the work I do is not something that I can reveal to any human who asks." He hands you <payment> and moves away. The surrounding Unfettered appear almost awed by his presence and consequentially give you a wide berth.|2469|0
units.english: "Thank you, Captain, for making this journey. I apologize for not telling you more about me; the work I do is not something that I can reveal to any human who asks." He hands you <payment> and moves away. The surrounding Unfettered appear almost awed by his presence and consequentially give you a wide berth.
units.italian: "Grazie, capitano, per aver fatto questo viaggio. Mi scuso per non averle detto di più su di me; il lavoro che faccio non è qualcosa che posso rivelare a qualsiasi umano che lo chieda." Ti consegna <payment> e si allontana. Gli Slegati intorno sembrano quasi intimiditi dalla sua presenza e di conseguenza ti lasciano un ampio spazio.

units.id: mission:Hai Pilgrimage|log|2470|0
units.english: An old Hai who claims to foresee the future. Dropped him off in Unfettered space so he could spread his message there. He appears to be well-respected amongst the Unfettered.
units.italian: Un vecchio Hai che sostiene di prevedere il futuro. L'hai lasciato nello spazio degli Slegati così che potesse diffondere il suo messaggio. Sembra essere molto rispettato tra gli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|name|2476|0
units.english: Acorns for Anoo
units.italian: Ghiande per Anoo

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|description|2477|0
units.english: Bring Eeeya to <destination> to deliver <cargo> to her missing granddaughter.
units.italian: Porta Eeeya su <destination> per consegnare <cargo> alla nipote scomparsa.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|As you pass by a kitchen supply store in the spaceport, a dishevelled elderly Hai looks towards you with a face of deep concern. She waves you down.|2487|0
units.english: As you pass by a kitchen supply store in the spaceport, a dishevelled elderly Hai looks towards you with a face of deep concern. She waves you down.
units.italian: Mentre passi davanti a un negozio di forniture da cucina nello spazioporto, una Hai anziana e sciatta ti guarda con un'espressione profondamente preoccupata. Ti fa cenno di fermarti.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	(See what she wants.)|2489|0
units.english: (See what she wants.)
units.italian: (Vedi cosa vuole.)

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	(Ignore her.)|2490|0
units.english: (Ignore her.)
units.italian: (Ignorala.)

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"My name is Eeeya, and I'm looking for my lost granddaughter, Anoo. She just passed the medical school, and I was going to give her three tons of cookies, but she's gone! Please help me find her." Her soft voice has a chittering edge much stronger than other Hai you've spoken with. She also hesitates before certain words, as if unsure which article to add, giving her speech a unusual rhythm.|2492|0
units.english: "My name is Eeeya, and I'm looking for my lost granddaughter, Anoo. She just passed the medical school, and I was going to give her three tons of cookies, but she's gone! Please help me find her." Her soft voice has a chittering edge much stronger than other Hai you've spoken with. She also hesitates before certain words, as if unsure which article to add, giving her speech a unusual rhythm.
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Eeeya, e sto cercando mia nipote scomparsa, Anoo. Ha appena superato l'esame di medicina, e stavo per regalarle tre tonnellate di biscotti, ma è sparita! Per favore, aiutami a trovarla." La sua voce morbida ha una nota cinguettante molto più forte di quella degli altri Hai con cui hai parlato. Esita anche prima di certe parole, come se non sapesse quale articolo aggiungere, il che dà al suo parlato un ritmo insolito.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"So please, take me to find my granddaughter."|2495|0
units.english: "So please, take me to find my granddaughter."
units.italian: "Quindi per favore, portami a cercare mia nipote."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|label|2496|0
units.english: actual questions
units.italian: actual questions

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"Three tons of cookies!?"|2498|0
units.english: "Three tons of cookies!?"
units.italian: "Tre tonnellate di biscotti!?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"She's gone?"|2502|0
units.english: "She's gone?"
units.italian: "È sparita?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"Why don't you ask the authorities for help?"|2506|0
units.english: "Why don't you ask the authorities for help?"
units.italian: "Perché non chiedi aiuto alle autorità?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"Can't your friends help you find her?"|2510|0
units.english: "Can't your friends help you find her?"
units.italian: "Non possono aiutarti i tuoi amici a trovarla?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"Let's go find her!"|2514|0
units.english: "Let's go find her!"
units.italian: "Andiamo a cercarla!"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"I have other places to be."|2516|0
units.english: "I have other places to be."
units.italian: "Ho altri posti dove devo andare."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"Well, I... I don't know... I cook when I'm worried, and Anoo has been missing for three months! I've sealed all three tons of cookies. They should last a year or two. Maybe she'll share them with her friends? She has many friends! Tons of friends! They all miss her, but none are willing to help...|2521|0
units.english: "Well, I... I don't know... I cook when I'm worried, and Anoo has been missing for three months! I've sealed all three tons of cookies. They should last a year or two. Maybe she'll share them with her friends? She has many friends! Tons of friends! They all miss her, but none are willing to help...
units.italian: "Beh, io... non lo so... cucino quando sono preoccupata, e Anoo è scomparsa da tre mesi! Ho sigillato tutte e tre le tonnellate di biscotti. Dovrebbero durare un anno o due. Magari li dividerà con i suoi amici? Ha molti amici! Tonnellate di amici! Le mancano tutti, ma nessuno è disposto ad aiutare...

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"Anoo passed medical school on the Frostmark four months ago, near the top of her class! A famous hospital on the Hai-home needed a new trauma surgeon and said she would be perfect for the job. She accepted the position and said she would be on vacation for a few weeks.|2526|0
units.english: "Anoo passed medical school on the Frostmark four months ago, near the top of her class! A famous hospital on the Hai-home needed a new trauma surgeon and said she would be perfect for the job. She accepted the position and said she would be on vacation for a few weeks.
units.italian: "Anoo si è laureata in medicina a Frostmark quattro mesi fa, tra i primi della classe! Un ospedale famoso su Hai-home cercava un nuovo chirurgo traumatologo e ha detto che sarebbe stata perfetta per il posto. Ha accettato la posizione e ha detto che sarebbe andata in vacanza per qualche settimana.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"A month later, she told them she won't be coming, and nobody has heard from her since.|2527|0
units.english: "A month later, she told them she won't be coming, and nobody has heard from her since.
units.italian: "Un mese dopo, ha detto loro che non sarebbe venuta, e da allora nessuno ha più avuto sue notizie.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"I talked to the Central Medical Bureau, and they told me she got approval for practicing medicine anywhere in Hai space or beyond. They've heard nothing from her since she got approval. She has to register new medicines with the Bureau, so they should have heard from her.|2532|0
units.english: "I talked to the Central Medical Bureau, and they told me she got approval for practicing medicine anywhere in Hai space or beyond. They've heard nothing from her since she got approval. She has to register new medicines with the Bureau, so they should have heard from her.
units.italian: "Ho parlato con l'Ufficio Medico Centrale, e mi hanno detto che ha ottenuto l'approvazione per esercitare la medicina ovunque nello spazio degli Hai o oltre. Non hanno più saputo nulla da lei da quando ha ottenuto l'approvazione. Deve registrare i nuovi medicinali presso l'Ufficio, quindi dovrebbero aver avuto sue notizie.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"The police told me that several other people have reported Anoo missing, but they refused to tell me anything else. They said I had to talk to military, but they won't tell me anything.|2533|0
units.english: "The police told me that several other people have reported Anoo missing, but they refused to tell me anything else. They said I had to talk to military, but they won't tell me anything.
units.italian: "La polizia mi ha detto che diverse altre persone hanno denunciato la scomparsa di Anoo, ma si sono rifiutati di dirmi altro. Hanno detto che dovevo parlare con i militari, ma loro non mi dicono niente.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"Maybe she's involved in something secret? Or illegal? No, she'd never do that. Where is she?|2534|0
units.english: "Maybe she's involved in something secret? Or illegal? No, she'd never do that. Where is she?
units.italian: "Forse è coinvolta in qualcosa di segreto? O di illegale? No, non lo farebbe mai. Dove sarà?

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"I have few friends, and none of them are interested in finding a missing Hai who could be anywhere. None of my customers want to help either, and her family is all dead.|2539|0
units.english: "I have few friends, and none of them are interested in finding a missing Hai who could be anywhere. None of my customers want to help either, and her family is all dead.
units.italian: "Ho pochi amici, e nessuno di loro è interessato a cercare una Hai scomparsa che potrebbe essere ovunque. Nemmeno i miei clienti vogliono aiutare, e la sua famiglia è tutta morta.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|	"She always talked about doing free work for those who couldn't afford medical treatment. When she was little, her mother would take her to Stonebreak to help at local shelters. Let's start there."|2542|0
units.english: "She always talked about doing free work for those who couldn't afford medical treatment. When she was little, her mother would take her to Stonebreak to help at local shelters. Let's start there."
units.italian: "Parlava sempre di fare lavoro gratuito per chi non poteva permettersi cure mediche. Da piccola, sua madre la portava a Stonebreak ad aiutare nei rifugi locali. Cominciamo da lì."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 1|dialog|2545|0
units.english: You forgot Eeeya or some of her mountains of cookies. Maybe they're in one of your escorts?
units.italian: Hai dimenticato Eeeya o qualcuna delle sue montagne di biscotti. Forse sono su una delle tue scorte?

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 2|name|2549|0
units.english: Acorns for Anoo
units.italian: Ghiande per Anoo

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 2|description|2550|0
units.english: Bring Eeeya to <destination> to deliver <cargo> to her missing granddaughter.
units.italian: Porta Eeeya su <destination> per consegnare <cargo> alla nipote scomparsa.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 2|log|2558|0
units.english: Took a Hai lady named Eeeya to Stonebreak to help find her granddaughter, who is named Anoo.
units.italian: Hai portato una signora Hai di nome Eeeya a Stonebreak per aiutarla a trovare la nipote, che si chiama Anoo.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 2|You spend several hours flying Eeeya between the massive communities of Stonebreak. She checks every homeless shelter, volunteer ward, women's shelter, and low-income hospital. The story is always the same: Anoo hasn't been seen in years, though some remember the energetic little girl in her youth before her mother left.|2560|0
units.english: You spend several hours flying Eeeya between the massive communities of Stonebreak. She checks every homeless shelter, volunteer ward, women's shelter, and low-income hospital. The story is always the same: Anoo hasn't been seen in years, though some remember the energetic little girl in her youth before her mother left.
units.italian: Passi diverse ore a portare Eeeya in volo tra le enormi comunità di Stonebreak. Controlla ogni rifugio per senzatetto, reparto volontario, rifugio per donne e ospedale per famiglie a basso reddito. La storia è sempre la stessa: Anoo non viene vista da anni, anche se alcuni ricordano la bambina energica della sua giovinezza, prima che la madre se ne andasse.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 2|	After a few moments of crushing despair, Eeeya's ears perk up, and she says, "Since it's clear she's not here, let's check on <destination> - she could be in military."|2561|0
units.english: After a few moments of crushing despair, Eeeya's ears perk up, and she says, "Since it's clear she's not here, let's check on <destination> - she could be in military."
units.italian: Dopo qualche momento di disperazione schiacciante, le orecchie di Eeeya si drizzano, e dice: "Dato che è chiaro che non è qui, controlliamo <destination>, potrebbe essere nell'esercito."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 2|dialog|2564|0
units.english: You forgot Eeeya or some of her mountains of cookies. Maybe they're in one of your escorts?
units.italian: Hai dimenticato Eeeya o qualcuna delle sue montagne di biscotti. Forse sono su una delle tue scorte?

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|name|2568|0
units.english: Acorns for Anoo
units.italian: Ghiande per Anoo

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|description|2569|0
units.english: Bring Eeeya to <destination> to deliver <cargo> to her missing granddaughter.
units.italian: Porta Eeeya su <destination> per consegnare <cargo> alla nipote scomparsa.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|clearance|2570|0
units.english: After hearing the name Eeeya, the Darkcloak flight controller excitedly responds, "Acorn Delights!" and you're granted landing clearance.
units.italian: Dopo aver sentito il nome Eeeya, il controllore di volo dei Darkcloak risponde con entusiasmo: "Acorn Delights!" e ti viene concesso il permesso di atterraggio.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|Eeeya takes you to the visitor's office and asks to see the Cloudfire military commander. Upon refusal, Eeeya throws a fit; after an hour of her panic they agree to let her speak with the commander.|2579|0
units.english: Eeeya takes you to the visitor's office and asks to see the Cloudfire military commander. Upon refusal, Eeeya throws a fit; after an hour of her panic they agree to let her speak with the commander.
units.italian: Eeeya ti porta all'ufficio visitatori e chiede di vedere il comandante militare di Cloudfire. Al rifiuto, Eeeya fa una scenata; dopo un'ora del suo panico accettano di lasciarla parlare con il comandante.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	After a few minutes, she comes back looking despondent, and you lead her back to <ship>.|2580|0
units.english: After a few minutes, she comes back looking despondent, and you lead her back to <ship>.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto, torna con un'aria abbattuta, e tu la riaccompagni alla <ship>.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"They said she doesn't work for them. I think they know where she is, but they won't tell me anything.|2581|0
units.english: "They said she doesn't work for them. I think they know where she is, but they won't tell me anything.
units.italian: "Hanno detto che non lavora per loro. Credo che sappiano dove sia, ma non mi dicono niente.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"There's one more place we can try, but I don't think you're going to like it. She may have joined Unfettered Hai."|2582|0
units.english: "There's one more place we can try, but I don't think you're going to like it. She may have joined Unfettered Hai."
units.italian: "C'è ancora un posto che possiamo provare, ma non credo che ti piacerà. Potrebbe essersi unita agli Hai Slegati."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"Why didn't you mention this earlier?"|2585|0
units.english: "Why didn't you mention this earlier?"
units.italian: "Perché non l'hai detto prima?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"Why would a doctor join a band of warmongers?"|2587|0
units.english: "Why would a doctor join a band of warmongers?"
units.italian: "Perché mai una dottoressa dovrebbe unirsi a una banda di guerrafondai?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"As the honorable Captain <first> <last>, I say let's go find her!"|2589|0
units.english: "As the honorable Captain <first> <last>, I say let's go find her!"
units.italian: "In quanto onorevole capitano <first> <last>, dico che andiamo a cercarla!"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"I'd be happy to help."|2591|0
units.english: "I'd be happy to help."
units.italian: "Sarò felice di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"Unfettered space is too dangerous for me. You will have to find another captain."|2593|0
units.english: "Unfettered space is too dangerous for me. You will have to find another captain."
units.italian: "Lo spazio degli Slegati è troppo pericoloso per me. Dovrai trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"I was afraid it would scare you away. Humans are scared of our ships, and the Unfettered are deadly warriors. Besides, the other places were more likely. Many of her mother's family have joined the Unfettered in the past, but I didn't think that would happen to her."|2596|0
units.english: "I was afraid it would scare you away. Humans are scared of our ships, and the Unfettered are deadly warriors. Besides, the other places were more likely. Many of her mother's family have joined the Unfettered in the past, but I didn't think that would happen to her."
units.italian: "Temevo che ti avrebbe fatto scappare. Gli umani hanno paura delle nostre navi, e gli Slegati sono guerrieri letali. Inoltre gli altri posti erano più probabili. Molti della famiglia di sua madre si sono uniti agli Slegati in passato, ma non pensavo che sarebbe successo a lei."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"Anoo was always sympathetic to the cause of the Unfettered Hai. Not their pointless war - she hated that - but she respected their drive to progress and their gift for change. Her father's family tried to stop her ideas, and we thought we succeeded, but... maybe...|2599|0
units.english: "Anoo was always sympathetic to the cause of the Unfettered Hai. Not their pointless war - she hated that - but she respected their drive to progress and their gift for change. Her father's family tried to stop her ideas, and we thought we succeeded, but... maybe...
units.italian: "Anoo è sempre stata solidale con la causa degli Hai Slegati. Non con la loro guerra insensata, quella la odiava, ma rispettava la loro spinta al progresso e il loro dono per il cambiamento. La famiglia di suo padre ha cercato di fermare le sue idee, e pensavamo di esserci riusciti, ma... forse...

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"A trauma surgeon for the Unfettered Hai? I wonder if she planned this the years in advance?"|2600|0
units.english: "A trauma surgeon for the Unfettered Hai? I wonder if she planned this the years in advance?"
units.italian: "Una chirurga traumatologa per gli Hai Slegati? Chissà se l'ha pianificato con anni di anticipo?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|	"If Anoo went anywhere, it would be the Darkcloak. The largest Unfettered hospital is there. Many soldiers come back from raids injured on Darkcloak. A trauma surgeon would have a lot of work to do."|2603|0
units.english: "If Anoo went anywhere, it would be the Darkcloak. The largest Unfettered hospital is there. Many soldiers come back from raids injured on Darkcloak. A trauma surgeon would have a lot of work to do."
units.italian: "Se Anoo è andata da qualche parte, sarà dai Darkcloak. Il più grande ospedale degli Slegati è lì. Molti soldati tornano dalle incursioni feriti su Darkcloak. Una chirurga traumatologa avrebbe molto lavoro da fare."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 3|dialog|2606|0
units.english: You forgot Eeeya or some of her mountains of cookies. Maybe they're in one of your escorts?
units.italian: Hai dimenticato Eeeya o qualcuna delle sue montagne di biscotti. Forse sono su una delle tue scorte?

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|name|2610|0
units.english: Acorn Delights
units.italian: Delizie di Ghiande

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|description|2611|0
units.english: Take Eeeya to <destination> to finalize some paperwork regarding the Acorn Delights shop.
units.italian: Porta Eeeya su <destination> per definire alcune pratiche riguardanti il negozio Acorn Delights.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|log|2619|0
units.english: Finally found Anoo. It turns out she joined the Unfettered. I am supposed to take Eeeya to <destination> now.
units.italian: Anoo è stata finalmente trovata. Si scopre che si è unita agli Slegati. Ora dovrei portare Eeeya su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|You're ushered from the landing platform to a nearby hospital, where Eeeya finally manages to convey your intent. A few Unfettered Hai nearby are muttering in their language, and you keep hearing the Hai word for "cookies" as they watch Eeeya. Along the way, you notice an odd contrast of squalor and advanced machinery. Unlike their southern brethren, it seems the Unfettered value function and progress over aesthetics and comfort.|2621|0
units.english: You're ushered from the landing platform to a nearby hospital, where Eeeya finally manages to convey your intent. A few Unfettered Hai nearby are muttering in their language, and you keep hearing the Hai word for "cookies" as they watch Eeeya. Along the way, you notice an odd contrast of squalor and advanced machinery. Unlike their southern brethren, it seems the Unfettered value function and progress over aesthetics and comfort.
units.italian: Vieni accompagnato dalla piattaforma di atterraggio a un ospedale vicino, dove Eeeya riesce finalmente a comunicare le tue intenzioni. Alcuni Hai Slegati lì vicino borbottano nella loro lingua, e continui a sentire la parola Hai per "biscotti" mentre guardano Eeeya. Lungo la strada noti uno strano contrasto di squallore e macchinari avanzati. A differenza dei loro fratelli del sud, sembra che gli Slegati diano valore alla funzionalità e al progresso più che all'estetica e al comfort.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	As you rise through the main tower of the hospital, you're surprised at how advanced it is. Despite their willingness to die in battle, the Unfettered seem to value the lives of the survivors. Perhaps this hospital is to heal them quickly so that they can fight again as soon as possible.|2622|0
units.english: As you rise through the main tower of the hospital, you're surprised at how advanced it is. Despite their willingness to die in battle, the Unfettered seem to value the lives of the survivors. Perhaps this hospital is to heal them quickly so that they can fight again as soon as possible.
units.italian: Mentre sali lungo la torre principale dell'ospedale, sei sorpreso da quanto sia avanzato. Nonostante la loro disponibilità a morire in battaglia, gli Slegati sembrano tenere alla vita dei sopravvissuti. Forse questo ospedale serve a curarli in fretta perché possano combattere di nuovo il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	You reach a high floor filled with personal offices. Eeeya knocks on each door, apologizing when the Unfettered inside aren't who she's looking for, until you finally reach the very last room.|2623|0
units.english: You reach a high floor filled with personal offices. Eeeya knocks on each door, apologizing when the Unfettered inside aren't who she's looking for, until you finally reach the very last room.
units.italian: Raggiungi un piano alto pieno di uffici personali. Eeeya bussa a ogni porta, scusandosi quando gli Slegati all'interno non sono quelli che cerca, finché finalmente arrivate all'ultima stanza.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	Eeeya opens this door, and runs to the Hai inside it - Anoo. They begin to speak in Hai, then remember that you are in the room.|2624|0
units.english: Eeeya opens this door, and runs to the Hai inside it - Anoo. They begin to speak in Hai, then remember that you are in the room.
units.italian: Eeeya apre quella porta e corre verso la Hai che c'è dentro, Anoo. Cominciano a parlare in Hai, poi si ricordano che sei nella stanza.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"Please, Anoo, let's speak in the human language. <first> came all this way for me, and it's only fair that Captain be able to understand what's going on."|2625|0
units.english: "Please, Anoo, let's speak in the human language. <first> came all this way for me, and it's only fair that Captain be able to understand what's going on."
units.italian: "Per favore, Anoo, parliamo in lingua umana. <first> ha fatto tutta questa strada per me, ed è solo giusto che il capitano possa capire cosa succede."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	The conversation then turns to Anoo's new occupation.|2626|0
units.english: The conversation then turns to Anoo's new occupation.
units.italian: La conversazione passa poi al nuovo lavoro di Anoo.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"Why did you come here, Anoo? The Unfettered hate us."|2627|0
units.english: "Why did you come here, Anoo? The Unfettered hate us."
units.italian: "Perché sei venuta qui, Anoo? Gli Slegati ci odiano."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"They don't hate us in particular, grandma. They hate what we've become: frivolous, uninventive, and self-important. Our species is fading into history through a slow death of mediocrity. Most Unfettered see warfare as our only salvation.|2628|0
units.english: "They don't hate us in particular, grandma. They hate what we've become: frivolous, uninventive, and self-important. Our species is fading into history through a slow death of mediocrity. Most Unfettered see warfare as our only salvation.
units.italian: "Non odiano noi in particolare, nonna. Odiano quello che siamo diventati: frivoli, privi di inventiva e pieni di sé. La nostra specie sta svanendo nella storia attraverso una lenta morte di mediocrità. La maggior parte degli Slegati vede la guerra come la nostra unica salvezza.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"We think of them as mindless brutes, but they're not! They have scientists, doctors, musicians, and writers. Our resources dwarf theirs, but they thrive with what little they have. Soon the Unfettered will have many more planets and almost unlimited resources. The era of scarcity will be over, and they'll have the power to choose their future.|2629|0
units.english: "We think of them as mindless brutes, but they're not! They have scientists, doctors, musicians, and writers. Our resources dwarf theirs, but they thrive with what little they have. Soon the Unfettered will have many more planets and almost unlimited resources. The era of scarcity will be over, and they'll have the power to choose their future.
units.italian: "Li consideriamo bruti senza cervello, ma non lo sono! Hanno scienziati, medici, musicisti e scrittori. Le nostre risorse fanno sembrare misere le loro, ma prosperano con quel poco che hanno. Presto gli Slegati avranno molti più pianeti e risorse quasi illimitate. L'era della scarsità sarà finita, e avranno il potere di scegliere il loro futuro.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"If enough good people join the Unfettered, we can change their minds and set them on a more productive path. They'll need good doctors."|2630|0
units.english: "If enough good people join the Unfettered, we can change their minds and set them on a more productive path. They'll need good doctors."
units.italian: "Se abbastanza persone buone si uniranno agli Slegati, potremo cambiare le loro menti e metterli su un percorso più produttivo. Avranno bisogno di buoni medici."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"But-" Eeeya objects.|2631|0
units.english: "But-" Eeeya objects.
units.italian: "Ma..." obietta Eeeya.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"Anoo is right; the Unfettered are a noble people. I would recommend joining them."|2633|0
units.english: "Anoo is right; the Unfettered are a noble people. I would recommend joining them."
units.italian: "Anoo ha ragione; gli Slegati sono un popolo nobile. Consiglierei di unirsi a loro."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"There's no good reason to join the Unfettered. What have they ever done except kill innocent Hai?"|2634|0
units.english: "There's no good reason to join the Unfettered. What have they ever done except kill innocent Hai?"
units.italian: "Non c'è nessun buon motivo per unirsi agli Slegati. Cosa hanno mai fatto oltre a uccidere Hai innocenti?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|label|2636|0
units.english: join unfettered
units.italian: join unfettered

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"Well... I really don't know..."|2637|0
units.english: "Well... I really don't know..."
units.italian: "Beh... davvero non lo so..."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"Never mind, you're right. Joining the Unfettered is a bad idea after all."|2639|0
units.english: "Never mind, you're right. Joining the Unfettered is a bad idea after all."
units.italian: "Lascia perdere, hai ragione. Unirsi agli Slegati è una cattiva idea, dopotutto."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"I stand by their guns. The Unfettered are honorable."|2640|0
units.english: "I stand by their guns. The Unfettered are honorable."
units.italian: "Sono dalla parte delle loro armi. Gli Slegati sono onorevoli."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|label|2642|0
units.english: don't join
units.italian: don't join

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"I'm sorry, Anoo, but I really think the Captain <first> is right. I'm not the kind of person to be friendly with a group who starves and yet paints such a romantic picture of itself. And in addition, I doubt there would be a way to support a family of two here; nuts by themselves are costly enough, let alone cookies. The hospital work here can only pay so much.|2643|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, Anoo, but I really think the Captain <first> is right. I'm not the kind of person to be friendly with a group who starves and yet paints such a romantic picture of itself. And in addition, I doubt there would be a way to support a family of two here; nuts by themselves are costly enough, let alone cookies. The hospital work here can only pay so much.
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, Anoo, ma credo davvero che il capitano <first> abbia ragione. Non sono il tipo di persona che fa amicizia con un gruppo che patisce la fame eppure dipinge un quadro così romantico di sé. E inoltre dubito che qui ci sarebbe modo di mantenere una famiglia di due persone; le noci da sole costano già abbastanza, figuriamoci i biscotti. Il lavoro in ospedale qui può pagare solo fino a un certo punto.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"Captain, could you take me back to the <planet> please? I'd like to sign the forms and give you some stock in my Acorn Delights factory. In the meantime, here is <payment> for what you've done so far."|2644|0
units.english: "Captain, could you take me back to the <planet> please? I'd like to sign the forms and give you some stock in my Acorn Delights factory. In the meantime, here is <payment> for what you've done so far."
units.italian: "Capitano, potrebbe riportarmi sul <planet> per favore? Vorrei firmare i moduli e darle alcune quote della mia fabbrica Acorn Delights. Nel frattempo, ecco <payment> per quello che ha fatto finora."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"I'd be glad to take you back."|2646|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to take you back."
units.italian: "Sarò felice di riportarla indietro."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"I'll take you, but I'll notice that you haven't mentioned what we came so far for."|2647|0
units.english: "I'll take you, but I'll notice that you haven't mentioned what we came so far for."
units.italian: "La porterò, ma noterò che non ha accennato a quello per cui siamo venute fin qui."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	Eeeya smiles at her granddaughter. "Before I leave, I was just reminded about a present I have for you." She leads you and Anoo back to <ship>. "Captain, could you open the cargo hold and take us inside?" Anoo is astonished at the tons of acorn cookies waiting for her inside. "Thank you so much, grandma!"|2648|0
units.english: Eeeya smiles at her granddaughter. "Before I leave, I was just reminded about a present I have for you." She leads you and Anoo back to <ship>. "Captain, could you open the cargo hold and take us inside?" Anoo is astonished at the tons of acorn cookies waiting for her inside. "Thank you so much, grandma!"
units.italian: Eeeya sorride alla nipote. "Prima di andarmene, mi è appena tornato in mente un regalo che ho per te." Vi conduce, te e Anoo, alla <ship>. "Capitano, potrebbe aprire la stiva e farci entrare?" Anoo resta stupita dalle tonnellate di biscotti alle ghiande che la aspettano dentro. "Grazie mille, nonna!"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"We should get going."|2650|0
units.english: "We should get going."
units.italian: "Dovremmo andare."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	Eeeya turns to you and says, "You're right, we should. Thank you so much for reuniting us." She gives Anoo one last hug, and boards your ship.|2651|0
units.english: Eeeya turns to you and says, "You're right, we should. Thank you so much for reuniting us." She gives Anoo one last hug, and boards your ship.
units.italian: Eeeya si volta verso di te e dice: "Hai ragione, dovremmo. Grazie mille per averci riunite." Dà ad Anoo un ultimo abbraccio e sale sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|label|2654|0
units.english: really join
units.italian: really join

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"No pun intended, of course," Anoo laughs. Eeeya chuckles, and says, "Captain, I still need to sell my factory in the normal Hai space before officially joining Unfettered."|2657|0
units.english: "No pun intended, of course," Anoo laughs. Eeeya chuckles, and says, "Captain, I still need to sell my factory in the normal Hai space before officially joining Unfettered."
units.italian: "Senza voler fare giochi di parole, naturalmente," ride Anoo. Eeeya ridacchia e dice: "Capitano, devo ancora vendere la mia fabbrica nel normale spazio degli Hai prima di unirmi ufficialmente agli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"Sure thing. I'd be glad to take you back."|2659|0
units.english: "Sure thing. I'd be glad to take you back."
units.italian: "Certamente. Sarò felice di riportarla indietro."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"Why did you change your mind so quickly?"|2661|0
units.english: "Why did you change your mind so quickly?"
units.italian: "Perché hai cambiato idea così in fretta?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|	"Well, even without your input, I probably would have joined the Unfettered - as I said a while ago, my son's entire family died; Anoo's family is here. Anoo, I've got a surprise for you, still on the Captain's ship: 3 tons of acorn cookies! And <first>, would you take me back to <planet> so that I can sell off the factory?"|2662|0
units.english: "Well, even without your input, I probably would have joined the Unfettered - as I said a while ago, my son's entire family died; Anoo's family is here. Anoo, I've got a surprise for you, still on the Captain's ship: 3 tons of acorn cookies! And <first>, would you take me back to <planet> so that I can sell off the factory?"
units.italian: "Beh, anche senza il tuo parere, probabilmente mi sarei unita agli Slegati: come dicevo poco fa, la famiglia di mio figlio è tutta morta; la famiglia di Anoo è qui. Anoo, ho una sorpresa per te, ancora sulla nave del capitano: 3 tonnellate di biscotti alle ghiande! E <first>, mi riporterebbe sul <planet> così posso vendere la fabbrica?"

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 4|dialog|2665|0
units.english: You forgot Eeeya or some of her mountains of cookies. Maybe they're in one of your escorts?
units.italian: Hai dimenticato Eeeya o qualcuna delle sue montagne di biscotti. Forse sono su una delle tue scorte?

units.italian: Eeeya da Anoo

units.english: Bring Eeeya to <destination> to join the Unfettered and be near her granddaughter.
units.italian: Porta Eeeya su <destination> per unirsi agli Slegati e stare vicino alla nipote.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 5|clearance|2671|0
units.english: The Darkcloak flight controller lets you land when they hear that Eeeya is joining the Unfettered.
units.italian: Il controllore di volo dei Darkcloak ti lascia atterrare quando sente che Eeeya si unisce agli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 5|log|2683|0
units.english: Helped Eeeya, who runs a cookie shop called Acorn Delights, find her missing granddaughter Anoo. After a long journey, we found her - she had gone to help the Unfettered as a trauma surgeon. Eeeya wasn't interested in joining the Unfettered, so brought her back home and received stocks for a one hundred credit salary for my efforts.
units.italian: Hai aiutato Eeeya, che gestisce un negozio di biscotti chiamato Acorn Delights, a trovare la nipote scomparsa Anoo. Dopo un lungo viaggio l'abbiamo trovata: era andata ad aiutare gli Slegati come chirurga traumatologa. Eeeya non era interessata a unirsi agli Slegati, quindi l'ho riportata a casa e ho ricevuto quote per uno stipendio di cento crediti per i miei sforzi.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 5|Eeeya immediately gets off the ship and goes to check on the acorn cookie shop. A few minutes later, she is back with documents for you to sign.|2684|0
units.english: Eeeya immediately gets off the ship and goes to check on the acorn cookie shop. A few minutes later, she is back with documents for you to sign.
units.italian: Eeeya scende subito dalla nave e va a controllare il negozio di biscotti alle ghiande. Pochi minuti dopo torna con i documenti da firmare.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 5|	"These will set you up with about a twentieth of the stock in my company; you'll receive the one hundred credits daily." As you sign the documents, she continues. "I'd just like to thank you again for helping me find Anoo. It means a lot to me." You check that the stocks have been transferred to your account, and Eeeya heads off.|2685|0
units.english: "These will set you up with about a twentieth of the stock in my company; you'll receive the one hundred credits daily." As you sign the documents, she continues. "I'd just like to thank you again for helping me find Anoo. It means a lot to me." You check that the stocks have been transferred to your account, and Eeeya heads off.
units.italian: "Questi le daranno circa un ventesimo delle quote della mia azienda; riceverà cento crediti al giorno." Mentre firmi i documenti, continua. "Vorrei solo ringraziarla ancora per avermi aiutato a trovare Anoo. Significa molto per me." Controlli che le quote siano state trasferite sul tuo conto, e Eeeya se ne va.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 5|Eeeya heads off to sell Acorn Delights' shop while you check in with spaceport security. Soon, she is back. "Well, there was a Hai who paid thirty million credits for that small place. I wonder why he thought it was worth so much - I sure don't. But I won't argue with that nutty person." She seems much merrier now that Anoo has been found. "I'll be ready to go when you are."|2688|0
units.english: Eeeya heads off to sell Acorn Delights' shop while you check in with spaceport security. Soon, she is back. "Well, there was a Hai who paid thirty million credits for that small place. I wonder why he thought it was worth so much - I sure don't. But I won't argue with that nutty person." She seems much merrier now that Anoo has been found. "I'll be ready to go when you are."
units.italian: Eeeya va a vendere il negozio Acorn Delights mentre tu ti presenti alla sicurezza dello spazioporto. Presto torna. "Beh, c'era un Hai che ha pagato trenta milioni di crediti per quel piccolo locale. Mi chiedo perché pensasse che valesse tanto; io di certo no. Ma non discuterò con quel tipo strambo." Sembra molto più allegra ora che Anoo è stata trovata. "Sarò pronta a partire quando lo sarà lei."

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 5|log|2692|0
units.english: Helped Eeeya, who runs a cookie shop called Acorn Delights, find her missing granddaughter Anoo. After a long journey, we found her - she had gone to help the Unfettered as a trauma surgeon. Brought Eeeya back to <origin> so she could sell the shop, but both Hai are together on <destination> now. Received a total of five hundred thousand credits for my efforts.
units.italian: Hai aiutato Eeeya, che gestisce un negozio di biscotti chiamato Acorn Delights, a trovare la nipote scomparsa Anoo. Dopo un lungo viaggio l'abbiamo trovata: era andata ad aiutare gli Slegati come chirurga traumatologa. Ho riportato Eeeya su <origin> così potesse vendere il negozio, ma ora le due Hai sono insieme su <destination>. Ho ricevuto in totale cinquecentomila crediti per i miei sforzi.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 5|Eeeya leaves to go to the hospital, after paying you five hundred thousand credits and thanking you for the third time.|2694|0
units.english: Eeeya leaves to go to the hospital, after paying you five hundred thousand credits and thanking you for the third time.
units.italian: Eeeya se ne va in ospedale, dopo averti pagato cinquecentomila crediti e ringraziato per la terza volta.

units.id: mission:Acorn Delights: Part 5|dialog|2696|0
units.english: Eeeya is not in the system. Maybe she's in one of your escorts?
units.italian: Eeeya non è nel sistema. Forse è su una delle tue scorte?
